It's come a loooooong way since it's glitchy & limited 1st gen days, but there's still a lot more work to be done. PVP needs a balancing overhaul, prices have almost doubled on everything, and it seems like the pokemon have become harder to catch. Part of me only continues to play because of all the time & money I've dumped into this game over the years, but at least it's an extra way for me and my girlfriend to bond. That, and it DOES still encourage outdoor exercise, despite how greedy it is.

Overall I really enjoy the game. It is a good way to learn more about pokemon and how to fight with them as well. While I do really enjoy the game, there are a few reasons why I gave it 4 stars. Due to word limit, it will have to be brief. - Randomly freezes as you catch pokemon - some raid pokemon are insanely hard to catch and seems like they want you to buy passes to catch them. - Storage space is easy to fill. To get more (choosing to buy) the amount you get is so small.

The latest updates are so incredibly frustrating that I'm considering uninstalling. They introduced a "Reward Road" to give player items when you make certain purchases, but the Niantic website no longer has the page to redeem rewards and you can't do it in-app. I transferred Volcanion to Home and now I permanently can't complete research tasks. Oh, and on top of that, the AI support chat does not work at all! There's no way to report the issues with the AI.

I've always loved the pokemon games, and I've watched the anime since I was 4 years old. It's awesome that there's a mobile game for it that's so fun. The AR features would be awesome if they didn't lag so much. Love the rewards and events, they're amazing. I go on walks in the real world to catch lots of pokemon, and then I claim so many rewards when I get home! It's a great game if you need motivation to get outside more.

I've been playing since 2019. It used to be better, as many are saying. The current problem with mine is that even though adventure sync is turned on, it's not working. I only collect kms when the game is running (and eating through my battery, even though I'm not playing). My other complaint is that when they redid levels, they gave you tons of items (awesome), then later said, "Oops here's 200 extra storage." Yet, I'm still out of storage from the level change. 🙄

Started playing the game when it came out. However, this game used to be fun. BUT, by adding TOO MUCH to the game (dynamax, max, gigantimax, etc), it has become too confusing and hard to keep up with. The original "gym format" shouldn't have been changed. If you don't have a pokemon powerful enough to take or defend a gym......find one you can. OR make gyms based on levels or strength of pokemon (tiers). Also, 4 star pokemon and shinies rates should increase after a set level (50+).

Played since release. It was fun for quite a while, but now I just login once in a while, see what around me and log off. Nobody wants to do raids so I dont join them. theres no point in purchasing anything. I think for game longevity things need to change. Maybe solo raids could be a thing. Add items to target farm specific pokemon. That kind of stuff. Hope the game gets better.

The game is okay, but there are always bugs, so it gets frustrating. Sometimes the game will crash just after I catch a pokemon, or I can't open the screen to play with my buddy, or the buddy just can't be placed, or the little photo sticker menu gets stuck on the screen even after I exit. I've had these same problems for years and always end up deleting the app and redownloading a year or two later.

Came back after years away and some things have changed for better, but the constant lockouts to update and reinstall is excessive [7/16/16] A LOT of fun ...when it works. Highly addictive, but I'll pass until the glitches get worked out with the server. It freezes WAY too much!! And, of course, always at the worst times. Also want to see battles with strangers (not in the gym), pokemon trading and have the pedomer running when the app is closed.

All I want for Christmas is a way to sort postcards by alphabetical order so I can easily delete all my doubles. Otherwise its a fun app. I am interested to see how the new updates go. But for the love of all things good in the world, please make it easier for us to delete duplicate post cards. The sorting by sender is broken. If I can sort by alphabetical order, I can sort and see duplicates even if I have doubles from 2 different people. Please do this.

I am quite addicted to this game, unfortunately. I get a lot of enjoyment out of it. My problem is the company in general. I bought remote raid passes with real money. I completed a raid but the app froze before I could get to the catch encounter. I filed a complaint, and a bot responded that there was no problem and they would not reimburse me. I have since found out this happens regularly. It would cost them nothing to fix this, but they choose to do the wrong thing instead.

Enjoyed playing this with loved ones. It's quality in terms of mobile app games. When they raised the prices on quality of life items, I wasn't bothered. When Niantic sold the game to a Saudi company, I was only kind of concerned. Even when it was revealed that the game was a data miner, I wasn't that outraged. Recently, the game has added a feature that turns off vpns when you load it up. We're not doing that. I'm leaving a one star review and uninstalling.

There's no ads, which is a HUGE win for mobile gaming. I played this when it first released, and I still believe that's when we were the closest to world peace. The downfall of Pokémon GO is the fact that there's SO MUCH going on, but they give you so little to work with. Upgrading storage is slow, expensive, and doesn't give what it's worth. Those extra 50 Pokémon slots? Gone in an hour.

This app is so neat and it keeps me active, but the glitches/bugs are unreal. Over the last couple days, it has been cheating me out of km walked with my buddy. GPS errors for no obvious reason, gym errors, sound cutting out randomly, etc. - all problems I've had within the last two weeks, let alone over the 9+ years I've been playing. A game with such expensive in-app purchases should offer a higher quality experience.

love the app, but I do have a few problems with the app: 1. anytime I'm battling (whether that be against ppl or rocket grunts/bosses) the game will lag so bad that I have to exit the entire app or else it'll freeze the game completely, 2. it takes over 2 minutes for my game to open(yes I timed it.), 3. sometimes when I'm trying to catch Pokémon they'll never catch and instead will just run away. EVERY. SINGLE. ONE, 4. I could catch a 1000 Pokémon with one ball, but then I can't catch a 25??

I used to play this game everyday until the latest update. The app keeps force closing on me. I can be in the middle of a battle and it will suddenly close. It's really frustrating! I'm thinking about uninstalling. Used to be 5 stars for me but now... It sucks Update: I wasn't having any problems up until recently. The game was working just fine but now it's force closing on me nearly every time I open it. Cleared the cache, checked for updates but nothing works. Ugh!

Amazing game! But, with all the raids, battles and events, there's too much going on. I mean.. I love the events, but the different types of raids+battles are too confusing. I lovee shinx. Fav pokemon evolution line. I think there should be a way to lure in specific types of pokemon. Like how there are sandwiches in pokemon scarlet and violet. It would make it easier to get the pokemon you want instead of just hoping to get one.

I have been playing this game since it originally launched and I really enjoy some of the changes that have been made over the years. One biggest complaint now is that the play with your pokemon feature has always been difficult to work with, and that's hasn't improved. It tells you to look for an open flat surface but then never gives me to foot steps to place a pokemon making leveling friendship and gathering gifts very difficult.

Let me give you my Analysis on this game and why it has the potential to be so much better and fun for everyone. First, you guys have to find a way to either round off the Pokemon or decline some points when it goes over 1501. it's just plain old disgusting that something hasn't been done to alleviate the mathematics of battling as well. I felt like y'all created a MODEL and ran with it, with no desire to evolve it or make it more strategic. Also, more special TRADES!

this is a very good game. but the problem i have is the character design looking very cheap and none of the clothes fit the female body right. there are also a lot of game glitches. it happens mostly when i'm catching a pokemon, flipping gym signs, or when it doesn't log the amount of km im going. Whenever I'm in a battle it takes very long to use the attck on the botom of the screen because of how low the touch sensitivity is. please fix this.

Update: My pokemon eventually returned from the gym after a couple of weeks however I did see in one of the gyms 2 pokemons that stayed there for over 95 days, this is unacceptable. Another thing is that on android phones you can't redeem codes in the app and have to go in a website unlike iPhone users who can redeem it in app in the poke store. This is a decent game however I'd like these problems to be evaluated. Please fix this Niantic.

If they kept Pokémon's core mechanics of experience and leveling up from battles, this could have been one of the best mobile games of all time. Instead, we got a candy mechanic, stardust, a glitchy battle system, cheap gym rewards, and having to catch the same Pokémon over and over again to evolve the one you want. This completely goes against what Pokémon really is about. It is a massive disappointment.

The game is a lot of fun when the app works. It's pretty glitchy. I sometimes have to open and close it repeatedly to get it to load my location. The layout of the app needs attention. I can never find my rewards because they're scattered across four or five menus plus a couple of other places I wouldn't think to click. Having everything in one place would actually make sense.

Repeatedly lose interest in this game, created by people who seem to have no clue what makes Pokemon fun and just cash in on the license. Now, Pokemon take forever to replenish without spending money in the store. Pokestops aren't dropping anything useful. I've completely stopped battling since I almost never find revives. Bottom line: not realistically possible to fulfillingly play solo. And without a local social circle, it's unrealistic to play AT ALL. Uninstalling. Again.

I enjoy this game a lot. Recently RE:installed myself. I wish there was something the developers could do with pokemon in Pokemon GO & Pokemon in Pokémon TCG PC & mobile versions. I know they're separate games but that could merge a player fanbase. Users from the other app would install the other app. I would for certain prizes and stuff from TCG. 🥹 but great job on GO as it is. I like the battling feature and ranking features on it the most.

Microtransactions have become more and more expensive. I have no issue buying items: the developers etc need a paycheck just like the rest of us. But prices are higher now than before, just look at the bundles on the store, and ticket prices. Plus, it's borderline pay to win anymore, and lately, there's a paywall if you want a greater chance at adding the latest Pokemon to your Pokedex, not to mention the the bugs & shoddy customer support. There much more to say, but I'm out of room.

My account was randomly deleted after I had gone too long without logging in. Couldn't have been more than a year. It had 9 years of memories. The team needs to be more forthcoming about their tendency to purge player accounts after what most would consider an unreasonably short amount of time. Support hasn't answered my ticket for almost 2 months regarding the issue. Can't recommend this game any less.

The game has started to lag and crash a lot, and because of this, I spent a lot of in-game money, which takes forever since there's a daily limit on how much you can collect, to do a remote gigantamax raid and I can't try to catch it since this game crashed and I can't to another one thanks to all the upgrades I had to buy. Support also basically told me I was out of luck too since the raid was already completed. I am so close to uninstalling this frustrating game.

Purchased one of the new event passes and sent it to some friends. Normally you would get to keep the tasks after the event time so you can have time to accept them all, without any mention of change I got to keep nothing. I completed tasks and the event ends too early. Heck it really starts too late. 2pm is the worst time of day for anything due to heat where I live being at it's highest point for the day. Wish I could say this game is user friendly but it's not.

My account was stolen in October 2024. I reported it to their support near end of October. They told me I didn't qualify for account recovery and wouldn't elaborate. I've sent 2 other requests since then and have continued to be given the same response. Literally told me to make a new account to keep playing. 10 years and pokemon from other games/consoles just gone. Money spent on in-game events and items, gone. Very cool, thanks Niantic!

Once again not working. Emailed developers since attempts to log in to my account are failing. Received emailing saying they can't help me, go to settings. Yeah that would be great.. IF I could log in? now works! The app itself is addicting and very fun. A great way to get out instead of sitting at home. I would give so many more stars if I could play it! I understand some bugs but I've tried loading up the app several times a day the blast 2 weeks and have only been able to play twice.

The game has a great initiative and concept. The only problem is you can never play longer than 15 minutes before you run into some kind of bug. Server issues continuously, constant connection issues, when you battle a gym 85% of the time you can't beat the boss because it glitches out and the boss won't die, at times game says there's no Pokemon around, and the list goes on. Also, when your team owns a gym, it's ridiculous how you have to battle your own gym just to place a Pokemon on it.

While the game is great for reliving childhood memories, the game is slowly tanking. It's made various changes that are inconvenient to the users (remote raid passes, not sharing odds of finding shiny, etc) for the exchange of more bugs and errors. The recent has been logging in to not be able to interact with anything on the screen. There's so much to write... it's a shame that the potential has deteriorated as much as it has expanded.

Niantic has decided that they know what's best for their users and are taking away the things that make the game playable for those of us that have busy lives. Oh well, an almost seven year run was fantastic. Shame that I'll never hit 50 now that it's not feasible to do anything worthwhile the once or twice a week I have to play now. If you have access to Campfire and an hour (or more) a day, then this is still a great game! If not, try something else where Niantic can't screw it all up.

I love the game so much, but every time I exit the game and try to load back in later, it freezes on the loading screen and has a "sign out" option, and when you press it and try to log back in again, it just says error. I found a solution, (a very annoying one) which is to uninstall the game and then reinstall it. I have tried contacting support but I'm not sure there is a way to fix it without an update or something. Like I said, I love playing the game, it makes walking around really fun.

Been a long time since I have been able to play. Trouble loading, even on a brand new phone. Graphics take to long to load. Go to tap on a character in the wild and won't pull up to try to catch it. The trouble of it is not worth my time. Even know a few others with similar problems with the game that have quit playing as well. Moved on and found something else to mess around with instead.

In the beginning, it had appeal. The game was flawed, sure, but it had some cool features that were added as the game grew aaaand then came the greed. Raids were fun. Trading was fun and cool, but as more features became available, so did the micro transactions. Remote raid passes were cheap-ish, but they then increased it more, and more, now events are as costly as a go-fest most of the time. We accept it because that is what it is. I recommend skipping this game.

Just started the game 2 weeks ago. Have enjoyed playing it daily. As of yesterday when the time change happened, I haven't been able to get into the game beyond the log in screen. It says I have a bug, and need to clear my cache. Tried that, as well as uninstalling and reinstalling the game. Nothing works. Hope you fix it soon, or you lose a new player.

Good game overall in terms of gameplay. However, it fails in all other departments. Had an update that removes avatar items that you might have spent irl money for, along with numerous other issues as in items clipping through one another, deformation to body parts with certain items, skin tone selector broken, the list goes on. Overall I would not recommend this game, as judging by the history of updates, your progress in certain areas might be wiped by future updates.

Uninstalled due to doubling the price of remote raiding and limiting the number of remote raids a day. This is just the last straw in a string of changes designed to price gouge players. I've been an active player since 2017. This recent change seems like nothing more than greed wrapped in a package of "We want the game to go in another direction" from Niantic. Make the game more enjoyable, reliable, accessible, and less about greed and location data collection.

I posted a review back when the game first came out. Since then lots of changes happened, new content and whatnot. The game is more accessible in urban locations and has advantages depending on where you live or travel. That's my biggest problem is that either you live somewhere where Pokestops can be found more available, or you'll have to play the micro transactions game. While it has improved experience since I first, some players will always have an advantage.

Hard pass. Epic Fail. The game is set up to fail. No matter how skilled you get. It's nothing like the world of Pokemon and having to walk around in below zero temps to play is asking a bit much from players. The only other option is to spend ridiculous amounts of money to play "remotely". Can't even connect with friends unless I'm in the same room. The battle format is nothing like the rest of the franchise, you need to grind or buy supplies to level them up, battles provide no experience.

I have played off and on since launch, and it used to be fun and made me enjoy exercising. I don't mind paying for some things to enjoy the game more, but the recent inflation to in-game items and limit to remote raids was the last straw for me. How can there be inflation on an infinite digital resource? Even if you do pay to play when raiding, it does not guarantee you will catch that pokemon, and it makes shiny hunting much more difficult. This game is fun, but it's time for me to leave.

Update 5/13/2020. Would be nice to be able to open gifts all at once and send them this way also. Also, why does there have to be a limit to how many gifts we can get each day? Lastly, having a star rating show for your Pokemon without having to click "appraise" would be time saving. Would like to see trading added soon. Also, the transfer button should be at the top of the menu so I can get rid duplicate Pokémon faster. Great game so far, just needs some fine tuning.

Entertaining... Until it stopped working on the third day of a fresh installation on a new phone. It was working fine the first two days, but now it just crashes as soon as I get to the map. I cleared cache, data, uninstalled, reinstalled. Would've been a fun way to spend some free time, but I'm glad I didn't have enough time to get too invested before it started crashing.

I've been playing this game since 2016. I did take a couple years off, but I started again about a year ago. My original rating was 4 stars. Then 3 stars. Now we're at 2. Somehow, there are at least as many bugs, if not more. With the new price hike on the remote raid pass, I'm finding less of a reason for this game to take up my time or battery life. Or the increasing amount of money. Please stop with the price gouging, Niantic.

I last played this game in 2018. I posted a 1-star review then, but the formatting has since broken. I reposted it, but then decided it's not helpful since it was 6 yrs old. tl;dr: i haven't played this game in 6 yrs, but the game was a mess then. I know people who still play it, and it sounds like it's still a mess, and none of the problems I had back then (poor distribution of gyms/stops/mon despite living in one of the largest cities in the midwest) have changed.

The attraction of this game for me was the fact that it was less complex than standard Pokemon. That's no longer the case. Storyline and faction missions take forever to complete. Floating ad balloons will frequently work to inhibit your ability to tap on things near them -- rotate your screen to try and get a better tap angle on something else, and the balloon will shift with the rotation to stay in the way like it knows you're trying to tap something else. It's just gone so far downhill.

This gave had turned into a total money grab. You need to pay for almost every event, big or small. They keep raising prices of items. They limit how much of the paid for items you can use in a day.... It's almost impossible to do a lot of raids anymore unless you go out with people. I've been playing since day one. It got progressively better than as COVID went on it got progressively worse. I'll still open it occasionally but it's GG for me at this point. Sorry Niantic.

The game is a fun and interactive take on the traditional Pokemon franchise games, and it is great at motivating myself and many other people to go outside to partake in some form of exercise. I would have given five stars, but there is an ongoing server issue that is making the game very hard to access in places of high on data traffic. Due to this the game is sometimes unplayable. Don't let the bad things stop you, this game is great fun.

Pokémon GO is actually a very fun game, but there are a few issues I would like to point out. When I walk a certain distance, it takes a minite or two before I'll hatvh an egg or find a candy. The online battling is cool, but I've had a few glitches and it isn't the best thing to do. I also run out of pokeballs really fast, and I wish there was another way to get them besides gifts, field research, and spinning pokestops. Other than that, I would say that this is a very well made game. 👏👏👏

It's a really good game to play especially with friends. I just updated it an had to transfer some of my duplicates, every time I did, it would take me all the way back to the top of the list an I don't really like that. I wanna be able to transfer my extras without having to find were I was. An another thing, I tried to get some coins but it wouldn't accept my card.(Ik for a fact there was more then enough money on it so that wasn't the issue.)

Love the game and am excited to see other games try this concept. There are bugs and server issues, but I am hopeful that the devs will correct these through updates soon. I will change my rating to a 5 when the bugs are fixed. Edit: 6.2020. Well, the game still has many server issues, like getting kicked out of a 5 star raid after beating the boss and not being allowed to try catching it. Still a 4 star game.

Day 1 and I can't even use the damn app. I go to open it on my galaxy s4 and it won't recognize the GPS location even though it's turned on. Too many bugs already noted, too many issues, not enough development put into making things more streamlined for all users. (Edit) since then the game is great! Still has issues recognizing GPS at times. Overall fun if you have money to spend. Which the game requires if you're after shiny legendaries.

The game has gone downhill extremely fast. From the outrageous pay walls, the money gouging, and the pay to play BS. I used to really enjoy the game, but its actually aggregation to play now. The go battles are horrible. As soon as you go up in rank, it's like the app puts you against the perfect counters every time. The doubling of pricing for the remote raids is just the end of it for me. People who can not get out of their house are forced to not be able to play due to cost and limitations.

This is literally the only game I have ever had any interest in playing and it worked fine for one day, just long enough for me to get into it, and now it just crashes on start up, over and over and over again. I've done all the things. Uninstall, clear cache, delete unused apps, sign out and back in. Everything. All it does now is crash on start up. If I could rate 0 stars I would. I am so disappointed.

This game was great. I have no problems with the game play. However, a big part for me is the character customization in the game. This new update has ruined the characters. Every character looks hideous. I want to throw up every time i look at them. There are no curves and no features. And why is the face so puffy. Horrible i would definitely quit if this isnt fixed soon.

This game has started with very few features and quite a few bugs. Niantic's solution to fix bugged features is to remove the feature entirely. The game has so little going for it already, and Niantic has basically ignored the complaints of players and has remained almost completely silent. On top of that, there is no reason to play if you live in a rural or suburban area, as pokemon never spawn. Ever. But hey, they fixed the servers. Good for them.

Probably don't play this if you live in a rural area that isn't walkable, because they remove the playability if you spend any time playing it in the car. I, however, love the thrill of getting angry at a video game, so I will continue to play it. Other than that, functionality isn't bad, and so long as you avoid having the app open during long travels you should be good.

I literally just started playing and it skipped all the tutorials and put me right into the making a nick name part, and I can't seem to restart at the beginning, or even just redo the tutorials. Great design... Not to mention I can't seem to find a way to contact customer support. Update: got back into the game December 2021, and support is *still* garbage.

The first summer it was released was magical. Being able to track Pokemon and find them was SO much fun. You'd go out to a park, and someone would yell out, "there's an Electrabuzz over here!" And people would rush over hoping to catch it. There was something so simple yet engaging in its first version. But the constant bugs, removal of the tracker, and late updates really killed any momentum this game had of being truly remarkable.

I was able to play all day today, without any issues. Tried getting back on, and it wanted me to update the game. Okay, sure. Well now, like everyone else, the game either won't load, or crashes as soon as it gets past the front loading screen. Obviously can't play if the game won't even load 🤦‍♀️ Maybe they will fix this issue in the next day or two so we can play again..

Could have been a great game. It has lots of potential. But when you get people hooked into certain features of the game, that were the main reasons they play the game, and you sneakily break some of those features, you will lose players. Not to mention spending money, and finding out after that you were essentially tricked. **8/2019 UPDATE** Many upgrades these past couple years. Keep up the good work. We need an ability to trade in extra candies from one pokemon, into rare candy.

The only thing I am unhappy about is the difficulty finding certain types of Pokemon, which seems to change at random. Especially when I have research quests demanding specific types, or very specific Pokemon. I'm also NOT thrilled with the region specific Pokemon. Aside from these the game play is pretty smooth, the graphics are phenominal, and the ability to play with my family as friends is a great benefit. Over all this is an exceptionally family friendly app, and a wonderful game

The game is fun, it has a lot going on. The mechanics work well and are very smooth, the game has taken off from it's starting date in 2016, no issues with gameplay itself. But I find it frustrating/unfair that things like raid hour and "complete 30 raids" type missions are ridiculously obnoxious, one raid pass a day, and it's 100 coins per pass. I don't want to spend two weeks doing what I have to just to complete one mission, personal lives and children make that quite hard.

Updating my review after recent events. I do not know what they did, but this game in it's current form broken. The bugs started the day of GoFest (a paid event). Many times the game fails to load. Spawns disappear as soon as you click on them. Shiny rates are significantly lower than advertised. Auto catchers disconnect within 5 minutes instead of the hour they're supposed to work. All these bugs are in addition to the anti consumer changes made by devs recently.

I've played this since the beginning, July 2016. I've gone through all the bugs.. Just kept playing. However, the lagging, losing raid passes (not my fault) getting them back is really hard to do. Took me forever to figure it out. click here, and boom you take me to another spot and out of game..so I log back in try it again, again, again. I finally got it back. Niantic, you've become so greedy. You're one of the biggest games but you keep raising your store prices. You're losing us 1 by 1.

The start up is slow, It freezes and when spinning a poke stop is always says "Try again later" You have to spin it multiple times to get anything. Tho the game is fun, But I feel like for an app theres a lot to it, I mean sure it's great to have more, But for the 16 GB phones it's almost impossible to have anything else than social media and pokemon go because of how much space it takes up. I've had this game since the release date and it has become easier yet harder. all in all a good game.

adventure sync is really bad at monitoring my km. adventure sync is on, high accuracy location and it still screws me out of rewards. I walk over 20 miles at my job alone and drive to places 250 miles away... still can't even hit 25km. please figure out how to make that more accurate for everyone or change the weekly goals to something a little more obtainable like 5km, 15km, 25km. other than that the game is amazing. I enjoy it and just got into pokemon go last year. fun goals and interactive.

It's a fun diversion built on the skeletal remains of Ingress. The flick controls are forgiving but inaccurate, making it tough to chuck a ball consistently. I quit for two years because I live in a rural area and there was nothing to do. There are still no stops or gyms near me, but at least pokemon finally show up and I get different varieties.

They have fixed many of the issues and the app is working great on my phone now. I've had only one glitch in the past week. Very pleased. Still looking for a couple things to get fixed, but I'm much more satisfied! Edit: I (and all my friends) are very frustrated with the trading feature. There is no realistic reason why when you trade a Pokémon, their stats would change. This completely ruins any desire to trade and is a major factor in why I've stopped playing.

Adventure Sync isn't working at all. I liked being able to log how much I walked during the day, since my job has me walking around a lot. But now, nothing, no eggs and no progress. I'm not going to keep the app open all day and drain my battery life. Get Adventure Sync working again!!!! It's still an option in settings.

Game is enjoyable but the character selection/features are lackluster, less than low budget games. And when I found out it was done intentionally, I was disappointed. Previously, before a certain update, the character selection was better and the artistry looked better. Pokemon Unite is another Pokemon Game and they have really cool characters to choose from and be, including changing styles. A nice portion of the game is individualizing your character, to take that away is a huge slip up.

I have a coolpad quatro 2 4g, and when I downloaded the app, it would show the first screen, before force stopping. I'm sorely disappointed. Please fix this? Edit: Years later, I return to this game on a much more powerful phone, the samsung halo. Now it just freezes every time I try to catch a pokemon. Glad to see how much it has improved over all that time.

I came back to this game 2 yrs ago and it was because of the pandemics groundbreaking new features that were added such as remote raid passes. Anyone could play and thats how it should be. Prices were reasonable and you could easily catch up on what you missed if you were a returning player. Niantic has slowly wanted to chip away at what brought new life to this game. The latest is putting limitations on remote raid passes and doubling the price. Therefore, as many other have done, uninstalled.

Originally had this game at 1 star because of Niantics terrible management of this game. Though this temporary event doesnt fix the main issues with the game (which is still plenty. Ie tracker, grinding, end-game goals) it's a step in the right direction. Editing my review to give props on the effort on their part. Still a long way to go though.

All the good work they put in went down the drain. The character models were downgraded and they don't look appealing. I cannot make them look like they used to and they're pay walling fixing this. Niantic has lost the plot. Characters have NEVER looked this bad in any of the games. I uninstalled and will not touch this game ever again. This on top of all the issues they refuse to fix, the compatibility breaking down, it legit seems like they don't want players.

My previous review was deleted. I have played this since it came out. I loved it when the community was active and I was in college. As a grown adult who has moved 7 times in the past 10 yrs, the recent changes affect the way I play w/ friends. I live in an area where I have to drive to play this game without spending $$$, and any gym I have been to in the past year has no one there to raid. I do "GO" and walk, but hiding part of the game w/ paywall is insane. And the game crashes all the time!

Pokemon Go. It really is a fun game. I've spent the last few days catching mons and taking gyms. But so far, I could only do it in the afternoon-night due to how loaded the server is during the day. Other than that, solid game. Edit: After multiple questionable decisions made by Niantic, such as increasing remote raid pass prices and actively hurting the accessibility that the game once had for its players, I can no longer recommend playing this game.

Be ready for network errors and tons of bugs, and not the ones you want to collect. Takes fun out of playing it. Contrary to their claim, this is not a location based game, this is a time based game, or more presized, FOMO based game. You don't get rewarded for going out to explore, you get rewarded for playing every day and to follow endlessly appearing and disappearing "events". To be fair, you get some rewards for traveling across the globe, but that just encourages spoofing and cheating.

With the new version, it kicked me off the old version and I lost everything. I was told there was no way I could get on to my old account and playing since Beta version doesn't save my Pokemon or any of the achievements that I accomplished. Its good for a beta version. There are alot of bugs that are being worked out. The server crashes often. I'm often fighting a rare pokemon when the server crashes and I lose them. :(

Theres more bugs now than there was when the game first released. I've been playing since the day it was released and I've put so much time and effort into this game... now it's nothing but errors and glitches. fix the bugs and stop ruining it by trying to make it better, just like everything else. I think the game actually working is more important than being able to buy a different pose for your character in the style shop, or being able to pay to switch to a different team.

I love the game. My fiancee convinced me to redownload it to play together. But, for whatever reason, I cannot access the shop to buy pokeballs or other items with real money. I have uninstalled the game and reinstalled it. I have also tried using my account on a different device, and I tried making a new account, as a last resort. Nothing seems to be working. I just keep getting a blank white screen. This issue also applies to my character customization screen. Please fix!

Very fun game if your a fan of pokemon. I enjoy collecting the cards and the simplified battle mode (in comparison to the actual tcg). Only problem is there is absolutely no advantage to going first in a battle as you don't get an energy. If you go second your able to attack first which seems backwards. Also I do wish there was more perks to having a premium subscription other than just getting an extra pack a day. Overall a good experience that I hope they continue to improve and update.

I originally rated this game 3 stars at launch. There were bugs (I mean lots of bugs), that seriously detracted from gameplay. However, the concept was cool and I put up with it. Sadly, Niantic has made it VERY clear they have no intent to fix or further improve gameplay. They have actually REMOVED key gameplay features, such as tracking, since launch. The community is crying out for a response on when bugs will be addressed, and Niantic is silent or pushing out "minor text fixes".

After the update, the character models for the player looks like they were downgraded. The customization options you have aren't great either. The faces look too similar to one another besides a single eyelash difference. Hair colors became more matte and less reflective of the lighting. The abdominal area is lacking in customization, which makes the player look like a noodle if they use don't increase the weight to max. The update had great intentions, but the execution of it was abysmal.

Let's get this out of the way: I know that launching a large game is difficult, but the server issues caused by poor prediction of player base is frustrating and game-breaking. I expect Niantic to do better and they have to work hard to get to the level of quality expected of them. The server issues create a host of unexpected behavior, including unbeatable gyms and frequent halts, crashes, and generally broken gameplay. When the game works, it's a casual, fun way to enjoy the world of Pokémon.

The menu to favorite, appraise, transfer, etc has been the same for ages. Appraising and transferring pokemon that I don't want is muscle memory, then you go an add tag in and mess the menu up. I will never use the tag feature. Would be nice to get a feature in settings to check a bubble that will remove it from our menu. I am going to click Tag expecting it to be appraise 100 times in the next 24 hours and that is going to get very annoying.

It gets you out and walking around. Still a lot of bugs in the system. Needs more servers, i cant transfer duplicate Pokémon, i caught a abra and a cubone but it froze when they were in the poke ball and i had to restart game, it shows that i saw the pokemon but didnt catch them. Which really sucks. But once you guys figure out the bugs and add servers this game has potential to be the best game ever. Keep up the good work! It would be cool if you gave me som cool Pokémon ;).

Update: massively updated the game since the last review. Lots more to do. Significantly better and still getting updates. Developer makes updates but don't address the main issues, such as trying to find the Pokemon. Now it's a sightings list instead of approximate proximity. There also seems to be less Pokemon in general as well. It's only OK. Fun for a little bit then that's it.

Really great game! I really enjoy the concept of walking around town to catch the Pokemon. Edit: my current complaint is that 9 times out of 10, Pokemon Go won't connect to my GO-TCHA device. The device works just fine with its one app, and my phone's bluetooth is working properly, but I can almost never get Pokemon Go to connect to it and I find this extremely frustrating.

You'd think by now they would make changes for the better. Game has never been near perfect but was always enjoyable enough to keep playing. A game is supposed to be a way of distraction. With busy schedules and jobs, remote raids was the only way to keep up with everyone else that has time to go out to limited timed events. Anyway, its not much a lot of us ask, but until remote raids go back to the normal, it was fun while it lasted. Sadly money wasted.

I LOVE this game, but there has been a recent bug that is extremely annoying. And NEEDS to be fixed. When I try to battle with a remote raid pass and get further from the raid, it would pop up and say that I need to walk closer to interact. A REMOTE RAID PASS IS FOR THAT! THEY WERE MADE SO YOU CAN BATTLE AT A DISTANCE! Not only that, but everytime when it kicks me out, it ALWAYS says Network Error. When is there is none!

It would be OK if things like trading weren't so expensive (one MILLION stardust to trade a shiny I have 5 of??) and if it didn't randomly ignore my settings. It's a 50/50 chance that when I do something that would play a sound other than the music the app will start playing music with the setting still off, same with vibrations and haptics. If there's a somewhat big event on, expect connection issues. I basically use it to get myself walking, that's all it's really good for. Middling at best.

I'm reducing the stars because lately I've been having issues just signing in. Sometimes I have to jump off wifi to get it to work, sometimes I have to restart it several times, and other times I just have to come back to it later to check if it's working. It's a bit annoying when, at the same time, my sister hasn't experienced this at all, so I recognize this is not a common thing.

They made a lot of Quality of Life improvements during Covid such as increased spin distance. This not only helped people social distance during the pandemic but also helped a lot of disabled/handicapped players. We're still in the midst of the pandemic and Niantic made it so you have to be right under pokestops/gyms to use them. This is a big step backwards and makes the game a lot harder for lots of players who can't reach pokestops and gyms for various reasons.

I am an unashamed 45 year old woman who loves playing this game with my grown children!!!! However, as of 1/27/2020 gyms are either not showing up or showing up in the wrong locations unless I restart my game. I have also noticed issues with the renaming feature and I have frequent problems with the GPS shooting me off to unknown locations then bringing me back. Please fix the bugs. It would also be great to be able to tap on people in gyms and send friend requests.

I began playing this game during the pandemic. I have a physical disability, as well as depression and anxiety issues. Initially, I loved this game because it accommodated all three by allowing me easier access to PokeStops, encouragement to walk, and by not triggering my anxiety attacks. Now Niantic has removed bonuses that so clearly should have remained. I want to explore but can't because of these rollbacks. It's become a stressful game and I may need to stop because I'm not having fun now.

I love the app, I was playing it almost daily up until recently until this last update (think it's the last one); I've tried updating it for about two weeks now and it just won't update. I've tried everything to get it to update so I can open the app and hatch my eggs, but it refuses. I keep getting notifications because I have eggs that are hatching, but can't open the app without having to update. This has become quit aggravating and I hope it can get fixed.

Game keeps crashing within minutes of opening now. (12/29/2022) makes the game unplayable. I haven't been able to update the game either in weeks. Even after uninstalling and reinstalling the game. I'm starting to get really irritated. Similarly after a few hours I end up logged out of the app only to have to download the app again in order to get anywhere with it. I've been playing since the very beginning in 2016, and have never had this many issues with the game until now.

It's an incredibly fun game, but it's terrible for non-drivers and people in smaller towns. There are far less pokestops and gyms, but they are closely knit together, so that's a small bonus. Its tougher to find certain pokemon like Ditto when hardly any pokemon appear in the first place, and the 7-Day Pokestop items are nearly impossible to get when you don't play every single day. No game is perfect and I do really enjoy the game altogether.

This app has crashed more times than anything I have ever downloaded combined..multiplied by 5. Wasted money on things I couldn't used because it will crash 16 times in a row in 30 min Edit. From 1 star to 4. It's come a long way in 4 years. Fun game to play woth the kids. Keep working on :BL please? Maybe make it so you can keep battling after 5, but just for fun with no rewards? It keeps you in the game and would be a lot of fun just to play and practice.

From 4 stars to 1. After the last update I can't minimize the game without it shutting off on me. That means my go plus is worthless until this is fixed. The speed limit also needs to be removed. That was the whole reason for the go plus so you could play when you normally couldn't. I feel like I wasted my money on it now. The speed limit is the stupidest thing they have done since getting rid of the 3 steps.

Also... Niantic, I live in a rural area. I have to drive to a city to find pokestops, and even in the city around here there are few and far between. It is highly unfair since those in towns get the advantage of more rare pokemon, more supplies, more everything since they have dozens or more stops. Help! Otherwise it's fun, but I'd like to actually progress in the game.

At first its a amazing game. But over time it dies. More and more updates making it WAY harder to play and crashing a regular thing now. It's really annoying. Plus, the game creators are slowly just going into a pay to win game. Please fix these issues. Other than all the bugs and glitches it's a really cool adventure and collection game.

Experience starts off pretty well, and is easy to learn. However, this game is very much Pay-to-Play. After a while, the resources you need, like pokeballs and potions, start running dry and your bag is filled with the worlds most useless stuff. I get the game is funded through in-game purchases, but if you're not willing to drop a good bit of money on the game, it might be harder to enjoy.

The game implemented a bunch of great changes over the pandemic that made the game easier to play and more enjoyable. Since, they started rolling those changes back, and increasing the cost of raids and limiting how many you can do in a day. Quests often require you to see or catch pokemon that often aren't available for months at a time. As a player of many mobile games, this is one of the least friendly to players who don't have much money to spend.

I think the game is phenomenal, however, I think having to try and use 10-15 Pokemon balls to catch some Pokémon is a little ridiculous. The regular Pokémon balls break to easily. The ultra Pokémon balls can also tend to break to easily. Not very often but sometimes. Also, several times the app fails to work and will not load. I feel that happens more than it should. But, all in all the game is once again phenomenal and very addicting. :)

It's ok but gets repetitive after a while. There is no real way to connect with other players. They need to add a chat. Even in an urban area it's near impossible to find others to raid and trade with. Also too many cheaters are faking their location. The game has always had issues with lag and battery drain though not as bad as when it was first released. Though there is room for improvement, it can be fun to play casually. But you might want to play Ingress or the main Pokemon RPGs instead.

Its okay, it definitely gives you something to do when you're out doing errands but it'd be nice if female characters could wear male items. Like the Fire red cap. Or backpacks that are only for male characters at the moment. I just feel female customization is very limited in comparison and male characters have so much more (better) options to choose from. 😭 I even switched to using a male character because of it. Even though I prefer having a female character.

When a company starts charging more money for game related things, while also becoming less fun and more glitchy, it's time for me to move on. Between releasing an incomplete, in-person, global event and hiking prices on items that improve the experience, I'm ready to find something better to do with my time. It was starting to feel tedious. The combination of the two things I mentioned only highlighted the fact that I'm not really enjoying it anymore.

This could have been great, and even was in some ways when it came out. However, through various updates and a lack of communication with the community, Niantic has ruined this game. Tracking has been removed after being bugged for weeks, making it harder to find pokemon. Additionally, spawn rates have been reduced, making it even harder to find them. Then, Pokeball capture rates decreased, while the pokemon jump/attack more often. Overall, players are being duped into buying more Pokeballs.

Update: So the game is better, more stable and back to 4/5 starts. Only took 4 years to come out of early access. (Original Spe 2016) You'd think I'd have been farming Missing No. with all the errors going on. Not sure which brand of potato the servers are powers by, but this was pokemon, everyone knew this would blow up. Someone at the top was trying to save pennies and not set up a appropriate buffer for the influx of new players at lunch.

Constantly getting a GPS location not found, even after turning everything off that requires use of my Location, Wi-Fi on, data on, location on...but still getting errors, can go to maps and GPS location is dead on to where I am at, but this game can't...once improved will give better rating. There needs to be a option to move your character around the map, not all of us live in major cities, some of us live out in the country and don't have the chance to catch rare Pokémon because of it

I've been playing this game since it started and somehow my entire account disappeared. I've been able to provide payments from my account, screenshots of the account, friend code, and so much more but was told that my Level 46 account 'never existed' and there is nothing that can be done. How is there no back up of accounts that they can track! Horrible customer service!!!

I don't like how you can't trade with someone who is not near you, I have friends that live a good bit away from me and I barely ever see them so I can't trade with them. Other than that, it's an amazing game. It's entertaining and fun, I just wish the range for trading was expanded, or maybe you could "mail" the pokemon to them, and it take a little bit to receive/send the pokemon if they live away from you.

This game has gotten so bad now... I came back after a few months and it has really gotten bad. Even with my mobile data on and even on a stable wifi connection, it lets me login and the screen goes blank. It displays a message about wifi connection but, I do have connection. Unable to play doesn't even show my character or any options. I was looking forward to playing again but, sadly I'm leaving again. Good luck Niantic

Fun game, but after the recent updates I've been unable to play it because of a GPS error. Tried everything (uninstalling, staying outside to find a better satellite connection, restarting, refreshing location tracker) and it never worked. If it gets fixed, I'll 5 star it. Other than that, it's a pretty nice game besides the 50 daily gold limit.

Pokemons Go is a good game. Not great. But a good game. Some of the game play can get very tedious at times *cough the gym battles cough* but other than that everything pretty alright. 2 major problems however with the game are the login methods and lagginess. I've lost at least 3 accounts because you have to pass a massive security check. Second there's the lag. If you don't have mobile data, you're screwed. Overall good game but nothing amazing.

Been playing faithfully since launch. We definitely need to emphasize on friends. We need to have a option to be notified when they're online. And we need a chat/messenger system in game to ask about trades, or if they wanna battle etc. As of now having friends isn't as helpful as it should be. Upgrade the friend system some more and I guarantee this game will stick even harder.

Edit: Removing the pandemic range boost is the single worst decision they've ever made. I hate it so much. Original review from 7/8/16 below: Not going to rate this with a consideration for the server outages. Half the world is trying to get on, honestly with a response the positive and such high demand, it's to be expected. The game itself is a lot of fun and once the server issues are worked out its going to be amazing. It's only going to get better.

7/17/2016: If it's your intention to play the most popular, completely broken, app on the market, look no further. Servers are always falling out of sync, gps lags horribly, game crashes/freezes constantly. This game would be 5 stars if it weren't for the absolutely wretched server infrastructure. 7/21/2019: Decided to try the game again only to find out my friends list and fitness metrics won't load. due to this I can't utilize about half the game content. good game, incompetent devs. sad.

I still love the game but I am becoming increasingly frustrated with the lopsided RNG factor. I put in a ton of effort with little to no progress in some areas and it's becoming more of a constant letdown than anything. It seems as if the game is only recently beginning to pick up pace again. I'm hoping things continue towards positive.

The game has definitely improved and they have added a lot to make it more interesting. The only thing I have a problem with is while winners of a gym battle get first chance to put pokemon in the gym, if another team joins in while you do all the work to defeat it they can take it out from under you which is very frustrating. I've had many gyms I had to beat multiple times because someone stole it from under me.

Been off and on over the years, but this recent change tells me that Niantic isn't listening to the very people who support/play this game. Because of that, I will no longer participate, which gives me more time to play other games. Thank you Niantic for making this transition easy, by implementing bad decisions. It's like Monster Strike all over again lol.

Overall fun, frequent crashes and login failures, and a HUGE battery drain. Would be nice to be able to scroll around the map to see where PokeStops are. Tracker is basically pointless unless it's at a pokestop. There needs to be a way to swap between sightings (what's at PokeStops) and nearby (what's in the wild). Getting stale with a lack of pokemon variety.

Waaaaaay too grindy. Also so much takes money. Extremely hard to play casually and if you do play casually don't expect to ever make it to the max level. Used to be fun, and lots of people love it, but it's just too big for me. If I play this I wouldn't be able to have any other hobbies pretty much. Update: they keep reducing things that were beneficial to players and such.

Unless you live in or near a big city the game could be frustratingly empty in regards to pokéstops. For those of you who don’t yet play the game, pokéstops are landmarks like statues, attractions, special buildings, and the like. They have stepped up their placement of pokestops in smaller towns, but many of the mechanics still heavily favor large metropolitan areas by nature of the games design. There's no real way to fully mitigate that but they're doing what they can to try.

Kind of had it with this game. Always log in troubles during special events, slow "friendship" leveling, no candy in trades if traded Pokemon were caught too close to who you're trading with, frequent crashes, must pay for more space and quite a few more. This game is less fun when I can play it and the latest update seems to have broken it completely. Even if I keep playing never spending money on it again.

can't log in using facebook credentials. Had to use my old PTC login info. Also, the past couple of updates have had a very annoying bug. Many times when either a Pokemon pops up on the map when others are already there, I run from a Pokemon, or I catch it, all Pokemon will suddenly disappear for a long period of time. I'm not driving or anything, so that's not the cause. If I'm on a walk, I have to stand still for 10-15 seconds before everything comes back. Please fix this.

Its lacking any substantial content. The challenges are boring and the games insanely repetitive. Theres really no sense of accomplishment when you do complete a challenge. It really feels pretty bare even after several years. The ONLY reason its even worth playing is because you can catch and collect pokemon. But that alone isnt enough to make it a good/fun game.. Niantic really dropped the ball with this one. They had a chance to make a cool game and made a joyless cash grab instead.

Pokémon GO is quite fun, but I must admit that it definitely has it's frustrations. I have never noticed any game breaking bugs, however some features are definitely annoying to work with at times. Activities such as gifting friends and questing can be long and tedious. In order to progress quickly/comfortably you are obligated to be active as most events, items, and Pokémon are best gathered/caught in that way. This game's good for collectors, competitors, outdoorsmen, and Pokémon fanatics.

Played many games on phones and this one by far gives a ton of play time without having to spend so much money. You only spend money if you want tuinga now or to continue playing in another way (i.e. raiding). 4/5 stars because the grind to get coins is slow and makes you want to spend money (good tatic btw). This game is better now from when it first started. The free parts of the game get repetitive, but things seems to change out every 3 to 4 weeks.

Getting better. Really liked the extra candy and shorter distances for buddies during Halloween. Could still use the ability to battle and train Pokémon when not near a gym. Server issues are also annoying and would like egg hatching steps to count when app isn't in use. Ability to trade would also be appreciated. 2020-March Constant GPS (11) issues. Game is becoming completely unplayable/un enjoyable.

Greatly improved since its launch. I am a returning player, and the pokestops as far as i am aware have increased significantly in frequency, as well as gyms. I can actually play now! The buddy system is very cute, the battles and GO Rocket battles are nice, and remote raids are a great addition. One issue I have now is that every time I go to catch a pokemon (literally, every time) it tells me to update ARCore, which WOULD be fine... If ARCore actually HAD an update for me to get. Pls fix!

I love this game, but I hope there's a new tracking method coming soon, removing the footprints makes the game so much more difficult. Also, it could just be every phone I've had, or the game, but I can't participate in raids or gym battles. It resets and then I'm no longer in the group or it lags so much that it freezes the app.

Game is ok, but I'm pretty much stuck. I have no gyms or stops anywhere close to me. I can walk around my neighborhood, but don't really get much in the way of good spawns. And, unless I want to spend stupid amounts of money on pokeballs (only to waste countless balls trying to catch anything since I have no berries and basic pokeballs, so good luck catching anything.) It seems unfair that if you are not surrounded by gyms and stops, the only way to win at the game is to pay pay pay

Lowered rating based on reduced distance to interact with stops and nerfed incense among other things. The quality of life improvements they made at the beginning of Covid made walking way more fun and left the right amount of distance for safety regardless of pandemic. Horrible decision. It's fun but for being a walking game, the animations should be much shorter. Catching and evolving and even opening and sending gifts are so slow. I hope to see a faster paced game in the near future.

The more it's updated, the worse it runs. It goes days without being able to track location, rendering the entire game unplayable. It routinely requires "updates". I put that in quotes because it actually doesn't update nor require updates. The updates don't install correctly, so the entire game has to be uninstalled and reinstalled multiple times a month if you wish to play it.

Was a fun game. The developers of the game keep making poor decisions that limit the game and the ways to play it, decreasing the value that players get. Cutting event times in half, removing rewards, increasing the price of everything in the boxes, and now the changes to remote raiding. Enough is enough for me, can't support this game anymore because all I can think of is everything they took away from me as a long time player who occasionally spent money on the game.

Edit: with covid present, it's not safe to play this around other people. A remote use item would be amazing, letting you control your location for a time limit. Even if it's a paid item or once a day use. Its fun and addicting and a decent game, unless you live in a rural area. It doesn't matter how much you walk around if there are no poke stops around you then you WILL run out of supplies and won't be able to play anymore. I have to go 4 miles just to reach the closest stop.

Most in-game items aren't worth the money, Niantic seems to have realized this and offers boxes now. Unfortunately the game still caps coins at 50. I'd be cool with 30 per gym, up to 3 or 4 gyms. The game doesn't really encourage taking or holding gyms anymore. 2016 player here. Not much has changed, although I'd love it if this game had more integration with their other products. The limited mystery gift option is grindy.

I love this game and have played for 2 years. However when I make nice/great/excellent throws with ultra balls, pokemon flee more often than when I land the poke ball outside the circle. Also, sometimes research doesn't register that I completed it. For example today I battled in a raid to complete a special resesrch task, didn't win, and the task is still incomplete. Poke ball reset still lags for android.

Updates happen often and the app is a memory hog, uses a lot of data and drains the battery quickly. You can paly once each update is completed. Plan for this. Updates are needed. They are working through the bugs. It is a fun game and you can play it for free once you learn how. i'm sure it is more gratifying when you spend some money.

Getting a network error when participating in a raid. Even though the Pokemon has been defeated it freezes, the timer runs out, and nothing happens the game has to be restarted. Everything that should have been gotten from the wind of a raid is lost and was unable to catch the Pokemon. Otherwise I love this game it is amazing and I actually have met a lot of people playing it

(edit) Great game, it really motivates me to go walking everyday. There's lots of fun events to keep you active and give you a reason to come back. Only con is the servers mess up every once in awhile and makes it hard to play the game. The devs need to get their stuff together. They need to listen to player feedback better because the game could be so much more.

As if it is not bad enough that this game glitches out in terms of accurate GPS/location readings, but I have in the past purchased an item through Niantic for Pokemon Go, and activated it, only to have the game crash on me again. I contacted Niantic for a refund, as the item was unusable in this instance, and the company literally did not once try to rectify the issue; it was as if I didn't exist, but they were sure happy to take my money. How about responding to your customers, Niantic?

I'd give this game a give a five. Only, you all should make it a whole lot easier for us to trade Pokemon with friends. Its difficult when you live long distances away. I'm stuck on one task now, only because I have no friends close enough to trade with. Also; it would nice to see new Pokemon pop up more often instead of catching the same ones in the same place all of the time. I promise to rate it a five when you add those features. Because I love this game. 👌🏾

I'd give this a 3.5 - it's fun to play and the concept is unique and real-time. But... people with small data plans are limited in play outside; so if you're stuck in the house you could be forced to buy and use the incense; it's pointless to search for nearby Pokemon without the little tufts of leaves that help you find them! That's what makes it fun!! Come on! Bring that back! Also, passengers on any vehicle transport can no longer catch, even though they have to press the "I'm a passenger".

The game is excellent in every way, as far as time management, on the go, and is a great outting with friends. The only thing I really dislike about the Pokemon management system, is that for events, you can't transfer them during or after. So presently I have like 25 pikachus just sitting in my pokedex, and I'm waiting for an update that allows me to get rid of them. UPDATE-I figured out how to transfer pomemon manually.

The game is fine, the location based spawns definitely incentivize going to the city over actually exploring or walking. I think they should drop the whole walking thing to some level or add some feature specifically pertained to walking. The battles are simple at best and the ways you can interact with the world feels liiting. The 2 main things that make the game fun is pokemon and collecting. It's a collectors game, though i wish it was more. Atleast they put a lot of effort in anti-spoof.

Greed got the better of them. Once upon a time this was a great game that focused on bringing the best it could to players. But over time, they've continued to make decisions to prioritize money over the player base. They made the most money when it was the opposite, but they're trying to squeeze everyone dry now. More paid events, worse shop bundles, the continued insane 50 coin limit from defending gyms that doesn't collect/reset until you pokemon is knocked out. It's just not fun anymore. 😕

The least polished game I've ever seen allowed to bear the Pokemon name. Turn off all the sounds, they're unbearable. Turn off battery saver and enable native framerate. It's capped super low by default, but doesn't actually appear to help the terrible battery drain. Also: after 8 years, they added some character customization, but it's the ugliest thing I've ever seen. How did it get approved? But hey, it gets me up and walking around places more than I otherwise would, so full credit there.

This game has become largely pay-to-play, and even then it's so buggy and laggy that it barely works. Niantic does not listen to or acknowledge the player base at all, and every update seems to be a blatant attempt to make more money, all while ignoring bugs that severely impact gameplay. I really want to like and keep playing this game, but it has gotten too frustrating. I have been playing since 2016 and am currently level 41.5

I've played since 2016. The game is enjoyable and addictive. It's unfortunate that none of their updates have ever attempted to reduce the amount of pop-ups, though. Don't play while driving; PS, here's a pop-up to distract you. Don't want to download the new AR+ thing? We'll show you a pop-up for it every time you log in, and another letting you know you can change your settings anytime. Still mad love for the game. But I wish they'd chill with that stuff.

I've played since day one and loved it. Sometimes the changes to game play are rough, but it ended up being OK. However, in the last couple of years, but especially lately, it has become extremely expensive. You have to buy a ticket for almost every event, sometimes the events are exclusive to paid tickets, and I'm not talking the big Pogo events. THEN, your purchase isn't even guaranteed - You have to perform a ridiculous number of tasks in a certain time frame or you get nothing.

This seems to instantly be one of the greatest games of all time. The only thing it REALLY needs is a PvP update along with trading, making it perfect. Too bad it has been out for years and really hasnt made much progress on the inovation front. Don't get me wrong, they have polished the game up very well since the beginning, but not a lot of great additions to the game..

I love the game. I have been playing since the beginning and its gotten better with time, but still issues.(1) There is still not a way to change/recover the email to a poke account. My email was hacked and never recoverable, therefore, my level 37 poke account was not either and had to start all over. A lot of time and money spent on that account and could do nothing about it. (2) The New Attack button seems it was intentionally placed there for players to accidently push and waste stardust!?

Core of the game is simple, you go out and catch Pokemon to gain a currency for that specific Pokemon, and raise Pokemon. Theres way too many bugs, particularly ones that block the player from getting resources, logging in, participating in the core of the game. The developers released this as a "Beta", so basically the modern equivalent of a fully released game with the excuse for as many bugs as they have. It's still fun, but the UX is terrible

It's a fun game overall, but it continues to have the same bugs that it has had for years, mainly errors for gym battles and raids, which are a pretty big part of the game. Frok the standpoint of a consumer, it seems like more effort is put towards new gimics and flashy content rather than fixing foundational issues, and it feels as though Niantic does not have the support staff necessary to provide for their consumers.

The game itself is good, I had it a while back and it ran okay. Recently I redownloaded it and it doesnt run well at all. In places with good conection I have to respin things several times and get a ton of "try again later" messages. On top of that, after one or two battles it starts lagging and eventually slows down my entire phone if I dont leave the app.

This game has had my attention on and off since its release in 2016, but my frustration begin to grow in the past several months as I kept experiencing more and more bugs where my game would freeze, or UI elements wouldn't show. The release of XL and XS Pokemon was an underwhelming feature that adds little to gameplay and they soon followed it by restricting the way people can play the game by changing remote raids . The game was at its best during the pandemic when they laxed restrictions

I have had this game for a while now and it constantly keeps force stopping. I can give through the notification that it is stopping bit no help has been received. Its annoying when you are running another app like lets say..... YouTube and Pokemon go sends a notification that it isn't running and it stops what i am doing because the app cant get it together!!!!!!!

Love this game! There's been so many issues with it lately though. Trying to buy community day tickets and screen goes blank. Have had issues with trading pokemon, game freezing randomly, getting logged out, and few others. Overall even with the issues, they have gotten fixed eventually. This game has been great way for getting out and exercising, spending time with my little family, and meeting new people.

Love the game. Since i travel for work i get a chance to play this in a number of areas. The only thing is it needs a touch of oldschool. I miss leveling my pokemon or getting items from battling wild ones. Gyms are cool, but we definitely need some more of the battle aspect. Also the random attack from TMs is SOOOO dumb. Especially when you get an even worse set of moves. What's the point?

While not perfect, it has slowly gotten better. My only major grip at this point is that while being a passenger in a moving vehicle and/or while running, its next to impossible to get poke stops, which you were able to do when it first came out. I hate having to stop running to spin a poke stop. They need to move the threshold to something like 15mph

This game is great, but not for the reasons you'd expect. The random adventures I embark on with friends bring this game to life. While I enjoy hunting and collecting (especially shinies), it is the community that keeps me coming back. I will say that Niantic's a very inconsistent company and updates can be slow or even terrible, but this game is truly unique, with a truly sizable player base to help theexperience.

Was excited to get to play it as i know other people who use the app, unfortunately though, it seems i an unable to move anywhere. Even if i walk around, the game does not track my location and my character remains frozen in its spot. Cannot figure out how to fix this. Edit: i have figured out a tedious way to move around, by closing the app and reopening it in a different location. Gotta do this whenever i want to go somewhere, though.

I was so excited to try this out. Now I'm having every issue there is. I can't get my GPS location to work; location cannot be found and I can't even get the servers to work. I can't even catch a single Pokémon even when the game DOES work which is very rare that it does. Extremely disappointing. Maybe if you'd actually fix the bugs we'd rate the game 5 stars instead of 1... 👎👎👎

Fun game play. Not a fan of micro transactions on here. Also you run out of poke balls if you're not able to go to poke stops again. I understand that is part of the game play, but it can be frustrating when you aren't close to poke stops. Also, I had a little lag on my phone, but I have an older cheaper Samsung. Overall, I do enjoy playing this game very much and would recommend it.

This review was inspired by the recent avatar updates. More colors and body choices would have been great if they hadn't done a terrible job. Weird head shapes, no waists, clothes have droopy crotch and more clipping issues, faces uncanny, no skin tones like mine (and some of the darkest look purple, at least on my device). Just bad. Also, boxes in the shop have gotten way expensive. I will spend $1 or $5 occasionally to stock up on certain things, but not $20 at once on coins for a single box.

Edit: Unable to authenticate tring to log in for the past month. Have tried reinstalling and changing my password. I can no longer get pokestops driving into town, so I'm uninstalling. I would have to drive far out of my way to wonder around a park for just 2 pokestops and it's just too inconvenient. This game barely offers anything, but continually makes it more difficult to do anything.

I'm disappointed in Niantic/PoGo. You had a great set up going during the majority of the pandemic. It made it easier for me to actually join in the game. I have a spinal injury which makes it nearly impossible to leave my apartment to 'move around and walk'. Since you've made your changes back so you can only 'have fun' by walking around I can no longer play. You forgot there are people who are unable to do what abled body people can do who play this game and make accomodations.

I enjoy the game well enough but I miss being able to collect from pokestops while being a passenger in a car. I realize they want people to walk but not everyone lives in a safe area to walk around all the time. Also would love if it could sync with fitbit to count the steps I do take. I know it's supposed to be able to sync with Google fit but I haven't noticed it doing so lately which sucks because I'd like to be able to hatch eggs with my daily walking and not have to have the app on

I used to regularly spend money on their boxes because they provided a good deal for getting incubators. Not any more. Sadly their pricing has changed and so has their boxes. Every week now they change and they are too expensive and not a good value. And they don't have the play coupon anymore through Google play. The only good thing is I will be saving money.

[07/2016] The server is constantly down or kicking you out. I'd say 1 out of 5 usually can't log in from what I've seen amongst groups. Other than the servers and occasional glitches it's surprisingly addictive and pretty fun to go out and play with friend's. Major kudos for getting people to walk more. I'm in AZ and it's way too hot to be outside but as soon as the sun sets I see everyone out playing Pokemon GO and just having a good time. [10/2019] Since the updates its been more fun.

Had a pretty good time with the game, its fun and has alot to offer but sadly at some point it just stopped counting my steps. So now i have over 9 eggs i cant hatch and cant comeplete some quests because of this bug. I'm not the only one having this issue, but I am hoping it gets fixed soon. Would gladly play again once it gets fixed. Edit: Bug was fixed and back to playing again!

Currently, I understand that this is a first release besides the beta tests, but at the same time I hope that a lot of the common problems are addressed later throughout the game existence. Mostly with logging back on after closing the game, a lot of "server" crashes. As well as walking to a place where there ARE Pokemon and the Pokemon not loading... Otherwise the game is a fun idea, and I like it a lot. Just has some disappointments. Edit!! (05/31/2020) The game has improved vastly! Love it!!

I downloaded this game when it first came out. It was fun, but living in the countryside, and being someone with a physical impediment, it was just way too difficult for me. I redownloaded this in the middle of the pandemic and found that I could finally actually engage with the game. Now, though, it is again basically unplayable for people like me and it's actively endangering people during a pandemic resurgence. Way to listen to your fans, Niantic. What an awful, insulting move.

I've had my review at 4 stars for nearly 3-4 years, and I've even spent probably $25 on add-ons, but recently, the app is unusable for some people.
