You can catch pokemon without having your camera accessible to the app, but if you have permissions turned off, it has a pop-up telling you this for EVERY. SINGLE. POKEMON. It is very annoying. I'm not using AR, so why are they trying to force it on me? I don't want my camera accessible and never will. STOP ASKING. I'm considering deleting the app.

It's a pretty good game for the most part, but of course my favorite pokemon riolu is extremely if not impossible to get without spending real $, and a lot of time, and even then it's still a very small chance. I wish it was easier to trade, I don't have any friends I can trade with because all my friends are long distance. And it would be nice if Pokemon spawn according to their environment, like water pokemon near places with water, etc. And I would of liked having different hair styles.

Game itself is enjoyable when it works. But one too many glitches at pokestops, or while catching a legendary Pokemon, or when trying to complete weekly research will leave a player frustrated. Many high level quests require you to go out and make friends or battle in huge raids. If you can't coordinate with your friends to play, or aren't much of a social butterfly, this will be difficult for you. But the nostalgia is great, and the game overall enjoyable.

Had a lot of fun playing this game the last few years. But Niantic is increasingly becoming a pay to play powerhouse. With the reversal of the extended interaction distance based on "getting back to the roots of exploring", yet keeping remote raid passes that you can pay for in order to raid from afar... Calling BS. They're just mad that they didn't get a chance to monetize on increasing the radius. Probably going to come out soon with a radius extension item for xxx coins.

As soon as I open up the app, it's hard to spend more than a few minutes on it. Most of the pokemon that appear are repetitive and lame. They add pokemon time to time, but they still aren't that great. Character customization is also limited to clothing that's largely hidden behind a paywall of their in game coin system. Game play is just an overall "meh"

The game would not let me move no matter how far I walk. It'll also not let me catch the Pokemon no matter what I tap on. I may be doing it wrong but it is still very laggy (We have great Wi-Fi). I deleted it and reinstalled it and it's still just not working. It's not frozen because when I tap on the screen it has the special effect it does. I literally just started the game and it wasn't working right off the bat. If anyone reads this don't get this app. Developers FIX THIS!..please

I've reviewed this game a number of times over the years since it's been out. At this point, I'll leave it at...it's a good game, that could be much better. If you can deal with the bugs and glitches, & live in an urban area with gyms and pokestops, you'll enjoy playing with friends. If you don't like learning to live with new and odd bugs/glitches that come in with each update, or live in a rural area, you may not enjoy the game. Niantic could do better with the great base game they have.

Constant server issues, and now log in failures. Edit 7/2/23 I've been playing this game since it dropped. Now we're back to the same issues as when it first came out. I've been unable to log in 95% of the time and when the game does log me in, it freezes. I've tried every little trouble shooting tip Niantic provided and NOTHING. Absolute BS

I believe this is an amazing game. Especially fun when you play with friends. However, for those of us who live in rural areas, it can be hard to fully participate in events when the nearest gym is miles away. Increasing the price and placing a limit on Remote Raids is blatantly hindering a specific demographic of the player base for the sake of profit. None of the player base supports the changes to remote raid passes, and while I love this game, I cannot support it with this change.

I've had this game for years and put so much time and a little bit of money into it over the time. throughout the years they've leaned heavy towards the pay to play/do well side. about a week and a half ago, the latest update hit, and basically rendered the game useless, as it now immediately kicks me out saying the app has a bug. I am certain Niantic knows about it, but seems to refuse to fix it. there is also virtually no way to contact their support outside of the game.

On one hand, being able to catch Pokemon in real life is awesome. On the other: the constant resets, bugs, failure of tracking system, server issues, balls that curve without prompt, and other things really kill this game. I'm pretty sure if it was Anything but Pokemon it would have failed on day one. EDIT 2019: waited a few years, it's mostly just an alright game, let's you play pokemon with people. Solid 3 stars for mediocrity

This game is one of my favorites! The higher prices of remote raids passes made me really upset when the change first happened, and a lot of people were talking about how it's impossible to get good stuff now. On the contrary, it made the game less pay to win, as people could not spend hundreds of dollars on raids like they used to. Also, the new backgrounds for the game really drew me back in cause now the graphics aren't trash. Also, new research and bug fixes makes the game more engaging!

As a player who started on the day it came out, has been playing since then, and has actually spent money on the game.. it's just not worth it anymore. Niantic has taken a great game and just absolutely tried to squeeze every penny out of its user base. Between the remote raid pass changes and price increases, I've lost interest in leveling up, and my husband has too. Super sad. ☹️ This was a great game, Niantic, and you've ruined it.

As much as I love the game. I have not been impressed with the amount of challenges/events that Niantic has been adding to the game with the pandemic going on. Yes they have made it so you can play more of the game from home. To have it so I need to find a raid that I can solo while being under a stay at home order is a little ridiculous.

It used to be fun and at some point, it was the best game on my mobile and was highly addictive. Now the app crashes and freezes a lot. Pokmon evade more so that you spend all your items and you need to buy them from store. Decreased speed limit so I can't play anymore on my commute. Every update makes it much more worse. Finally I just uninstalled it.

Game mechanics aren't particularly fun. Gym system is completely unfair to those who can't dedicate large amounts of time or in the wrong place. One person in my area with too much time, makes gyms a nightmare, which is terrible game design. The combat is boring with little variety. The only aspect going for it is the collecting, and that becomes less fun when the package around it sucks. Simply put, terrible designed game that is kept alive by the Pokemon theme.

Extremely annoyed. I first started a day after the game was released but stopped playing until a few months ago, where I purchased an amount of coins to customize my avatar (to which I was very satisfied with). Come to find out, with no warning, that they completely changed the models! Now the items I had purchased look terrible on my avatar. Some of them clip through, and now everyone looks samey. It genuinely feels like I wasted my money and I hope the devs somehow fix the situation.

Update: after years of playing, I am unistalling the game. Niantic only cares about selling user location data. Change after change is based on increasing prices, limiting content, and selling data. Below is my review from over a year ago. Niantic just keeps making poor decisions in the hopes of gathering more analytics. They are isolating the player base and it is getting extremely frustrating.

Was a player of this game from the beginning. Always loved the idea of walking around and catching pokemon. It's gotten to the point now that the game isn't enjoyable anymore. And everything they do to "help" the game I feel like they're getting farther from the point of helping. The spawns are the same, you basically have to pay to get the good or cool pokemon. Any package you can buy to get items to help speed up the game cost at an insane rate. Just nah man.

Since it just launched, the servers have been crashing. When it's running, it can still be slow especially when walking past pokestops. Also, I used an incense item right before a server crash which was a waste of the item. Can't wait to see how the game will end up, but right now it is pretty hard to play.

I had just joined the game and after spending about 30 minuted tryna make an account, I finally got into the game and created a pretty good character. But afterwards, I was supposed to catch a starter pokemon. I was unable to because they were all stacked together in a pile under me, so I couldn't really catch one. After refreshing the game multiple times, it's still like that. Please fix this. This is very annoying!!

Every update makes this more frustrating to play. GPS is 8/10 not found, even with my phone's location method set to high accuracy. And even then, it shows me across the street or something similar, making me unable to spin pokestops or gyms when I'm walking. It also tends to say I'm in a totally different area, that I usually don't recognize, while if I open Google maps, then that app says I'm exactly where I'm standing...

I'd seriously pay money if I could get the app to not crash and freeze 30 times a day, or even if it didn't take 2 minutes between clicking on something and it actually pulling up whatever I clicked on. If I had a dollar for every time a Mon popped up and I immediately click just to get an error reading "this item can't be used at this time." I'd be able to pay to fix this bull for you.

I can't take pictures of my Pokemon where I find them. Very, very rarely do they show up. The battery drains super quickly. My phone freezes up completely. And there's no way I can battle except to go to a gym. Which there are few around me within reach. And the servers are constantly going down, even though I have connection. Hopefully it gets upgraded.

It's a great game in all but Battle Mode needs a lot of fixes. For one, sometimes when I Join, the game will freeze and by the time I'm back 1 of my pokemon is already out and it's not fair, also, when somebody JUST used there ultimate, after 1 hit they can use it again and it's not fair. Even when I count how many shields the enemy has, they get like an extra one or something. They had none but they were still using them. It needs to be fixed.

Used to be able to track Pokemon in the game..now there is absolutely no direction as to where to go... Everything has become a random encounter. It was more fun when we could see the Pokemon steps go from three to two to one to none. You will waste a lot more time and battery life. This is just one of the problems of many buggy features in the game.

I've loved playing this game for years. I recently got back into it, and everything was working as it was supposed to until a few days ago. Now im consistently getting error codes 11 and 12, referring to GPS and location. I've tried EVERYTHING. Toggled WiFi and Data, made sure location was on, restarted my phone, reinstalled the app, etc. PLEASE fix this. I really want to be able to continue playing, but this makes it impossible, and I believe it's a glitch in the game.

A disappointment to say the least. Paying 15 usd and getting one shiny after catching close to if not more than 1k pokemon(during event time) is absolute nonsense. I have felt my account has had a rarity (shiny, perfect, zero) limiter or something akin to it for a while. This was the first and the last purchase I will make from this game until this is fixed. It isn't just me, tons of articles and complaints about this. The raid pass price hike and how slow animation is ruins the game.

Some features need to be fixed. Minor bugs and some server issues, I don't think they were prepared for that much traffic. I'll still play in hopes that they fix the bugs and add battling and more Pokemon. I'd pay just to have more features and mini games with this. It could be a lot better. Still, helping me handle my alcohol problem by not sitting on my butt! Edit: This game has been ran into the ground by people that don't even play their own game.

This is an awesome game no doubt. Only thing is every now and then there are errors or glitches that cause me to miss Pokemon or poke stops. Hopefully the update will fix that, but other than that highly addictive. If you don't want to spend money on in game purchases, then I recommend walking everywhere. The more poke stops you go to, the more items you get.

I loved the first few weeks of the game the going out and seeing everyone playing together, now I've seen a bit of embarrassment at still playing it. My biggest problem is the lack of gyms and stops within a good walking distance. (traveling to play a phone game is out of the question) I guess it isn't the game for me. Oh bonus points on finally having a way to hatch eggs outside of having the game open.

I've been playing since launch, and the recent update makes me want to uninstall the game completely. The character changes are horrendous. I'm all for more customization of our character, but did we need to be turned into a swamp monster? No offense to swamp monsters because clearly the character design in this game is atrocious. One of my favorite things about the game was buying cute outfits and changing up my characters look for each season. Can't say I'd even bother anymore...

I've had fun with Pokémon Go, but every time I log back into the game, my settings are refreshed. Fine, I've kept the standards, but I really do not want AR on to view the buddy. Is it really hard to keep a setting in place per player? Further, the routes and location may or may not work. Lots of raids had to be refreshed mid game as it doesn't load. All the issues are making this game unfriendly.

I understand that it's just in the beta. but it would be nice if I can at least connect to the game. Everytime I go to play it says it's having technical issues...3 days in a row almost every single hour.... Update: still not a good app. Seems it only likes to work best if connected to WiFi. Takes forever to load and when finally in game. constantly says can't find GPS when i have it on.

A game still good for collecting my pokémon I love! Longtime player, but I have started having a lot of issues and new Route feature is not available near me yet. Snapshots have not been saving on my Galaxy S23 (check yours!) even though I can progress any research that needs them, I want them to save, lol. I still play every day now, but hoping for some intense bug squashing. Extended trade options with long time friends, pls!

It is one of the few free games with minimal pop-ups and ads. You can truly play it without spending money. The only issue is that you need to be nearby where other people play or have many friends who play in order to complete raids. There is no way to remotely connect or invite random people, so most of the time that feature of the game is not possible for me to use. I enjoy catching my little pokemon friends and I have had a great experience otherwise with this app.

This game is awesome, but there are a few issues. For example, I can't install the recent update, but it may be because of my phone and not the app. Also, I NEED Sylveon in the app! She is my favorite pokemon and the only Eeveelution not in the game! Finally, I would like to be able to talk with your friends or with people you battle with. Great game otherwise!

Just rejoined after deleting it two years ago and there have been a lot of upgrades! More Poke Stops and gyms, which is nice. However, the two-star rating is for the distance tracker and Adventure Sync. If the main point of this game is motivate people moving, then the trackers shouldn't be as off as they are. We walked at least a mile last night with the Adventure Sync on and full battery use, yet nothing was tracked in the game. Even checked this morning to see no progress added.

This game was everything I have hoped for since I was a child. My wife and I would go for regular walks because the adventurer in us was given tools of the hunt. Namely a decent tracking feature with the foot prints. It was fun hunting them down with that as our guide. Now there is... whatever this is. I rarely see people out wandering about. And neither my wife or I even bother to open the game. I miss what it was and could still be.

I originally left a 5 star review, but recent changes in the game took away features that made the game more enjoyable. Also increasing prices for events that are lackluster and not releasing details of "boosted" rates has been misleading and poorly executed. Niantic created a supposed task force to listen to their players but that was quickly taken away and the game is headed in the wrong direction. I have played since the games launch as well.

Game has improved slightly over the past 4 years. However many glitches still occur regarding location tracking as well as team rocket balloons not showing up/glitching out during its 6 hour window. Also, add detail to pokemon stats,IV, info on catch rates, etc rather than have other people try and figure out the faulty and lacking interface/details of the game.

I mean i like this game in that I can use it when Im running. The only issue that its game mechanics are lack luster.For example the battles are lame in that you repeaditly click instead turn base such as the game. Other issues I have is the money grab. I have been waiting a long time for the Mega evelutions to start but they ended up ignoring what players wanted and gave a lack luster update. In the end I will still play but it could have been much better.

Editing this as the game has taken a bit of a dive. With a dwindling player base, Niantic still insists players team up to do every single event. Raids of 4* or higher are basically locked out since all gameplay is solo these days. Too many buy in events, and the actual "updates" to catchable roster makes this thing feel pretty dead in the water. I've been playing for about 5 years off and on, and the game feels 10x as cash-grabby as it did when I began.

I hadn't played in a while so I figured I'd download it again. Now I remember why I stopped playing to begin with. Simple things like potions, which used to spawn with a frequency that made the game playable, are so uncommon now it's practically unplayable. I genuinely used to love playing Pokemon go, but now it's nothing more than a cash grab scheme designed to nickel and dime it's players in hopes of any kind of progression. Oh, and $15 for community day? Get wrecked.

Game was okay when it came out, but as time went on it got some better updates and some worse. Overall, the game suffers from a greed problem, with nearly every feature having a paid service to make it "better," and prices are increasing. Don't get invested into this game unless you have a lot of free time and travel a lot, or have excess money you feel like wasting.

this game has SO SO SO many bugs. i lost out on a ton of exp because their in game item the "lucky egg" decided to bug out and not let me use it. if you click on gyms to fast, the game will just cease to work. i am not recieving coins from gyms i defend. i really want to like this game, but it is frustrating when these problems, and so many more, are not being addressed. the game is 2 years old now and still has day 1 issues.

Used to be a great game. And while there were always extras you could buy, the game was still mostly free. But it's gotten less & less so. There's some pokemon you just can't get unless you buy a ticket for it. Having major glitches seems to be a weekly thing now. I just bought a whole bunch of coins right before the announcement, but when they are used up, I think I will leave the game. Maybe these coins will last me until my 7 year anniversary.

I personally enjoy this game quite a bit but the with all the technical difficulties that I have to deal with on a regular basis it only gets four stars. the GPS tracking sometimes screws up and other times Wi-Fi completely jacks its ability to understand where it is. otherwise the games pretty fun, sucks to play out in rural areas it's more of an in-town kind of game, no pokestops no balls no fun.

EDIT: I've since started playing again and with the addition of trainer battles and trades, rocket stops, and buddy Pokemon, the game has vastly improved. I'd still like to see some updates to reduce bugs and make the overall user experience a bit smoother, but it's definitely better than it used to be. This game is arguably the most overhyped and underwhelming game I've downloaded. It promises a Pokémon adventure, yet it has nothing that made the Pokémon games great.

Fun game, when it works. Sign in inexplicably stopped working yesterday, sent an email to them, was sent to a stock troubleshooting page, worked my way down the list without result until i got to "delete and reinstall the app". I deleted it, and the download has been "pending" for about 24 hours now. I'm pretty fed up with this. I've spent a lot of time and money on this game, but it seems like its no longer possible to play it.

I've spent a considerable amount of money on cosmetics in this game because I've always been a fan of making my characters look cute in videos games. And now every single item I purchased is essentially ruined. There's no cute left. Everything looks cursed. Ape like. And also like there's diapers under everything. It's so bad. This game has had so many changes that players weren't happy with. This avatar update is just the tip of the iceberg. Stay away. Don't bother. It's not worth it.

I used to love playing this game but stopped playing because I couldn't rationalize getting my young son out in crazy temperatures. I was able to start playing again when they made changes to the stop radius. But now it's very disappointing that Niantic changed it back in the middle of a pandemic and won't be able to play again. Do better Niantic.

Trying to keep this short. I've been on here 3 yrs, & I've noticed that the game is more $ hungry than when it was released. The items from poke stops aren't that great, and I don't have the option to buy regular(only max) items like revives or potions.. I do have a suggestion for this game though. Berry Planters. Just like you guys introduced in Ruby/Sapphire. You can pick them 24 hours later and replant if you'd like but to keep the game challenging, space them out. 😊

Game is ok. They focus too much on trying to make money and less on what the player base would like to have. Also increasing the price of an already fictional item that doesn't actually have value is a garbage move. If you want to be better people try instead to create a new item that has value that people would be willing to buy rather than raising prices. Never will play again.

Won't work one Google Pixel. Was able to set up my account but as soon as I was required to catch a Pokemon, I wasn't able. GPS error even with my location turned on, restarting the app, and the device. Worked fine on my old iPhone. Really disappointed because I would have loved to keep playing. Edit: It has worked for the past couple months!

I gotta say I love this game. the visuals are stunning, the Pokémon are amazing, but some of the mechanics are wonky. the tracker that tracks how far you've walked could use some work, especially with the eggs, and they only limited the Pokémon to being able to use two moves, a base move and then a special move. the worst part of that is that you can't keep moves and still learn new ones at the same time.

I liked the original Pokémon tracker with the footprints and pings, even with those aspects helping the player it was still hard to find Pokémon, but it wasn't hard enough to make it not fun. Now it's close to impossible to find a Pokémon you have your eye on. I don't like the no footprints idea. Also with the new update it takes forever for Pokéstops and gyms to load after opening the game and seeing the map. When they do finally pop up I can't even collect my rewards. Needs work.

I started out playing this game with high hopes, as a Pokemon fan from the beginning. After nearly a year I dropped it due to lack of non-bug-related updates. I'm very glad I picked it up again a couple of years later. There are now an abundance of Pokemon and more are released on a regular basis. The addition of quests that allow you to add myths and raids for legends only increases the fun. The downsides;. Heavily biased to cities/ downtown, can get laggy.

Lots of fun searching for pokemon. Still in its early stages so some bugs that need worked out. So much potential to become an amazing game. Update: after nearly 3 years of playing the game has gone stale for me. Gym system is now garbage (use to be my favorite part) raids are bland, events are ok and new pokemon released are getting harder to find outside of events. Niantic does nothing to keep long term players interested in this game.

I have played this game for years and put so much time and effort into it. Shinies, legenderies, 3 star, and 4 star stat pokemon. This new updated however, has made me decide to transfer my pokemon to home and uninstall the app if the character design change is not made optional. There was absolutely no reason to force this change on everyone. It's sad when some of the Pokemon have more curvs than you. Let us be able to choose to keep our old avitars or be able to edit with the new style.

Been playing for years now and while I still love the game, all the quality of life changes made during covid were so helpful for people like myself who lived in areas it wasn't safe to walk but I have to take away a few points due to them undoing them. Not to mention some of the missions are getting way to hard for people in areas with no gyms to complete which only furthers the need for more ease of access to raids/pokestops.

The game appears to have a very simple architecture so it should run fairly smoothly on newer devices, & In concept the game is enjoyable. On the few times that it works for more than 15 minutes it's fun. But this game crashes more than any game I've ever tried to play. So you finally catch that Pokemon you've been looking for you give it raspberries and use 5 Ultra Balls, then your game freezes and when you turn back on the Pokemon is gone never reappears and all of your balls are gone.

The first couple of days of the game, worked like a charm. Then the after the servers crashed all hell broke loose. The GPS won't work except for 10 seconds if I'm lucky. Edit!!! Game works much better now. I can catch pokemon, it reads my steps, do battles and trades. Fight in Gym and Raids. The only downside is sometimes it randomly exits the game but doesn't happen all that much.

Awesome game love it! Play it EVERY day! Took a star away for each of two reasons: 1) the 50 coin per day max is totally a rip off! If you put mons in gyms you should be entitled to the coins, regardless of if they all return the same day or not. 2) the "online" friends list is never working properly. You still end up having to scan your friends list to find online players because it doesn't correctly sort them all to the top of the list as it should. Should even be able to do it in real-time.

I wish I could give it 5 stars but I can't. I like the game very much. Recently downloaded it again and I am very disappointed. It won't track the fitness portion of it, so I cannot hatch any incubated eggs. Meaning I can't gain any distance towards collecting a candy from my buddy. Also, I was trying to figure out the friends portion of the app but it just keeps saying an error occurred and went even let me attempt to add a friend. Very disappointed. Fix these issues!

As of 1/2020 after not playing for a year, the game improved considerably. New areas, evolution stones, trainer battling, trading, best friends, research, and buddy walking has made the game much more involved and enjoyable. There are still issues with raids most recently, during gofest 2021, the game froze while trying to catch one of the legendary Pokemon. The event was disappointing, but it was a great way to build up stardust.

Since the update I can't can't use properly cause the GPS keeps moving me to areas that I'm not in. It keeps jumping from scene to scene without me being there. Bug needs to be fixed. Also this app keeps saying GPS not found. I have tried everything! Now that you have added the trainer vs trainer battles the game frequently freezes! How do you add something but it makes it worse!

Played since the first week of launch. Can no longer tolerate the constant added features, which comes with constant bugs. Niantic does not deserve the investment they require in the game. No longer simple, no longer fun. I can not imagine being a new player and not being utterly annoyed and overwhelmed. Garbage experience if you live in Arizona. So many landmarks on the map, can't even tap on wild pokemon, polluted.

From great to garbage. Whatever this new update is, I am sure it is terrific, but I can no longer play the game. The game starts to load, then crashes. Several attempts at proper tech support have yielded nothing. I cannot load into the game to ask from there, so all of my time and effort playing was for nothing. Deleting the app. Cheers Niantic, on making a once wonderful game deletable.

Right now the game doesn't function properly on a Pixel 4 XL running Android 11. There's something wrong with the camera functionality in the game, for example if you go to take a snapshot of your buddy you won't get a heart for it. In addition, the game doesn't show you the photos you've taken after taking where (where photobombs occur.) have made sure that the game has all the permission access for my camera and eve

8/7/16: Someone at Niantic needs to blow into the cartridge. If you enjoy watching a Pokeball spin indefinitely, and feel that you don't see the word "Error" often enough, this game is for you. Otherwise, you'd be better off throwing real balls at real birds. Edit: Most of the aforementioned bugs have been resolved, but the gameplay experience is still very much dependent on where you live. If you have a gym next door, you're going to have a much better time than someone who doesn't.

The game is always fun and engaging when I play it, and I tend to play it anytime there's something new, but I don't usually play it consistently for an extended period of time. I live in a place where finding more than one PokéStop usually requires an amount of walking that feels more excessive than it's worth. I do tend to drive by many PokéStops and Gyms, but I can rarely participate in any new events because it's just too inconvenient to be there for them

I really love the game. I do. But having to click this stupid "You're moving too fast" button every five minutes while im riding with my parents, is just ridiculously irritating. I live in a mostly unsafe area, and not being able to pick up pokestops while im riding in a car is ridiculous. There are loads of people that are completely incapable of playing properly because they cant walk at glacial shift speed to pick up each one. People will ALWAYS play while driving. Stop hindering gameplay.

I honestly was hoping to fall in love with this app but it is constantly crashing. It doesn't keep track of the distance I have traveled just to hatch an egg. I catch a Pokémon and all the sudden it crashes and the Pokémon is gone along with the Pokéball. This is just a couple of the issues I have came across out of the 9 I have written down. I will revise my review once the app is fixed or if it gets fixed before I move on and forget about it. Much better than it was!

Gameplay has improved. Newer features are nice but attention span seems to be shortlived. What happens when you run out of Pokémon to introduce? Still several years down the line, at which point in sure a new game will be introduced. Gym mechanics still sketchy, however raids help promote multiplayer. Sad that there is no room in the meta for lower stat mons. I left awhile back. Periodically jump on here and there, but would not call myself the full-time player I used to be.

Pros: it's addictive and fun. Cons: errors. No reimbursement when error out of gym raids even if I used my premium pass. Still waiting to hear back from Niantic from the first time this happened to me and I submitted a complaint over a month ago. They don't take their customers seriously and they never reimburse when they are at fault. I will edit this review as I see fit.

I love Pokemon GO. The ability to catch pokemon in AR is amazing, I had started playing years ago but stopped. My husband got me back into it during Covid and it was AMAZING! All of the changes made playing easier for me after just having a baby and myself not being able to go out in the heat often. But now they reversed the changes and I can't play anymore...I can't leave my house to play...so it was a good game, but I can't recommend it anymore.

Fantastic game and I absolutely love playing it. It's given me a good reason to go out and see new places in my hometown, and its nostalgic feeling like a real life Pokemon trainer lol. Wish they would do some work on improving the frame rate of the game and glitchy behavior when things get busy but at the same time its sort of expected. I wish incences were a little more effective and if anything could be multiplied by nearby people using them as well if you're friends. Keep it up though!!(:

Game concept is good and addictive, but lot of times unable to connect due to insufficient servers for the number of people playing. GPS is glitchy, can be off by up to a mile or more at times, can be sitting right on top of a pokecenter or gym and it tells me to far away. Not enough new content, takes way to long ro add new and updated content to keep players interested.

It used to be a good game. Now, the prices have literally doubled for in-game purchases, which legitimately make the game almost unplayable and not enjoyable anymore. At the same time, the content in the game has become very lackluster, uneventful, unrewarding, and very boring. The overall experience from this game is pretty much ruined now since it requires players to rely on buying newly overpriced ingame items to even try to manage to get together and succeed in what the developers intended.

Honestly fixed a lot of problems thanks to covid, easier to get pokestops and gyms with a bit of a wider range. Only issues I have with it now are trading being a little too expensive, but thats more of a personal problem. I also don't really understand the latency on trainer battles regarding charged attacks, some battles I feel like I should have won. I enjoy collecting pokemon.

After a long break, I decided to pick this up again after seeing emails telling me to come back and offering me some codes. However when I went to log in, it appears that my account got deleted and it's been completely removed from all my friends' lists as well. Despite me showing screenshots of my player nickname and those emails they sent to me, they have done absolutely nothing and are pretending like the account never existed. Horrible experience. Save yourself the trouble.

I really enjoy the game, I play a lot with friends. BUT, theres so many bugs and lags ALL the time. Specially during special events. One time went out with friends to catch Moltres and none of them were able to login in the game.everybody getting error messages. I would give 5 stars if the game. Loaded more smooth.

I literally love this game and have played it consistently since 2016. Unfortunately, it turns out you can accidentally transfer Cosmog, making it so that you can't complete all the quests without Cosmog and you only ever get one in the game (and yet it's transferable?? A required Pokemon that you will NEVER see again is transferrable). I was told I might as well delete the game after that mistake, so I reached out to support. Turns out I might as well delete the game -_- real waste of 7 years.

An amazing misuse of a major property, the game grew leaps and bounds until fairly recently, when the management decided to put selling user data at the forefront, at the expense of the player base. Great accessibility features have been rolled back. Expect the bare minimum from events, and very bad deals in the in game store, designed to "get you outside" so they can sell your location data.

I really liked this game when I first started playing it. It's fun, gets you out of the house, and is a great way to meet new people but the glitchiness and constant freezing have me fed up. I hate when I catch a good pokemon the game freezes so I lose poke balls and don't even get to keep the monster. Nintendo and the other company need to get on top of this ASAP at least give us the pokeballs we lose and the monsters we've caught. Not playing it till it gets fixed.

I've been playing since 2016 and the game was a childhood dream come true for me when it first launched. Unfortunately Niantic seems to be bent on sabotaging themselves and is limiting the game to essentially able-bodied, driving urban players (and bonus points if they have money to burn). As a non-driving student living in a dangerous city, making progress in this game is incredibly difficult, and participating in events is even more so. Seeing this game go downhill the way is has is very sad.

Updated review. I wish I could give Niantic 0 stars. This game just keeps getting worse. It started as a beautiful thing, peeked in 2020, and then the downhill began. Everything from awful price hikes on beloved items, to the addition of campfire, to new character models that look horrendous. Niantic just does not care about its player base. Used to play every day, now I log in every couple of months just to be further disappointed. Don't get sucked in.

Have played off and on since launch. Don't have much free time to play the way they want you to play, and it feels like I accomplish less and less with what time I do spend on game. I'm in the suburbs of a major city, so the lack of spawns and gyms is disappointing. At some point in the last year, the game now demands I relogin every time I launch the game. Overall, the game is a disappointment, both as a Pokemon game, and as a mobile game.

Laggy, buggy, constant glitches, if this game was not inclusive of a franchise as beloved as pokemon it would have died years ago. I play it regularly, in large part to the friendships made in the community, it's a collaborative game when you think of it that way. But given the revenue it brings in it's embarrassing for a game to be so horribly constructed. 10/9/20 update: still trash. took a break playing for a bit and have tried playing again. Still experiencing harsh lag, do not recommend.

Game is fun, but you really need to play with a group. It is more fun that way and raids are easier. I do think things in the store cost a bit much, a dollar for one raid pass is a little steep to me. I really liked being able to enjoy raids at more distance. It connected me with friends who live farther away. I wish you would bring the distance back and listen to your players. If you don't then I will likely uninstall.

Overall the game is fun so long as you have poke balls and people to play with. That being said the games GPS and it's tracking sometimes fail, and don't track well. As of this last update I haven't been able to log on and the teams support on the subject is null. And I've looked to see if anyone else was having the issue or had a solution and come up with nothing I haven't already tried.

Well I have a much better phone now to be able to run this properly so I should update my review for this again (hopefully it'll be the last time as well). The GO Battle League is still pretty bad even with my new phone, same problems and all. Most of the self-isolation stuff has been gone for awhile but some of it's still there. The game does freeze while loading and I thought it was because I installed an SD Card in there but it's been the case since the beginning. 3/5 still

This game is a fun way to enjoy the Pokemon franchise in your daily life without getting all involved in a console game you may not always have time for. But the game is heavily biased in that it's easier to play the closer you are to city-like places. People who live hours away who want to enjoy the game have to rely on in-app purchases, and when the prices of store items that are depended on rise, then the game is more pay to play for a party of people who are at an unfair advantage already.

Love catching Pokémon, but the battle system is TERRIBLE. Connection issues are poor regardless of where I am, whether I'm using WiFi or data, doesn't even matter if I use a different device. Connectivity is almost always poor. I'll lose a battle that's super even all because the game will lag and won't register me tapping the special attack, even if I hit it TEN TIMES IN A ROW. Very frustrating to be beaten in a dishonorable way.

I love this game, but there are a few things I'd love to be added and/or fixed. I would like more organization with the Pokemon Box. Somewhat like PC Boxes in the core games. Box 1, Box 2, etc. I would also appreciate the ability to sort my pokemon by type as well. If either of those are possible, it would be greatly appreciated by many. thank you!

I used to love it but now. It just seems they just want your money and not actually care about issues. I did the recent event feeling like I was going to get more shinies other than a ditto and a mew. I feel let down and couldn't complete the timed research because like a real person I had to work. So I decided I'm not going to play for a month or the rest of the year. I was going to stop playing once I finished at level 40 anyways. I already caught them all before I started playing game.

I love Pokémon and I think this game was fun, but server issues and a few glitches kept it from being perfect. Then they shut the tracking system down and still haven't even bothered to fix the original bugs. Basically, the only way to catch a Pokémon is to wander around aimlessly until your phone vibrates. With the most recent update, the game has pretty much become a glorified pedometer.

The new update to the player characters is just bad to look at. While the old models didn't have the same customization options, I see no reason why they had to be completely scrapped rather than expanded upon. Beyond the wierdly realistic/detailed features and the unappealing and derpy looking faces, the new models just don't look good. They don't even carry the same artstyle as the rest of the human characters, making their appearance much more of an eyesore.

You finally confirmed in your policy update that you're crawling through our phones & gathering a list of installed apps. You claim it's to prevent cheating which is possible, but I don't recall being prompted to allow you to do this. It's an invasion of my device & privacy. You need to be more open about what data you're downloading from our phones. Why does PoGo freeze any time I connect or disconnect a Bluetooth headset? It happens with everyone I own. Are you parsing external devices too?

The games ok but there hasnt been much in the way of beefing up the game to keep up with the times. Eggs are hatched based on distance. It bothers me they havent given the option to connect to a Fitbit or a fitness tracker. Since they're all the rage it would definately get more people into the game. Not to mention I walk a lot during the day but my phone is not on me all the time running the app. My Fitbit tracks all of it without my phone being on me. It's an idea

Been playing since 2016 and they've recently decided on changing the range of pokestops to a reduced range. Niantic wants people to go out and explore the world but since the range of stops are reduced, it's hard to go to some areas without trespassing. Also, there are many times where the pokestops are across the street. Before this change, I was able to reach it without causing danger to myself from having to go across the lanes.

Lots of fun! very addictive! i love that team rocket has joined the game!!! I wish we could trade with friends without having to sit right next to them. I'll be moving soon and won't be able to trade pokemon with friends that I leave behind. It would also be nice if we could trade items instead of deleting ones we dont need. It seems really wasteful.

It would of been nice if we had a heads up on that Trainer level 40. All they said was by the end of this year. I started Go in '18, and not in' 16. I had ran out of balls very fast. I didn't know there were free daily items in the store. I can only play this game so far from my apartment. I'm very close to level 28, On Tuesday 10 Nov. '20 the level was 40. Two days later it dropped to level 33 which is 7 levels. Now it's two more days later 14 Nov.' 20 so it should of dropped to level 26!

Raising the star level, was playing the game when it first came out and plagued with issues. Majority of those issues have been resolved and the game is much better. There is now a lot more to do, trading, team rocket battles, raiding, etc. The problem i have now is the RNG. It just feels that the RNG is not in my favor so i feel like i am missing out on some of the rare stuff.

Made it to level 46 and they severely reduced the remote raids and are increasing the costs dramatically!!! They want us to walk the earth recording all the data we see, streets, landmarks, buildings, etc so they can sell it to whomever and when we choose to play from home because of weather, health issues etc they think they can force us back out!!! No thanks!! Was fun for awhile!

Overall, my favorite mobile game. As a long-time Pokémon fan, the catching and exploration are like a dream come true. If you enjoy Pokémon, you will probably like this game. But I still can't give 5 stars because the PvP sucks. The battles feel dumb. Instead of the thoughtful strategy of the original games, we get two (maybe three) moves per mon and a lot of tapping. It's boring and repetitive. At least the rest of the game is good.

I'm very frustrated with this slow nerfing of the players experience. The changes over the years are just making it more and more difficult for regular players to enjoy the game. I also find the menus to be laborious. Once you catch a Pokemon for example you have to click so many times to appraise and tag or transfer it. This process should be much more streamlined.

Been playing off and on since launch. By and large I think the changes they've made have been solid, but some are just too glaring to ignore anymore. Slow to release updates (new pokemon specifically), continued stripping back of well-loved features (remote raids, breakthrough research), and circling the drain with the same few ideas has really been killing the game. Can't say its worth playing like it use to be.

Edited 1/27/2021 The addition of events, battle league, trading, and "research" have added so much life to this game. I'm surprised how much we still enjoy it after so long! Took away 1 star for the frustrating connectivity issues, inability to play in all "CP" leagues as a casual player, and hackers(?) making league a frustrating experience.

I love this game to an extent. It's great when it works, but the servers go 
down all too often, namely when I've been in gym battles. And if you're 
looking to battle friends, move along. Fix the servers and give me an 
update and maybe you can get 4-5 stars. Update: congrats you made the 
servers better and made the tracking worse. I wish I could rate lower than 
1 star

Released a game that isn't close to completion or first advertised. Update so that all users can't use. Update: 6-27-2020, I enjoy it more than when it first came out but they seemed to have reduced the spawn rate to zero in the majority of areas. Some places in town have a normal rate while walking, while others one street over have absolutely none. I don't understand what you label as a spawnable place.

Hoping you'll fix the tracker. I've argued that this is so new, there will be bugs since it came out, but while I understand the servers are overloaded, they have been since day 1. Even with the 3 step bug, you had an idea of where to go. Living in a rural area with now no idea where to go, it leaves us with only the option of having to hang around a lured Pokestop. Essentially folks like us will have to pay to play. Not fun :( Will edit when/if this is fixed.

I love this game, and I've been playing it pretty consistently since it came out. I wish there was an easier way to get coins besides spending money I don't have. The cap on what you can make in gyms and the fact that you just throw supplies away is very limiting. It would be cool to be able to sell your items, or when you vullaby's been in a gym for nearly a month without you being able to remove it it would be cool to get more than 50 coins. Seems kind of unreasonable.

I have played since the game started in 2016. I set it down for a time because it wasn't what was promised. After updates and bugs worked out I started again! What fun! Everyday! My husband and I both! The kids! The grandkids! However. We live a ways away from each other and the remote raids were our go to for playing together. Now we are limited and can no longer do this. Not to mention the EXTREME BUGS and game loading errors. After thousands spent I think we will all have to say good day.

its a great game, but is virtually unplayable in most of my area of the US, outside big cities because it requires (relatively fast) mobile connection/internet, assuming there even is one. The infrastructure simply isnt there. The places I can play are far and few between, and the pokemon variety still isnt very great despite multiple updates. Gyms etc are very spread out and the most random places are marked as Pokestops. Will continue playing when ppl like us get a better experience.

I spent money on clothes to make my character look fit and pretty. With the new model change, I can't get my character to look nearly as good in them as she used to. I honestly feel like I've been cheated out of my money. I don't understand why the old bodies couldn't be included in the options. Character appearance is extremrly important to me, so I hope you'll add more options to body type, including the old styles. Until then, I've deleted the app.

At first the game was a blast, even with having to deal with all the server issues. Now, however, with the inability to track pokemon, the developers complete lack of communication and their apparent inability to properly document changes to the game, and the stealth removal of even more features of the games it just isn't worth playing, or trustin Niantic for that matter. It really is a shame, the game had so much potential...

Great game. Hard to play when you're stuck in home quarentine due to spawns in rural areas being extremely low. Has some interface issues. Crashes on low end devices. Semifrequent glitches or quirks which render the game hard if not impossible to play. Items are costly if you lack local stops, gyms, or events. Near impossible to request new stops. Trading and battling is subject to lag which is sometimes extreme. No way to chat with other players internally, not even with canned responses.

Awesome game, you guys have really added so much since it first came out. I still think the heights and weights need to be more realisitc (I have a Nidoking that only weighs 40 lbs???) And I think we would all love to see "boxes" created much like the PCs from the games so we can organize Pokemon we want to keep in our main party, and then move ones we want to trade or keep in storage to a different one.

I initially had a 5 star review for the game, it was buggy and unoptimized when it released, I've been playing since day one. While it has come a long way in performance, the monetization aspect is a deterrent. With the price of remote raids going up, it makes the game more restrictive. While the purpose of the game is "Go" the ability to remote raid reasonably made the game more accessible to those who cannot go out/other limitations. Very few new features/pkmn added to rationalize daily play.

The option to edit your avatar and maybe even your name should be present without emailing support and the in game purchases need work. I bought coins, used them and never got the items but the coins were used and I was still charged. Overall a great game I love playing, but the servers need work and I wish you could get more options for your avatar and edit it in game rather than only at the beginning.

That game used to be genuinely fun, now I spend more time having to update my app just to open it to maybe have a chance to play it, and that's if it doesn't freeze up. I've lost countless remote raid passes from being able to join and sit in the lobby to be booted out and unable to get back in to battle. And pitting lures at the stops doesn't work half the time because nothing pops up. The lures have the opposite affect and stop things from spawning. This is really frustrating at this point.

Nothing good came from this new update. The game as a whole takes noticeably longer to load and has started to add strain to my battery. If this was for a good reason; I would understand, but it's not. It's a new map, and "lil' Debbie" character models that look just awkward in every way. I'm considering wasting coins on a mask to avoid my character models chunky little face in the corner. The pokemon models are starting to look just as awkward in both of their new backgrounds to boot.

I've been playing the game since launch. I want to keep loving this game. Unfortunately, it's gone tremendously downhill. I still play, but I've switched to an entirely passive style. Space is limited so I can't be super detailed here but the increased monetization of every single little thing has killed the raid scene and events aren't worthwhile as a F2P player anymore. Every event has some bug. The "sale" prices are a lie, they've been artificially inflated and then slashed. It's sad to see.

Ok, so it has been a few years since my last review and I'll admit the game has got slightly better, the soundtrack is now set to loop and there are far more encounters to help collect candies to level up, thumbs up on that. However wild pokemon battles are still non existent and it is for this reason I can only give 2 stars. Come on Niantic fix this already.

Long time fan of the main series of pokemon all together. I enjoy this game but after the pokeball well gets dry you can lose interest in the game. The way the game is designed just doesn't seem to grab me like the main series. The giveaways and events are neat but they're just that "neat" to get some more foot traffic for more microtransactions. My opinion has shifted as time went on but I see this as a cute side game I just muddle around in.

Honestly the game has gone down hill the past few years. I've been playing since the beginning and the game has really lost its touch. The game crashes a ton, and the way they release new Pokemon is so random and has left many Pokedexs incomplete due to it. The game when it initially came out, though a lot of server issues, was great. Super addictive and a childhood dream. However, with each update, the game continues to get worse and worse. Don't bother installing. You can't hardly do anything anymore anyway with the increased rates of Pokemon running away and the increased difficulty in catching pokemon. Everything they do, they do wrong.

I liked the idea, just the constant adds, changes, and going back on the pandemic things makes me not want to go out and explore the world anymore. Other than all the complients about the 3 step being taking off (with or without it, doesnt make a difference if it doesnt work) the radar is sometimes inaccurate. Well the game itself is funny and I would give 5 stars, BUT without tracking it is not the same. On a Galaxy S5 you can literally watch the battery drain! 20% in under 20 minutes. Honest review 1. The game is very pay to win, unless you plan on walking for hours to get some pokeballs you might wanna spend some money. 2. The game has a great concept, it's a good way to help motivate people to exercise while having fun. 3. The game is most difficult in rural areas. There will be fewer places to get items, less gyms, raids, ETC. 4. The game is incredibly easy at the start but gets much more difficult as you progress. Pokestops are mandatory to visit if you want a chance.

It makes no sense that pokemon spawn way more often in large cities than in rural areas. Also there are very few pokestops in rural areas so it is much more difficult for people who do not live in large cities. Also when you defeat a gym someone else who did nothing to help defeat it can just take it for themselves. The game is also still a bit buggy. If these issues get fixed I will update my review. Update: it got better. Not great, but better

I abandoned the game like many did 2 months into its initial release but came back during the anniversary event in 2018. Surprisingly the game is now at an enjoyable level with actual stuff to do, raiding with groups, trading with friends, and/or battling strangers. I gave this game a 2 star review at launch because it was an incomplete grind. Now though in 2019 it's a pretty good ARG. Go trade, battle, and explore. Whole communities have formed to make raiding and playing easier, just search.

The gameplay is super shallow considering how cluttered and labyrinthine the UI is. And yet still it always seems like the information you need isn't made available when you need it. For example, let's say you want to trade some Pokemon with me. This costs a currency called stardust. How much do you have? You gotta cancel the trade to go check. How much do you need? Unknown and, depending on how much you have, potentially unknowable. It's a mess.

Update 3.9.24 Game won't load. The phone says there's a bug. I have a lot of problems with getting randomly kicked out after hours or days of solid gameplay and all of the sudden an error message that tells me my login cant be authenticated. The games servers are lacking. As usual Nintendo has under estimated the amount of people that are going to try to play. Also GPS location doesnt work very well. Half the time it says my GPS isn't working when it is. Samsung Galaxy S6 Btw. My biggest complaint is that it gets boring. I came back to the game hoping to enjoy it. I love all the updates yet the GPS STILL doesn't work. I have all the specs and meet the requirements and the GPS will crash on me repeatedly. Would be nice to be able to play the game without restrictions. Please fix the lags that are happening since the latest update. The app continually crashes, freezes, lags, and is generally unstable since the biomes were released. Here are my issues. 1. I have had this game since day 1 and it has gone through some demo, but overall I am very happy with how the game turned out. Having originally thought it crashed way too much, I only gave a 2 star rating. Thank you for this game niantic team. Everything is a grind, many people use GPS spoofing and the handful of fun activities that exist have few rewards, all of which are entirely luck based. Unless of course, you want to spend cash. The game is dead. In its final stages its doing everything it can to take advantage of the handful of players left. If you're thinking about trying it again, don't bother. Everyone is years ahead of you anyway.

For a major game it is very unreliable. Starting the game often freezes, sometimes it recovers, other times you have to kill and retry. Several times a day it will hang, especially if you are busy, and even more so when coverage is less than perfect. It seems like they have a very poor retry scheme and no hardening against network issues. The game has less features than when it started out, and we can't even track Pokémon the way we're supposed to. Not even a little bit like the trailer. Not enough of anything in rural areas. I live 15+ miles from the nearest town, it's not fair that cities have the easiest time playing the game. Please do something about this. NIANTIC removed the tracking system years ago and has never fully implemented it back. Don't get me wrong, I still love the game. it's just not nearly as fun when i have to walk around aimlessly trying to catch them all. I'm not sure why Niantic is removing features, unless it's a server issue, but even then, it's not like they don't have the profit to get some better servers instead of removing features.

For the past week or so the tracker has also been bugged. Every nearby pokemon is always 3 steps away and never changes. Please fix this as its not letting me track down specific nearby pokemon. It seems that the server is more stable now. Have very few disconnects. Keep up the good work and I'll bump up those stars.

As of now in late 2019, the game has content. Tons of it. But the amount of cash grabs and poor decisions Niantic has made in the past few months alone warrants a lower rating. The base game is great, and a good way to go out and meet people and do things. But locking content behind paywalls and making raids unbeatable with less than 10 people seems like a step in the wrong direction. If you pick it up now DO NOT give Niantic any of your money, speak with your wallets ladies and gentlemen.

I've loved Pokemon for so long, and same with this app. It makes me upset though, that there are constant crashes while playing the game. There is also a lot of lag, meaning when battling other players its hard to actually win which is not fair at all. This also goes for catching Pokemon in the wild, some of them flee because of bad throws caused by lag itself. If Niantic understands, please try to fix the lag. This game is great and I would hate to uninstall it.

The new character update is trash. The "battle" system is atrocious with its latency and just isn't fun to begin with. If you're just looking to get Pokemon to transfer into mainline games, it's good for that. Beyond that it's just an insane money grab. You can't even get rid of eggs without hatching them with paid items, and with the recent pools there hasn't really been anything worth the effort or cost to hatch. Stop trying to push the newest starters. Nobody likes them.

I used to really really love this app and game, it was a fun way to get outside and experience Pokemon in a new way with friends. Lately though I started playing again and it's become more of a money grab than anything else. Coins to purchase items and items themselves in the shop are seriously overpriced. You're limited in what you can do without going through a paywall. Raids (only one free daily), appearance items, lures, etc. are premium items now you have to pay for with real money.

Terrible app. Every single time one of the kids wants to play, we have to enter the username and password. Then, the app tells us our username and password are incorrect . Have to sign up as a new player EVERY SINGLE TIME they want to play. This means they can never save their progress. Tired of the frustration for a stupid game. Uninstalled. Forever.

I've been playing since it came out, I did take a break from it for almost a year because I was having issues acquiring pokeballs. They have since fixed this.. Some of the more recent updates have been great but have issues, the battling freezes or lags causing some frustration. The remote raiding has been great. I do wish you had more time to join after getting an invite, i have missed out on some raids due to this. Also had it freeze battling raid bosses and missed out on the shadow pokemon

I'm personally enjoying Pokemon Go, it's made me actually step outside more. I'm also adding another star because in 2019, they've started to give us more single-player content! The problem is, the app doesn't work unless your screen is permanently on or you buy a pricey peripheral. Plus, the game only really works best in urban or suburban areas; rural players will have very little to do.

Don't get me wrong, I absolutely adore this game and it gives me a good reason to go outside, but it's hard to find Pokémon when the footprint feature doesn't work. The footprints are supposed to increase and decrease depending on how far or close you are to a Pokemon. It works fine on iPhone but not for Andriod, I hope this feature is fixed soon. It's really the only thing wrong with the game, everything else is absolutely wonderful.

Recently, the game has gotten worse. GBL is unplayable, as it keeps giving the Weak Connection message. Yet my opponent is able to attack me perfectly fine. Doesnt matter what wifi I'm connected to, it's still unplayable. I even have issues logging into my game. It doesnt let me go in the game connected to my wifi, I have to always turn off my wifi just so the game can load. This game needs to be fixed asap. I know others are having the same exact issues, so I hope niantic provides some update.

This game is fun, it encourages you to get out and walk and explore new places. If you have played a pokemon game you will have fun with this. It has problems, the tracking is still spotty, and it drains batteries like crazy. The research is nice, it gives you a reason to log in every day and chances at legendary pokemon, the raiding is fun if you can find a group. Give it a try.

Update: I give up. It's not worth the 20-minute fight to log in every 4 days. SHAME on the devs for ruining a cute game. The constant forced updates are HORRIBLE! I just want to play for a few minutes while walking to the train, but NOOOOOOO. Each update logs me out and I can't reset my password until I have a wired connection. So even tho I love this game, I rarely play it.

Very fun game, been playing it since launch. I'm disappointed that the performance hasn't gotten any better. Please add a toggle to enable a high performance mode so we can play 60 fps on a 60hz display. The Harry Potter AR game runs at full speed, why can't Pokemon Go?

So worth the occasional minor glitch. Even after all this time, I still pull it up weekly and have paid into a little bit of the extra-but-definitely-not-mandatory paid items. The game has changed a lot since its debut in 2016. Some changes are welcome like the peer to peer battle. Although it should have been an option from the start, its finally here. The poke tracker is finally in working order and I like the way they done it as the pokemon are easier to find rather than wandering around aimlessly like before. More to come after I use more with recent updates.

Update: Increased prices, decreases item effectiveness, and no remote trades are why I've given up on this game and uninstalled at level 43. new character models (as of 4/19/2024) are actually bad. Good but could be great. Niantic doesn't like to keep quality of life improvements. I've uninstalled the game after playing for years. Such a grind of a game that encourages you to pay money to make life easier. Some challenges can not be done unless you get lucky and raid with some big group or pay for remote passes and use pokegenie for matchmaking.

I've been a player since the beginning, and came back in 2020 after a hiatus. All in the name of making more money, more like it. They no longer care about the player base, just their bottom line.

I have been having a lot of issues with this game and the only way to fix it is to have e to uninstall and reinstall everyday. it gets very annoying. Overall I enjoy the app; however, what I don't understand is how a game that's been out this long and is backed by a massive company like Nintendo has such garbage servers. Just disappointed with the game that could have been the best like no other ever was. Played at launch 2016 but left the game after 2 months due to servers and limited features. You will spend more time facing down error messages then actual gameplay. Works, sometimes. But when it comes to exploring and playing with friends pokemon go will let you down 95% of the time. They really should have made sure to fix these problems and a year later it is a continuing problem. Pokemon go is the death of this once amazing genre of games.

Very fun and addicting game. However, the two setback I have is that you can only get 50 pokecoins a day (LIKE WHY?!?! It was a fun game when I played it on launch, but I haven't kept up with it. Although i do like Pokémon, i didn't like this one as much. When they finally get the bugs out and fix server issues, this game will be amazing. Until then it's just ok. Still worth a download. EDIT: THEY RUINED IT. the game gets worse as time goes. Loads of fun, the new trainer battles allow for tons of fun and competitive play. The consistent updates add new content all the time, to keep the game interesting. I think at this point the game has a solid base of mechanics, they just need to make sure it doesn't get stale. Maybe new catch or battle mechanics?

Look guys, it is a great game, still a great thing on off time but we severely need things. First off the storage is a severe problem, we don't wanna pay, ok? It's a good game, except that there are only a few stops and a single gym near me. It also has to constantly be updated, it's hard to play when it has to update ALL the time. Updated**** to 4 stars. I'm experiencing the same login problems as everyone else since the latest update. My husband is in the same boat. We both play on Android phones. Pokemon GO used to be fun to play. I lived in a small, rural town, and was doomed to solo raids. Remote passes made that much better, and I had a great time with the game! I have had this game since it first came out and I like the potential it has. As of now, however, the game is virtually unplayable for me. The game itself is great, definitely deserves a solid 4 stars. The problem is that you have to actually be able to get through the potato servers to be able to play the game. They should consider giving everybody some gifts for how many times server disconnections have cost people Pokémon catches, having to restart the app a dozen times in one session on some days, and not even loading at all at times. I truly hate this game. Truly. Niantic is a JOKE. I feel this way because Pokémon Go is not the game that we wanted or needed. It's a half-hearted attempt to lay a Pokémon theme over a scavenger hunt. If that is what Pokémon Go was advertised as, it would be great! But it wasn't. For nothing! No improvements!

When I was 10 years old (20 years ago), all I wanted was to catch Pokemon in the world. While the premise of this game is exciting, it's pretty clear now the game was not ready for release. I'm leaving Pokemon Go alone until it's actually done and picking my 3DS back up.

I really enjoy the game most of the time but there are a few big problems. The updates are huge, 90% of the time they don't work, I have to close everything out and restart my phone multiple times. The feedback system is tedious + doesn't work. Too many of the challenges are based on routes or playing with other people now. And it's complete bs that you only get 50 coins no matter how long a pokemon is in a gym. If you have multiples in gyms, it doesn't even count as you can only earn from one

I love the idea, but there are still a lot of bugs. I think it would definitely be better if 1. There was a "start raid" option instead of the countdown 2. There was no timer on raids, not everyone has a group of friends to go out and do raids with 3. You could delete eggs. Also it's really annoying when you click on a Pokemon and it despawns and bugs out so you can't catch it.

It's a fun game to play to kill time, I just wish it didn't take SO LONG to level up. Also sometimes when the circle is green and I'm using my BEST poké-balls to catch a Pokémon WHILE using berries, they escape. Or when they pop up on my screen, I'll click on them to try and catch them they just disappear. It's really is a great game and gets me out of my comfort zone, but there are a few inconveniences within the game. I can handle them but its just bothersome.

The one specific thing that I find could be improved is the battle system when battling friends, it sometimes works and other times it does not(this may be my internet, but just letting the devs know just in case), I also think that the feature of being able to see what your trainer level needs to be to power up your pokemon instead of just saying your trainer level is too low. (P.S. It would be nice if in your pokemon list you could go directly to their pokedex entry.)

This game is quite addictive as this is a childhood dream to actually catch Pokémon... But that's all the positivity I can give. The lag, the servers, and the constant bugs are what put me off so much. Just now, I was transferring some clafairys because I already have a clafable. I go to transfer, it lags, and it then transfers my clafable. If only you guys could of did alphas and betas before release. I guess you can only go up from here.

Update to my update: years later, I'm still playing and having as much fun as ever, and would have even more fun if it with too less time to appraise and access Pokemon to keep for whatever reason and what to transfer OR if they arrived our storage issues, possibly by giving us a home base type mass storage dump. With so many different aspects to the game and so many Pokemon to collect, many of us would play the game way more (and thus, spend more money on it) if we had a mass storage solution.

My review has changed, they made pokemon more frequent, and pokestops are no longer an issue, they've popped up everywhere. A lot of the warts this game had at launch, have been alleviated by a development team that listened to their userbase, and has given them what they want. It took some time, but they delivered in spades. Niantic is a good example of what video game publishers should be doing.

I love Pokémon. Played since '98. This game started off so strong and continues to ruin itself with every update. There have been a lot of updates to help with the Covid-19 situation we're all in, but overall, I still am not impressed by any means. I'm always more disappointed with "fixes and adjustments"; With the latest update, the game lags so much that it's costing me resources. I'm upset the Pokémon Company trusts their franchise with Niantic, but I do hope they don't repeat the mistake.

Its great so and they've added a few of the things i wanted them to add, but i still have a few more things if like to see. That said, the fact that they added to and improved the game earned them star #5 1)The ability to locate fellow trainwrs as long as both trainers are on each others friends lists. 2)trading of items and candies. 3)the ability to train/level our Pokemon through battling, and maybe even being able to engage wild Pokemon.

I absolutely love this game. As an ongoing pokemon fan this is the closest thing to catching them irl. However, since the recent 0.33.0 update, I have not been able to see gyms, not pokestops. I also get nothing in the nearby listing, even in highly populated areas I have been going to practically scince I started the game. I would love to continue playing, but if there is nothing for me to interact with in the game, I have nothing to enjoy. I hope the programmers get the bugs under wraps soon.

Maybe just add another way to earn coins other than putting pokemon in gyms? I don't live near a lot and finding a gym that's even owned by my team? Forget it. But it's really cool and definitely keeps me entertained for a while. The challenges are cool and keep me interested. And the variety of pokemon seems to always keep me surprised- good game. Can't wait to see what the future holds.

I've been playing this game since day one and I've been blown away with how many features they keep adding. If you played this game early on but stopped due to lack of content, I highly recommend you give it another shot. Gyms have been overhauled, there's research tasks, raids, team rocket, pvp, trading, and so much more in the works. Quite ironically sometimes I feel a bit overwhelmed with how much there is to do now. It's a great game and it motivates you to be active even in the winter.

The developer continues to make baffling decisions that just make it harder, more expensive, and more frustrating for players to actually play the game. More than doubling the price of the only good item you've added to the game in years is just unfathomable. And then to further limit how many a player can do in a day makes no sense. Remote raid passes aren't killing the game, they were the only thing keeping it alive. Also campfire is useless. It does nothing facebook groups didn't already do.

When the app first came out, an indicator in the bottom right would tell you how close a pokemon is to you. Then it became glitched, with all pokemon showing as the maximum distance away from you, regardless of actual distance. Several sites popped up to remedy this, showing you where the pokemon actually was. Today, they removed the distance indicator and shut down the tracking sites, essentially removing the only reason a lot of people played the game.

The content and events are pretty repetitive which makes it a little boring if you try to play to much, and gyms are WAY to easy to take down. There is no point in putting a strong pokemon in a gym because it is just as likely to be taken down as a level 1 pokemon. I still love the game and enjoy playing it a little more casually than I used to.

06/27/2019 Update review. We NEED!!! a messaging system in the game. It's a lot of work using 3rd party apps just to stay in contact with people you're high friend level with. It's alot easier to message in game and they get a notification and respond. The notification for messages also could be turned on or off. It's alot to have to add them on Facebook or discord or find them just to schedule a battle or trade. Also trainers should be shown during gym battles. Not just pokemon vs Pokémon.

i love this app, but I wish it was better designed for small communities as well as cities. My nearest gym is nearly a mile away, in a low-traffic part of town. Since the time they were introduced, I've only ever participated in one raid because either I can't get to the gym in time, or I can get to the gym but no one else is there. It's frustrating that so many things rely on raids and the assumption that everyone around you is also playing.

I enjoy the game pretty well. Though it can be laggy, unresponsive, the throws will curve to the side a LOT when throwing straight, and the GPS needs to be refined a little more. Also, I would love it if there was a nudge option added for if a friend has an unopened gifts from you. I have some friends that are online daily but they don't send gifts. But I know it's because they forget. Maybe have a notification of a gift not being opened after 24 hours

I started playing this game in launch day. Had a good time. Put it down for a few years and came back again recently. I just found out about a bunch of nice QoL features and that Niantic is starting to take them away.
