They doubled the price of remote raid passes which sucks, and their "Global events" also cost a lot. Like how you gonna charge 15$ for a 2-day event. Also they put a limit on how many raids you can go on everyday. This game used to be fun but the creators obviously care more about money than the customer.

This game used to be a blast. I was totally addicted. But Niantic has failed to update game loops and give incentives to play those game loops. Plus to play the more attractive parts of the game, you have to buy PokeCoins. I say, you have to buy, because it's not viable to collect PokeCoins. I really wish they would be for the player rather than line their own pockets.

"You've walked 4.3 km this week!" No, because of my job I've walked at least 100 km but Adventure Sync hasn't worked since its release so all that walking doesn't count towards my rewards. And if you try to spin the stops too soon between each one, the game will basically tell you to piss off, which doesn't work well for me as the only ones I pass are on my way to work each day. This "game" specifically punishes anyone who doesn't live in a highly populated area with lots of attractions nearby.

Way to go Niantic. You once again proved that you care nothing about the players. Doubling the cost of remote raid passes! Ridiculous. I will not be purchasing any more raid passes. And then on top of that you limit us to 5 remote raids a day! Many players, such as myself, love in rural areas and have to drive at least 10 miles to get to a gym or PokeStop. This has made me want to play the game way less. I have been a loyal player since the game came out and I'm close to deleting the app

I was at level 41, over 100 shinies, 16 perfectly appraised Pokemon, and, all of a sudden, I can't access my account. Contacted Niantic, and they said they can't find my account, even though I took a screenshot from one of my other accounts, that showed the precise account I was trying to access. They said they couldn't find the account's email I was providing, even though I just accessed the account with that same email previously in the day. All that hard work gone. Thanks a lot Niantic.

Wishing it was more. I don't know. Back to basics. Like. I want to battle wild Pokemon to level up the ones I want to use. Should have some kind of "trainers spotter" or something. Like see other people playing real time and if you want to trade or battle, should be able to. Capturing Pokemon as to level them up is outrageously unattractive.. Should be more like the games I grew up with. This leaves you feeling isolated and alone.

I like the game well enough, and I exercise regularly, so I dont mind walking. The problem is there's NOTHING near my house except woods. I run out of pokeballs easily and need to drive MILES if I want to find a pokestop to get more. I want there to be another way to "find" pokeballs. You should be able to find them on the ground like in the games. It could be a random drop from pokemon or something. I wouldn't even mind watching video ads daily if I could accumulate pokeballs.

It used to be fun to check on, even as a hypermonetized game, but every component has gotten more user hostile and you can't readily earn enough resources to keep up with costs that are constantly changing. Support also auto-denies requests now. I think it's criminal that this game is available to children, who will not just be annoyed but very tempted to purchase their way around the frustration that has become the entire game.

THE GAME WAS SO MUCH FUN IN THE FIRST WEEK! Until you got rid of an actual tracker. Now walking over every single square inch of town is insanely frustrating and boring. With a tracker, we could hunt out Pokemon in groups and actually have fun. I'll change my rating to five stars when we have an actual tracker like the game originally had. You can't just put in a loved feature then delete and it act like nothing happened. Disappointing.

So many small things that could be fixed to make this game better. There is so much downtime and loading screens for no reason. Giving gifts shouldn't take 20 minutes. Eggs hatching should be able to be skipped. Raid lobbies should have a ready check instead of having to wait for a countdown in a full lobby. Distance should be increased back to what they had it at as it makes the game safer to play and more accessible. Listen to the players and not just investors.

I played this game at release and I put out a review a couple days after its release and the game has evolved a lot since then so I felt it appropriate to update the review. the main thing about the review last time was that servers were constantly going down and connectivity was absolutely poor. these issues have for the most part have been completely fixed. the game has had multiple systems added to it to make it a more fun enjoyable and fair experience. Pokemon go has come a long way.

I used to have 4 stars on this. Not anymore. Niantic is running this game in the ground. PVP doesn't work right. Never has. They've taken away QOL functions that actually made this game better. Now price increases since they're losing money on their other games. My granddaughter and I are hanging up our accounts. We'll find other ways to fill in what used to be our pogo time. That's 2 less paying accounts. Congratulations, Niantic!

Really, I was addicted to this game. However, there were many factors that weighed my love down in the long run, and one consistent problem was consummation of pokeballs and obtaining pokecoins. I get a need for profit, however a better mechanism would be to implement small portions of pokecoins into quests, which could help with the problem of pokeballs consummation. It's easy to go through all your available pokeballs in a short amount of time, leaving you unable to do much more than sit.

The developers prove time and time again that nothing is forever. Raising prices and offering fewer incentives to play what was once a very fun and rewarding game. I've been playing daily for nearly 3 years, and have seen beloved features get stripped away in the name of an unclear vision, and remote raid passes are the latest. For what? An app that doesn't start up, adventure sync that only works half the time, paywalling certain Pokémon and weak research tasks, and limiting incense spawns? 🫠

Lots of fun! So many new friends from playing this game (pokemon players are everywhere), easy to get items, prices are very reasonable if you want to buy stuff, but the pokestops, gyms and level ups give you enough stuff that you don't really have to buy, there is always something fun to do, cool events, etc. I would highly recommend this game. The only thing I wish is that you could level past 40, but the fact that you can't doesn't take that much away from the game.

I've played this since launch. The app has gone downhill in the last year. My biggest complaint is being ignored when trying to improve the game. I've also been targeted by other players and Niantic support just says "that's how the game works." I enjoyed shiny hunting, but now it feels hollow. Save your time and money. I'll be uninstalling once I transfer all my shinies to home. Niantic is hopeless.

I've been able to play a few times on different accounts, I had a shiny Pokemon on one of the accounts, and I got logged out a few days later. The auto log out feature is the most annoying thing in this game. Also that happened a few years ago. Also I tried to make a new account, and I couldn't. Would rate 5 stars if the auto log out feature was removed

It seems this app only works at night here in America. If you live in a rural area you're gonna be SOL. I know people that find them in their cars and houses but I've located 2 outside since launch. If you have the bigger bank account you can rule the gyms and get rewarded for it. There are no battles, camera mode doesn't work. The creatures are tiny compared to data sheets. I call them creatures because this ISN'T Pokemon. Edit: For the past week I keep getting GPS signal not found error (11).

So after a few years of playing, the biggest issue I think most players could benefit from is a larger area of effectiveness. Not everyone can play a game that requires you to walk around town every day so having just a little more reach would be helpful. I can play at work anytime I want but my city doesn't necessarily have a PokeStop or a gym always nearby depending on where I'm working that day. Maybe giving us an extra city block or two would be helpful just in terms of activating locations

The game was great until I couldn't play it. I soon had to be connected to wifi to PLAY the game. Like, when loading up the game, the loading screen would pause and say "unable to connect" and tell me to retry or log out, which wouldn't let me log back in if I logged out. Please fix this. One of the reasons I downloaded was because I could play it on the go.

I love this game, but there are too many glitches. I have to restart my app too many times. Sometimes I have to uninstall and reinstall. The remote raids are great when they work. I often lose passes due to glitches. Remote raid passes cost a lot too. I am not spending any more money on this game until they fix that. Also, they should disclose the rates of pokemon in which eggs. I love this game, but it's starting to frustrate me. I can't quit because I've put hours and money into this game.

Still great game have liked most updates, in 2019 if I could point my phone in AR at a gym location and see it. That I would say is the next step. Maybe even see a AR over lay of gym fights in semi realtime. It would encourage many to try, also maybe add some more depth to the system. With a Gym "leader", "captain", and "member". Could give order to challenge system and make more interesting and spectical in AR. I would stop to watch someone or a group fight there way to a gym leader.

I really love this game, but I am disappointed that Niantic is removing the features added during the pandemic. The game is much harder to play now. I don't live in an area with good spawn rates, and leaving my house has become harder since COVID started. The pandemic features made this game more fun and accessible for my household, and it's not either of those things anymore. I would love to see Niantic reinstate these features, because I want to love and participate in this game again.

I have uninstalled and reinstalled this app like 3 times and it doesn't matter. Each time I spawn atop 3 pokemon (as a new player) and I cannot catch any of them. They are all merged together too. Pressing the catch pokemon button does nothing. I walked a solid 30 min around my neighborhood and no matter what I did the camera wouldn't work, nothing would work. I just want to catch and collect pokemon. I could care less about the battles.

Daily player, in fact, the game has been the primary means of my exercise over the past year. However, the recent "commitment" to the in-person experience (kicked off by a local-only raid that crashed the game for massive numbers of players, then followed by a nerf and price hike for Remote Raid Passes) has caused irreparable damage to the player community and rendered 4-star or greater raids nearly impossible to beat without substantial planning in all but the most populated areas. For shame.

I love this game, don't get me wrong, but whatever the update did has left the game consistently crashing on me. Every time I try to open a gym or catch a gift Pokemon the screen goes white. When I'm catching a pokemon, it'll sit and load forever until I reload the app. On top of that, the cost of buying more bag space is insane when there's virtually no space. I just restarted the game and can't spin stops because it's already full, please add a little space to the item bag.

I did really enjoy this game right up until I downloaded an update and now the game never receives a GPS signal. I've done all of the recommendations to make my GPS signal better yet it doesn't fix it. The game used to run just fine before I did the update and now I haven't been able to play for months. I had hoped to see it get fixed but I guess not because I still don't get a GPS signal. Congratulations you just lost a hard core player!!! Very unhappy!!!!

It's a Pokémon tracking game with no way to track Pokémon! Which is apparently a feature! EDIT: I made my earlier review in 2016 when PokemonGO had some difficulties supporting the influx of players, and had no social media presence. Revisiting GO in 2020, it's a much more stable game, with frequent updates and plenty to do. Niantic has been incredibly generous and attentive during the COVID outbreak, and I'm really enjoying myself! So I'm changing my review to 5/5, great work Niantic!

Money-grubbing garbage. First you think, "oh fun, so rewarding, look at all this new stuff" then you stop leveling up so often, you realize you barely get pokeballs for how long it takes to get them, and because of how much time you've spent thus far, they bank on that commitment by making it so that you'll need pokeballs fast for something special, and no way to get them other than buying in the heat of the moment. Something like 20 per $1.

I've enjoyed this game for a long time and have spent a ton of money on it. With the coming changes to remote raid passes, I think my time is done. There are constant issues with big elite raids and game freezes and they want to take the one quality of life away from players that they enjoy. I can over look some of the things but I'll be spending my money elsewhere. This is just greed pure and simple to gather your data as much as they can. If you're reading this, I suggest you don't install

This game is fun when it's firing on all cylinders, but the app is plagued by bugs and inconvenient issues that Niantic does not address. From the game not loading to being kicked out of raids for no apparent reason, your experience will be muddled. Echoing what others are saying, if you live in a rural or even suburban area you're probably gonna have a bad time, the game is mostly catered to those in a dense urban environment with access to good public transport or a car.

The game is a lot of fun and much more rewarding when played with friends, but why isn't there a friend chat menu or any way to communicate with in-game friends? If you're a solo player you have to download other apps that work with Pokemon Go just to find other players to raid with and actually progress in the game because Niantic won't do it for us. The game needs more love and care for it's own community. It has such potential, but sadly like most other mobile games, lacks creator love.

(Edit) Lost a star due to another price increase. Even more pay to play! It's something all the time to buy. How can we keep up? Paying 200 coins for 50 slots for pokemon and 200 coins for 50 slots for items that we so desperately HAVE TO keep buying OFTEN if we want to keep playing. Then you get behind if you aren't constantly buying Raid passes! I won't even mention all the comical event ticket rip-offs. Everything on the game is overpriced. Even the useless stickers they try and sell.

My previous rating was apparently deleted, which was 2 stars. I'm lowering my rating to 1 star for the same reason I had lowered it in the first place. The game is good and fun. Missing just a few aspects to make it a great 5 star worthy game. Like trading, PvP battles, and possibly an elite four system. First, an update came for remote raid pass price to be doubled(which isnt really a problem to me), but the real problem is that a got a shiny riolu and evolved it, thought it was my lucky day, I was happy until I noticed that the cost of teaching it a second charged attack went up, there was no warning(there should be), & there was absolutely no way I would have known about this, infact I thought It would stay the same because i remember evolving other pokemon and the cost was still the same.

Game use to be great and I would play daily. Since they decided to change the remote situation I barely get any raids invites or gifts. I went from a daily player to not wanting to play much. I have been a casual Pokemon player my whole life. I am 24. I took a break and after a series of new phones I figured I would have to start over. So I pushed it off. I live in suburbia and get all the game content from the 3 pokestops and gyms near me. I get the premium coins. Its not hard. It is a great casual game.

Used to be great, but the longer the games around the more consistent the network errors have become. "COME DO ADVENTURE WEEK/COMMUNITY DAY/GLOBAL CHALLENGE!" but if you try, do know your gaming experience will be "error (0)" "network error" and "can not use item at this time" pokestops wont spin, clicking on pokemon will freeze the app. Of course due to the type of game it is, you probably already left home to play and so you will be left not only dissatisfied but also quite angry. Shame.

Devs definitely don't care about the game. Events are all cash grabs and the "free content" like the ability to get galarin birds is overly difficult so you have to keep playing. The game has terrible loading issues, so bad that I have to open and close the game 3-4 times before it loads. If you enjoy pokemon, I'd pass on this game so it doesn't ruin it for you.

Niantic keeps increasing prices of in game items, and the recent push to try to get players playing in person again by doubling the price of remote raid passes, limiting them to five a day, and introducing elite raids is delusional and ableist. Things in the world have changed since the time the game was released, people don't want to be in groups of 20 strangers. I used to spend $40-$80 a month playing this game, I'm now uninstalling it. We'll see if I start back up again.

Still have some signal issues, but not as bad. Only complaint now is the lack of Pokemon in areas that should have them. I went to a park for almost 1.5 hours and only got a couple of Pokemon, while walking through my apartment complex I got a lot more. That doesn't make sense. Ingress had more to do, this game seems really slow pace comparatively speaking unless you are on a college campus.

I love this game when it first came out as it was an easy to play a pokemon game without have to bring my 3ds everywhere, but slowly over time the game kept getting worse. Recently I havent been able to get any potions. It feels like the drop rates for potions went down from previous updates. It use to be that I could barely get any pokeballs which i was fine with. Changed my previous rating. Been playing since launch. In short, STOP BEING GREEDY. STOP MAKING THE GAME LESS FUN. I've been playing this game since launch day. It is something I get on and do at least a couple times a day, but I'm busy. I work full time. I don't want to go out and find 5+ people to do raids. STOP RAISING THE PRICE OF REMOTE PASSES. It literally does not improve the game for anybody in any way. It just makes it harder for many of us to participate. Pure greed.

I used to like this game, but the way Niantic is going for money and not the quality of game experience. I have been glitches out of ongoing raids, had pokemon suddenly disappear and reappear in my pocket a day later, had my avatar glitch off screen, the game not open for me for hours, but I stayed. Since the game's creation, PoGo has drastically improved. Devs seem to have listened to their user base and added pretty much everything that was asked for - improved gyms, trading, gifting, PvP battles, etc. The game crashes are few and far between now. The user base is still there too, which is half the fun in playing.

I enjoy how we are able to turn fantasy into somewhat reality, being able to grow and produce something doesn't just come from anywhere but when people work hard. Now I perposly gave a star less because I gives you restrictions, I don't have data, so I can only do it at home, and you can only get money by going to gyms, but I can't, so no buying anything for me.☹️. I have to admit, the first few months of Pokémon GO being out wasn't the best. Servers were often down, you couldn't catch Pokémon, and over all there were many bugs. Not only is it more enjoyable but the buddy system gives you more of an incentive to walk and exercise. Not only that, but it runs way smoother compared to earlier months and many of the minor bugs have been fixed.

The fact that you still haven't added ability to trade/transfer pokemon with/to others, is sad to say the least. Not to mention also adding one-on-one battling besides fighting pokemon placed in the gym, like how they would in the actual pokemon series T.V. series and movies. Make it a requirement to only be able to trade at pokemom gym's or something. all the bugs I've found and all the annoying error codes and lagging between menus/screens/and .

Honestly, this game needs alot of updates to fix everything wrong with it. There's so many issues with lag, pokemon running away after the first throw(even though it's a less than 10% chance), unfair matchups when it comes to battling, it's almost impossible to get potions when you're completely out and all your pokemon are fainting, etc. This game has waaaaaay too many bugs in it for me. Not to mention all the stupid glitches everywhere in the game. Niantic has alot to work out

I haven't had the game for more then 24 hours and I now cannot even log in. Fun game, just need to fix the bugs if your going to have a high demand game. 7/17/16 UPDATE: game is addicting. Just like any other game there are some glitches, but runs a lot better then when it first came out. I absolutely love this game. Love pokemon. Love the halloween special items. 11/8/19

I love pokemon to death. I have tattoos to symbolize my love for Pokémon since the 90s. But, after the last few years, the game went down hill drastically. It took away the joy to play. I don't mind groups, but, I love playing alone and exploring my city and being active that way. But I feel it doesn't offer much to us solo players/tiny groups. Plus it's all, "Money this, money that" when I last played, and you have to be in select cities for actual fun... No more PokémonGo for us :'(

The game itself is fantastic. It's a great distraction from everyday life. But Niantic is garbage. They have warped this game time and time again. They are doing everything they can to make signing into this app as difficult as possible.

I'm addicted to this game, except giving it 2 stars for this reason alone: the Pokemon you have to catch winning battles. It takes like 50 PokeBalls to catch this epic or mythical Pokemon like. And it's not even worth it to go through all that trouble. You just have to trade it anyway, because you can't have 5 of the same, unevolvable, untradable Pokemon in your inventory. I've had several frustrating experiences playing this recently that I hope will be addressed quickly. Twice today, when conquering a Gym, it erroneously said all my pokemon had fainted. Not sure what happened recently. The game has issues loading, causing you to close the app and reopen until you get in. I'm missing raid passes. The trading system is a little messed. My husband's phone will be done with the trade, and on my end it will still be thinking(we both have a brand new samsung galaxy s23 ultra). Had some fun with the game since it's inception,spent some decent money on it too. If you feel like being milked of your money, enjoy. But I'm done.

1 star still remains. I tried to it again recently and...there's nothing of substance really. At this point there are so many Pokémon trying to evolve your chosen few is torturous. The "difficulty" at trying to catch some doesn't make any sense. One at 250CP a regular ball works but another at 250CP need an ultra ball and even then it might not happen. I've really enjoyed the game, overall it's a super fun game and adds some fun elements to the Pokemon world. I've been having a blast playing this game. It would be nice if they could implement Pokemon Centers in the game, even if it was limited to every few days or something. Pokemon Centers were always a big part of the game's so not having them feels odd in a way.

Suddenly getting "UNABLE TO AUTHENTICATE" error message. In my 10 years of playing, I have NEVER had an issue with this game. No bugs, glitches, nothing. Good game, but just double the prices of a paid expendable item that is essential to the majority of the player base as well as put a limit a on how many times that item can be used per day. Therefore it widens the gap on the limits to players like myself who live in rural areas with a scarce amount of stops, gyms, spawns, etc. If Campfire was up and running and mildly successful the change would be understandable but it's still invite only and most people don't even know it exists!!

The best idea for a mobile game, ruined. Niantic shows no concern for its customers and continually makes attempts to get more in game spending. I love the game, but something that does need to be fixed is the "swooping" in on Pokemon when you click. Because of this, you no longer see or get the spiral star animation for shiny Pokemon. Updating my review, you guys have come a long way in the game and have done a pretty good job with it. I would say we need are 3 more things: 1- Let us battle wild pokemon with same battle style as pvp battles (this can be a turn on and off option) 2- Implement a Pokemon Center for us to restore our pokemon (at least 1 or 2 times a week of poke cebter availability) 3- Add an actual pokemart theme song to the shop and add more items like regular potions, super, hyper potions.

This used to be a really fun game still is sometimes if it loads or not be in the middle of a raid and it tells you to update it, buy incense and when you use them there's no Pokemon that shows up. it took away couple of my free boxes, it's just been a lot of glitches here lately and it's not fun anymore to spend money like that, and not be satisfied. I started playing when it first came out, quit then picked it back up. I do enjoy it just wished it was better on some things. 🙂

As mentioned in last review, that I would re-rate once major issues were addressed. So I rate from a 2 star to a 4 star. Game is quite more stable, however, I am still having some login issues from time to time. Other then that everything else has been fixed. Please provide more servers so login works almost all the time. Thanks.

The AR aspect makes pokemon catching difficult, since they often disappear and reappear all over the place so it's best to just not use that function. Sometimes it takes way to many pokéballs to catch, it shouldn't take 10 pokeballs to catch a Weedle. While the PVP trainer battles are fun and a welcome addition, it doesn't give you a notification when one of your friends wants to battle, so you each have to go on at the same exact time.

This game and the horse it rode in on can fornicate with a cactus. For 8 years I have toughed it out through glitches, crashes, errors, etc. but now I can't log in and it seems like I'm the only one, and there's no functional customer service department, and no announcement saying "some trainers might be having issues". Whatever. Go debug yourself.

As someone who goes to college, there's always pokemon and pokestops, and things to do. The only problem is when I go back to my parents place, there's almost nothing for a wide range of time. No gyms, the only thing to catch is a daily Rattata, and nothing new. But, being blessed into all the action, the game is really fun and engaging! I enjoy it, and would recommend it to people that live in populated areas. That's where the fun is.

I commend Pokemon Go for implementing features that allow for a more solitary game play during this pandemic. The rate of Pokemon appearing as well as faster egg hatching has helped considerably as well as the one time reduced item buys. On that note I'd like to request/suggest making more of these available especially pokeballs. For some who can't get out to the pokestops because of the pandemic it is very hard to get them or coins if not impossible which leaves the game dead in the water. 🤠

I enjoy the app and that it encourages people (including myself) to get out and about. However, I have been getting increasingly frustrated with the app. Quite frequently it sends me back to the sign in page; then says sign in failed. If I delete the app and re-download it, I am able to sign in. Sometimes it will let me play signed in for a couole days; other times it kicks me out after a couole of hours. Then I have to delete and re-download again if I want to continue playing.

WASTE OF TIME AND MONEY!! It's incredible how much this game has gone to trash. The app developers don't care and only see each player as walking dollar signs. From events that crash, glitch, and make the game unplayable, (which they REQUIRE you to pay 15 dollars to "enjoy") to lack of anything players actually want/ask for. As someone who has spent countless hours and money into this game. I have to say there's nothing but disappointment and greed left in Pokemon Go 2022

I enjoy it, I understand the foot mapping for Pokémon are off probably until they better their servers. I would suggest a better way to pick multiple pokemon to transfer and earn your multiplier of candies. If not multiple seperate Pokémon, same choice of that one would still be easier. A way to keep the app running for your eggs and not burn your battery even in power saver mode. Maybe some new items that could be found and maybe even purchased, but so far it's great, keep up the good work.

I use to love this game. I love the idea and concept. Even pre-COVID its very very disappointing that the only way you can reliably get a pokeball, the one with the lowest success rate, requires additional payment. When you've run out of pokeballs, and no poke-stop in sight, its time to turn off the game even when you find the pokemon you've looked forwards to.

This is a great game but there are some features I would love to see added in the long run like the option to see other player's avatars and battle them just for fun. I detest the way the gym battle system works and miss the turn based battle style. Also wish you had to battle pokemon to weaken them like in the original games.

Update 2023/04: After announcement of accessibility features being removed and reduced from the game along with other updates I can no longer support or recommend this game. Original: Although there are server crashes and some bugs, this might be the best mobile game I've ever played. I have no doubts the issues will be resolved and this will keep getting better. Update: the nearby feature has been removed. Finding Pokémon is next to impossible!

Played this game for a long time but unfortunately the developers only seem care about money, making it so only players willing to buy lots of passes can participate in the community. Not to mention the disregard for those who play with disabilities. Most features they introduce are buggy, flawed or not user-friendly and one can only hope that they'll fix them at some point (they never do), and when they do implement a feature seamlessly you can be sure it makes the game harder and less fun.

Used to love this game, but that was before they removed all the rewards. I'm also quite annoyed I'm unable to complete primary goals in the game because I don't play in close proximity to other people, so I can't play parties, do trades, compete in battles together. I'm also not close to any routes, so I'm unable to complete those goals as well. Most of the timed quests require killing yourself or paying a fortune to even participate. If you're not playing this, don't bother honestly.

A forthcoming update has made it all too clear that the company who develops this game, Niantic, is only interested in its players' personal GPS data. They are manipulating game mechanics to coerce the players to play the game a certain way which maximizes the type of GPS data other companies will pay big $$$ for. So, if you are interested in your privacy and not being used as Niantic's tool, please find another game to play.

I've been a player since day 3. I've put a lot of time and energy into this game. But as time goes on, I find myself less engaged. It's rinse and repeat, and the reward for that isn't all that great. Niantic doesn't seem interested in helping all its players. Only people in high population areas and lots of money to spend really get the "full" experience of this mobile game. If Niantic wants to keep people engaged, they need to do more for their players.

My last review disappeared? Seriously? The improvements in the spawn rate are nice right now. However, it's mostly unplayable for those of us in quarantine! We can't get pokeballs, berries, or participate in gym battles and I need to lvl my pokemon. This is supposed to go on for at least 18 months in the US and I'm sure that timeline is comparable around the world. We'll be stuck inside. Increased spawn rate isn't enough Devs. Make the game playable for everyone.

Hey my review got deleted. Well I'm here again. This game is simplistic and repetitive, and you're more or less forced to play it if you have interest in creating a "living Pokedex" for the main-series Pokemon games. And dealing with it wouldn't be so bad if Niantic weren't utterly incompetent devs that show no interest in appealing to or listening to the playerbase. Seriously, design choices aside, there are still glitches from when the game first launched over five years ago. Avoid this game.

Niantic took away the ability to do Raids from a distance w/o paying a ridiculous amount of money; and they capped it at only 5 long-distance Raids per day. As someone with a physical disability, this makes the game much more difficult. I started playing to have fun and escape stress for a while, but now it's more stressful than it is enjoyable. It sucks, I had to change this from a 5-star review (from 2020) to a 1-star review. The game has gone downhill big time!

Game is fun, but Niantic has gotten greedy as of late. The fact that they're expecting people to buy incense on top of the cost of a go fest ticket to get good spawns is absurd. And for how much money they make, the app sure is pretty buggy and featureless. Could stand to make a lot of QoL improvements. Like maybe an in game calender so I dont have to visit the stupid blog all the time to keep up with events. Or perhaps not freezing when I try to launch the app. Do better.

This used to be a great game and it wasn't something I was concerned with spending money on (mainly for incubators or remote raid passes). Working full time and being a dad, it's a little hard for me to consistently play, but the recent changes over the past year have made it much harder to play. Niantic is no longer catering to the casual players despite what they claim to make the game even for everyone.

Increased pricing and micro transactions have ruined this game. My wife, kids, and I used to go out for long walks, catching and raiding. However, we have all deleted the game due to its constant greed for more and more money. I get you have to pay for the creators of the game, but now the disparity between profits and pay are astronomical. It's a fun game that does have value, but not enough to justify increased costs.

I like how this game gets you outside and exploring. You can collect, battle, do routes, compete in showcases, raid, team up with friends, and really whatever else you feel like. The game has some minor bugs that can be annoying at times, but those aren't that common. I've gone to events and played for more than 6 hours with no issue at all. Overall, it's a really fun game if you like collecting and exploring. They've added a lot of new content and features lately, too. Fun stuff!

The game has a lot of potential! Bugs of course due to being first released, but that is like any other first released game. Is it possible to release re-character customization option? Oh and to fix the AR locating to be more wide spread? Sometimes I am not able to use it. Update: As the game releases more updates it is becoming more prevelant that niantic does not immediately listen to their consumers and are adding features that require more money spent to enjoy the game.

Even when I'm outside in open area, I cannot move. My location is enabled, but every time I try to walk my character spins in circles and goes nowhere. Everytime I try to play, I spend a solid minute clicking "dismiss" on all of the notifications. I may be getting a new phone soon, and when I do I'll try again, but if I have the same issue I am leaving this review as it is.

So the whole premise of this game is supposed to be tracking pokemon that are close to you so that you can find the pokemon and catch them. I love the game, I only found a couple bugs. Been playing since day one (on and off). Niantic has rolled out amazing improvements and kept my interest in the game for quite some time. I love this game. But the only thing that really annoys me is the 50 coin daily limit. There should be a 10 day threshold to earn let's say 100 coins. Make it to where it's actually beneficial to leave a Pokemon in a gym for that long. That's the only thing that really bugs me. Please fix this Niantic.

This game has had me going out every night to hunt down pokemon cus ya know, I wanna be the very best. But ever since the recent tracking bug with 3 paws always, it's not fun enough to be worth it. Shame Edit: well the tracker is not totally broken now, it just tells you where to go rather than give you the "warmer, colder" mechanic which I thoroughly enjoyed. Back to 4 stars.

I've played this game since the day it came out. There has been a lot of high points and low points throughout that time, and although I do really love this game, the steady stream of terrible updates and decisions made by Niantic have brought this game to an all time low. Every game I have ever seen with a dev team this out of touch has resulted in a game dying, and this I'm sure will follow eventually. Maybe things will change, but until then, it's time to find a game with devs who care.

The game used to be really fun where good items and Pokemon weren't too hard to get. Now almost everything you may want will cost so much money just to get. Niantic has really gotten greedy and raised the prices for everything. The main part of the game for me was the battling and that feels like it's set up every match, with you having to go against typings that are exact counters to yours. I miss when they first came out with it and the battling was COMPLETELY random with starter pokemon.

The game is okay. Been a pretty good game for the most part, some hits and misses since it's launch. Many people can't get out or have no where to raid nearby so Niantic is isolating people. Remote raids brought in a lot of people and made it easier to play with friends. You could at least raise shiny odds if you're going to make this app choppy and unplayable. It has been SO laggy, I have lost many Pokéballs. It says "Pokémon can't be found" and ends encounters. It's a great game. It has SO much potential. it just seems unfinished. I think the game itself is a lot of fun, and its a main driving force to get me to leave the house. However, i cannot support the substantial price increases for the items in the in-game shop. It is good but needs a lot of improvement. For example,the loading screen 7/10 times gets stuck. Another example is that the price of the items now are not as good as they were originally. DO NOT PLAY!!! This game introduced features that made it accessible to many people, yet in the middle of an ongoing pandemic they REMOVED THEM!! I walk with friends and we enjoy the events. I love that they added trainer battles and team rocket. I just wish I could trade long distance with some of my friends. Other than that. To many cheaters and no redress. I started playing again to help motivate me to go a little further everyday. The system of the game is reasonable, but it could be improved. I originally had a really good time playing. I give them credit for all the changes they made during the beginning of covid but I'm concerned that their changing things back to early. I'm angry that you can purchase special researchs, that inorder to be completed you must be at lvl 40, with no warning before purchase. The catch rate for legendary pokemon are abysmal for raids, I have more than 1/2 run away. This game is set up to eat your money and I'm honestly close to just deleting it.

I adore this game! It genuinely motivates me to get outside and DO something, unlike many others. I've been playing basically since the start, and have enjoyed most of the gameplay elements, although I still can't land a decent curve ball. Lol Spoofers are an issue - along with people who drive and play, although that's definitely not as bad as it was. The cap on gold per day from gyms is a bit of a bummer - I usually only have a few incubators at a time because of it. Overall, great game.

This game is awesome. The help to access your account isn't. I tried to play again using my old account and got no help in logging back in. I got the error message and no help from the automated email system. I had to make a while new account and had issues doing that too. After 5 days, I was able to get a new account going. Two weeks later the game logged me out and when I logged back in, it took me to my old account. Which sucks, cause my daughter and I busted our butts to reach level 25

I've been playing since July 2016 and have accepted the many changes made to the game, good and bad. However, Niantic recently, greatly reduced Pokemon spawns across the globe, including my neighborhood, a nearby park, and the small town where I normally play. The now very limited amount of Pokemon in the wild ruins even basic gameplay. The rating reflects the current state of the game. I hope they are able to course correct and fix these issues.

Niantic sucks, they have made the game pay to play, reduced the rare quality pokemon, made encounter/catching some nearly impossible. They ignore feedback from players. If you have unlimited disposable income, this is the game for you. For the rest of us, who work at the times Niantic seems to think everyone should be available, on to the next.

I don't play any more. Developers have fallen so far away from what their fans wants. It's nice you want people to get out and play together but it's difficult. Loved that I could raid with friends out of state as much as we wanted. when they limited the amount and upped raid passes they killed the last enjoyable part of the game. There is nothing to keep you playing long term.

Updates are still very large and fill a hefty chunk of my phone's storage. The game was more fun when I didn't feel like the only way to have enough balls to catch any decent number of mons is to buy coins. The daily items given out are miniscule and barely offer any help in keeping stocked up. In the current atmosphere this game feels a little too demanding. I only occasionally play, if only to attempt to catch specific mons that are sword exclusive so that I can transfer them.

I'm really sad. I just recently started playing again after taking a break for a while. I was excited about the game again, it was fun. Immediately now my excitement has been crushed. I can't do 195 coins for a single remote raid pass. That's almost a week or more for me to get a single pass. I can't chance spending money on buying a pass because I don't have the best luck catching the raid Pokémon, they run after 16 or so great throws and golden raspberries more often than I catch. Very sad.

I been playing Pokémon Go since 2016... my overall experience from then to now is how there are many more ways to level up faster. Newer Pokémon to catch and acquire new items as well. Remote raiding changed the overall game play in a good way in my opinion. Adding friends, Trading and battling have been a plus! The only draw back is how they're introducing into the p2p era.

Improving and getting better!! However, the remote raids and other remote options need to remain in the game. COVID-19 is still a thing. It's also not good that the prices were increased for the Remote Raid passes. Also the times for the Enamorus raids suck. 2 times during the day when people have work. Then at night, I went to gyms and no one showed up to the gyms. If I could rate Pokémon Go at 0 stars, I would. It was way better when it started.

The game is great and certainly has come a long way since the beginning, especially for those playing in small towns. Although it would be better if we were able to recall Pokemon from gyms. Being in a small town, they can be stuck in a gym for months at a time before someone defeats them and they return to you. It makes earning coins much harder because you don't receive them until they return from the gym

A few glitches but good innocent game for kids or for anyone. I enjoy playing this with my kids(5-21) and the hubby. Gets us out and we travel to different areas doing it. It's like board game night but all the time. Really is a great way to keep close with your family and friends. I do wish pokestops were easier to spin at traveling speeds so my kids can play when I am driving. There aren't a lot of pokestops in our small towns either so we have to use a lot of fuel to get to pokestops areas.

"Free to start" my cheeks. I live in a suburban area where you would expect them to have put something. Nope. During the initial release, there were no Pokestops or gyms for dozens of miles in my area so the game outright forced me to pay for supplies to get any use out of it. Since then, it hasn't proven to have gotten any better about hitting me with a big paywall at some point or another. Game is also very clunky and tends to glitch often. I don't know how this game has so many rabid fans.

Idk what is wrong with this glitchey app. Stuff will load in super slow, I've lost a few passes from "network errors" and or in the middle of raids being kicked out in thus also losing passes. Also, idk about anyone else but lately I've been getting a LOT of what I like to call ghost gifts. 🙄 I'll get people that appear to have a gift for me, only to click on it and it not appear. Then if you refresh the gift will suddenly disappear. A good number too.

No longer lets me log into My game, since it doesn't have Facebook or even Google as an option to log in anymore. Just got Pokemon Go. I had my Pokemon Go linked to my Facebook. I sent an email and it just sent an automated message, which was of no help. I haven't been able to play for a long time because of this issue. I even opened a new account with Niantic and see if I can link my accounts. It still won't let me log in. You really need to fix it.

As buggy as it is, it just came out in US today. So I don't expect it to be perfect. However there are a few flaws I don't like, like no friends list, or you can't battle without being at a gym unlike advertised you can battle anywhere. I mean other than that, its just a walking simulator. 5/7 perfect score. Edit: Added friends list, trading, and battling. Changed the prices of remote raid passes and severely limited how many you can do a day. Sorry Niantic, but you done goofed...

You can't even battle wild pokemon, you just throw a poke ball at it. Where's the fun in that? This app still drains my battery really quickly. Please fix that. The new gym update is pretty incredible; it reignited my interest in battling and the badges are nice. The best part is that I no longer need to go to the shop to collect the poke coins from assigning a Pokemon to a gym, they are automatically entered into my account.

Fun, and nearly the closest thing to being a real Pokémon trainer achieveable with modern technology. That said, the in-app purchases have always been closer to necessary to actually play the game than they should be; if your place if residence is even moderately isolated, odds are you'll be running out if critical items unreasonably often, "encouraging" you to spend real money just to be able to play. Moreover, some recent events have been locked behind $8 tickets-- "pay-to-win" is seeping in.

Normally I would rate this about a 4 out of 5 stars, but recently they decided to up the prices in their shop making it now near impossible for the majority of players that don't have heaps of cash to use the shop in any meaningful gameplay way. Raising the prices of the remote raid passes, is only hurting this game's already lacking ability to play with other people. So much for trying to pretend that you want to connect people around the world.

A wonderful game that is a lot of fun, except when they start making terrible changes. They keep increasing the price of things, which makes it a lot harder for many people to play certain parts of the game. Theyll be Increasing the remote raid pass by nearly double soon, and it already isn't guaranteed to be able to catch the Pokemon at the end of the raid. The loading screen gets stuck sometimes too. Hopefully they'll rethink their decision to stop overcharging their customers.

Its alright, unless you live in a rural area. The old lore/scents used to allow at least some playability, but they were nerfed because... Niantic needs more money? Theres almost no RPG element to this, as even leveling seems cheapened. Events come and go. A bit lack luster. You can gather all these Pokemon, but theres no interaction with other games, thus its all isolated to one app. Battling other people isnt all that great either. Trading can be amusing if you can find people to 'play' with.

Been playing since the game came out, along with the whole family. Very interactive and I like that pokemon can be sent to other games and the experience is based on being out and about. It is so much better that we can finally communicate through Camp Fire, but this system could be made much better if friends were automatically added to our Camp Fire or if Pokemon Go had its own chat system. A few other things that I would like to see fixed: 1. Wasting Raid Passes due to others leaving without

Dropping to one star because my review seems to have vanished somehow. The game is fine, it works good and can be fun. I dont like it because I was expecting walking around to catch pokemon but still having a turn-based combat system. Turns out there really isnt much of a combat system at all and it slightly annoys me. You walk around, find a pokemon and just throw pokeballs at it... wheres the fun in that?

Started playing this game at launch, kept playing through the bugs. Now that I've been back to playing for about a year, I've been enjoying the remote raid passes as they allow me to play with my friends even when we're all travelling for work. They have recently begun disincentivising remote play and have been making the game less playable for most players. Between the price increases and elite raids(they require in person attendance) my friends and I are feeling forgotten.

I've been playing this game for a long time. (7 years), and I'm so fed up with how restricted it is. 7 years, and I'm only level 37. It takes too much exp to level, and the fact everything is based on your location makes it worse. You can be in the middle of nowhere, cutting off 60% (raids and gyms) of the game! And don't get me started on how un-handicap friendly the whole game is. My grandma loves pokemon but can't really play with because she can't walk!

This game has improved somewhat from it's dismal post launch mismanagement, but over the past few years Niantic's slow trickle of updates have never added much substance to keep players engaged. I wish they'd add more content in line with the core pokemon console titles. This has been a common dream of many players that, at this late point, just has no chance of happening.

Curve ball throws are currently glitched for me. No matter what I do, as soon as I go to throw the spinning ball it just instantly returns to the bottom of the screen like I wasn't throwing it, and no poke ball is consumed. The laundry list of rules about trading is also a real let down. With no way to trade and Gastly being rare by me, I've given up all hope of ever getting a Gengar. Just not a fun experience.

Although the game isn't as good as everyone thought it was during its first 2 months, it's still a decent game to play. What has kept this game fun were two things: probabilities and exploration. in 2018, the game feels much fresher and has many more features than initially, including PvP battles, quests, trading, event bonuses, raids, redone gyms, much more Pokemon to collect, Team Rocket battles, and an available 3rd move slot. I can finally say the game feels whole and completely playable.

Mad disappointment I switched several devices just to be able to play this game.. Now while playing I cannot find half the things others in my group find they either don't show in the radar or I can be in the same location and they never appear for me. So frustrated tired of the disappointment and frustration and money gone down the drain. Makes me look crazy trying to keep up!!! Tired of no resolutions to my issues. I'm done after my coins are spent. Thanks for NOTHING

Used to be a lot of fun. Niantic keeps citing user experience and their ongoing goals while making it harder to play for anyone who is disabled in any way, not well off in cashflow, not in an urban enviornment safe enough to walk and/or gather, and anyone who doesn't have lots of available free time. Plus, the app doesn't function well with increasing frequency. There are a lot of people who love Pokemon and love this game. It's too bad Niantic is destroying so much of what was good about it.

Played this game back when it launched and had a blast. It unfortnately wasn't rural friendly so had to uninstall for quite a while till Covid hit. Picked it back up and was SO excited for all the rural changes. It made it to where I could actually PLAY. Niantic has ruined that with the recent changes. Being rural means NO coins unless you pay money; no raids because well no gyms. Can't remote because nobody is doing that now due to the price hikes. If you're a whale, this game is for you.

The tracking system is worthless. Great idea for a game but sad execution. Their idea of minimum viable product for launch should've been re-evaluated. evaluated. no trading, no way to train Pokemon. I can walk around different places and catch the same 10 Pokemon over and over and over again. They don't seem to be improving possible ways of finding Pokemon. I'm going to retire my dream of being a Pokemon master and enjoy having a much longer lasting battery. Me and Pokemon go are breaking up.

I am with everyone else here on the new update... It is complete garbage. I have played for years and never had these issues even the "white screen of death " wasn't as bad as these problems. Being a level42 and having contributed my share of pay for play I feel slightly cheated. The thrill is gone challenges aren't worth it. I long for the days of nests, pokemaps, groups gathering at exraids, and having to actually work for that elusive pokemon character. Just ranting, but please fix it!!!!

So the game is fantastic, not gonna lie. But Niantic, you are seriously messing up trying to upcharge the remote raid passes. You make enough money already as is so why are you gonna go off and lose revenue from people that actually bought the bundle when it was 250. There is literally no incentive to buying to the bundle when you can get 3 singles for the same price. I don't know who made that move, but they messed up big time. Your fan base is extremely pissed off about it.

I have loved this game for a very long time. It has made me be more active in my everyday life, and it involves fun tactics to the gameplay. Alongside that, it is enjoyable to run into the shinies of the many different pokemon, and learn new mechanics as it's updated. The community days are fun as well, and battling in the raids can be enjoyable yet difficult. However, the game can be slow and laggy at times, as well as unfortunate as less pokemon appear in less populated places.

Leaving again. Price increase in the remote raids is unacceptable. Was enjoying it and close to level 40. Pretty good now. Bugs fixed. From a long time ago: Niantic is having lots of trouble keeping up with demand. They removed any ability to track Pokemon including outside apps. Their refresh is to slow for biking. Other than that the idea is pretty cool. Give it a try, maybe they have it all fixed by now...

I tried to download it 3 years ago and had technical difficulties. I recently redownloaded it last month just for the heck of it and I am glad to say that I have been having a blast! I live in Houston (a big bustling diverse city) so there's tons of Pokéstops and gyms. Although it's not be the latest trend anymore, it's still fun, entertaining, and surprising to bump into other players while on adventures. I'm no gamer girl but I'd surely keep playing and exploring!

One star only because cant give less. The game was great, then Niantic disabled the in game tracker, and went after everyone who attempted to   help make the game continue to be enjoyable.  With no way to actually track the pokemon I actually want to catch, the game has become way less enjoyable and the experience not worthwhile.  Maybe Niantic will listen to its customers and make some changes but all in all I recommend steering clear of this company.

Not worth the time or effort due to uncontrollable aspects of the game. Things like type of throw, fruit used, or even poke ball are minor factors in catching a Pokemon. Fight a Pokemon and wear them out, they're rare, so you go all in, and miss catching them after 25+attempts. Then you hear the same problem was experienced by other players. The frustration and effort are not worth it.

Long time Pokéfan, and a lover of Ingress. This combines the two beautifully. I'm more than happy about the change in playstyle, as it gives a fresh perspective on a deeply beloved franchise. I'm curious, though, as to whether the developers plan to add any content to interact with other trainers or not. Update: ABSOLUTELY loving the new additions. Trainer battles are insanely fun! if I could add another two stars, you bet I would! 7/5.

I'm very of two minds about this rating, played as a casual game Pokémon Go can be great fun and a good way to encourage being more active. But if you want to play it as a game first, you run into events that continue to have load and stability issues 5+ years into the game's run and bizarrely tone-deaf responses from Niantic. Keep it to a light activity amusement and you can argue it's a five star app, try to go further than that and you may also find those stars vanishing in the dawn.

Doesn't use notification categories and the recent event notification spam can't be opted out from within the app. Bugs take forever to get fixed and sometimes regress. Most parts of the game just take too long to play (sending gifts, gym battles, especially PvP). Recent updates have been greedier (trying harder to guide you to paying to win). Has always had tons of cheaters that ruin any parts of the game that involve interacting with other players (e.g. gyms).

The game is fun, but when you live in rural areas it forces you to stop playing after a certain amount of time. There are no pokestops for miles, so the only way to get any supplies is driving around. But with pokestops having a speed limit for when you can spin them, even if you're a passenger, you can't spin the pokestops. Without being able to spin them, you eventually run out of supplies and you can't progress anymore, so you just can't play anymore.

So much fun, seeing lots of places I never would've gone to. So many people I never would've met. The only issue might be the police issues there have been many folks are very oblivious to their surroundings and seem to be causing many disturbances. However it is amazing to see so many people out and about. Would be better if it buzzed out of app when a more rare pokemon was around or pokestop.

Fun and good way to pass some time. I've honestly been playing since it's release. Not something I log into every single day. But I do pretty often. Since the introduction of online battling it's a good way for me to kill as much time as I need too and rack up some stardust. I've rarley had issues with the game in general. The most recent updates have been awesome and have made the game much more enjoyable. I'm a level 32 steadily making my way to 40. Hope the raise the level cap soon though.

How have i not rated sooner? Pokémon GO is an Incredibly fun game that I have played on a regular basis since release!! If I wanted to complain, it would be about the constant updates, but I can't really hate on regular inprovement. No ads, which is rare these days! Sometimes a little slow, and hungry with data, but that is to be expected. Graphics are kinda buggy, but it's funny rather than annoying. Friendly community too. Great game to keep chuldren active, especially these days. Stay safe!

It's certainly a fun game (for long time players). In order to play free, you need irl people playing it or put together groups.. otherwise you're paying out of pocket to get certain Pokemon (any raid Pokemon aka legends and etc). 90% of content is behind a paywall as well. Many events are also catered toward higher level trainers. Overall, a lovely game but isn't for new players/ VERY pay-to-win/ collect. If you're a Pokedex completionist, expect to spend A LOT of IRL money in this game.

Works fine until it stops letting you login, about a week or so after you make a trainer club account. Been locked out of two accounts now because it says I failed to login. Very happy I never spent money on this - it would have been a complete waste. You're better off playing a real Pokemon game on a walk - at least you keep your progress.

Overall not bad. Big issue I have is that it seems impossible to catch rarely encountered pokemon. Use a golden raspberry, an ultra ball with a "great" throw and it immediately escapes and runs away. What's the point of the encounter if its impossible to catch? Needing to repeat those throws multiple times to catch is understandable for difficulty. But if it immediately runs away then it gives no opportunity for the catch. What even is the point then??

So the basics of the game itself is fun to play. See what pokemon show up near you and then throw balls at it. Trading and working friendship is also great, and helps with your Pokedex. Gym battle system has improved leaps since it came out. PvP will clinch it. My only complaint now with it is the tracker system; fix it so one can actually track specific pokemon without wandering around aimlessly and fruitlessly. Or let the 3rd parties take over again.

Fun for casual play, but if you're trying to catch legendary raid pokemon, forget it. Unless you happen to have extremely good RNG, the lack of consistency in space (how far the pokemon is from your "position"), the small number of pokeballs at your disposal, and the extremely low catch rate makes it extremely unfun and unfair. Despite having been playing Pokemon Go since launch, the only legendary Pokemon in my collection are story-based ones that are a guaranteed catch.

The game is fun, but I ran into two issurs since yesterday. MY AR camera doesn't work, it's just a black screen and then it crashes. My second issue is with the location. I can be at home, yet it says I'm in the next town over before switching to another town(one of which I have never been with my current account). Other than these? Good game, but the bugs need to be fixed since I can't even play with my buddy without it crashing everytime and having the reload the game.

I have been playing this game since a few days after launch, staying through after the popular craze faded. Niantic has done a great job over the years with keeping the game fresh, offering new objectives, Pokemon, challenges, community events, etc. New ways to play are added every year. The gameplay is good for casual and dedicated players. Glitches are rare but fixed when they do arise.

Spring 2023 Update: (unfortunately due to googles word limit I'm having to replace my original 2 reviews). Pokemon Go has gone down hill. I've been a daily player for years and have seen a lot of good and some bad with the game. As of late its more bad than good. Remote raids have been capped at 5 per day and the price doubled. Niantic cares more about receiving player's location data then about the player base. Its sad to see a game going so down hill and the players being treated so poorly.

I downloaded the game for my 8yo but due to WiFi boundaries, he couldn't play it, so i put it on my phone. I have become addicted to finding Pokémon. Unfortunately, I have had to log in numerous times and change the password even more. Now I am unable to even log in. Don't know what the issue is but I'm getting ready to toss the game. Something needs fixed.

Update: Distance tracking while walking, biking is still 3 to 1. Personal data collection in exchange for fixing errors with the game? No thanks, you ensured I'll never use Adventure sync. Read the patch notes. If you don't like spending money, this game won't be for you. You can get 50 coins a day, that's 1500 a month. Need a fix sync for Poke ball plus, Pogo plus and Gotcha.

Hi, I've been playing Pokémon GO for a long time, and the game itself is not bad. However, if you live in rural regions, it is pretty hard to progress. Another bad thing is that if you don't buy poke coins, you won't have space in your backpack and/or pokemon box, and it is the problem I have right now. Even if I place my pokemons in the gym, it doesn't give me enough Poke coins to buy anything, making the game almost unplayable(quests).

I loved pokemon go when it first came out, it seemed like such a great idea, bringing pokemon into the real world and I eagerly awaited updates for new pokemon. But I dont really get to go out much, which isn't a problem of anyone's but my own, but I wish there was a pedometer system instead of a mileage/distance system.. I understand the aim is exploration but I'd like to be able to play and enjoy at least the egg hatching mechanics as I walk a lot at work.

Routes? This update is horrible I can't do the missions as these aren't available in my area at all. I spent money on event tickets and then didn't even get the items of the event. This game has gone way off track and it's making it hard to complete anything latley. Trying to get legendarys at this point is impossible still playing but really disappointed.

I love playing with my daughter and her friends. we enjoy battling together. awesome. it now gives you a bit of your walking when there is no game on nor little go unit monitoring (way too much battery to have them on constantly). if in small town you dont get enough ppl to battle big egg monsters so we wait once a year to do big battles down for sdcc. do not like the gifts being reduced and harder to get, but not like the egg drops are unique monsters a anyhow...

In the recent update, the game won't even load. It just gets stuck at 3/4ths of the game being loaded, before staying that way for who knows how long. Fun game, but not fun when it's refusing to load. Internet is not the issue, it's just not loading, no matter how long I wait and try to get it to load. Like walking around seeing if I'm just at a weak spot and stronger internet connection is elsewhere. But it isn't. It just will not open. Please fix this so I can get back to playing this game.

Due to the recent uodate, I was able to play it yesterday and now I can't even load the game. I cleared my cache, uninstalled and reinstalled the game at least 5 different times. Now it's saying i have to wait for the developers to fix it when they just use updates and that's it? Awesome... Fix your app, Niantic. 8/17/24 Edit: it has happened again and I cannot even open the app! What is going on????

I've been playing this game since launch day. It's had its issues, but never as bad as it's been recently. Bringing your buddy out to play is freaking impossible after the latest update. Which is ironically hilarious because it was actually improved a few updates back and it didn't require you to find the silly pokemon tracks. Now they just don't spawn, and when they do, it's impossible to find them. If you find them, your buddy is just flipping out all over the place. Hope it's fixed soon 🙄

I love the game, hands down one of if not thee best mobile game out there, that being said the one main problem with the game that I've found alot and I mean ALOT of ppl(myself included) have with the game is how money oriented it is. You can only earn 50 coins a day from gyms and no other way to earn coins and the smallest (discounted) box they have is 480 coins. Which means you have to save for 10 days to buy said box. I think that's pretty ridiculous.

The pokecoin mechanic really needs a change, no reason to have a pokemon in a gym for longer than 8 hours. Master league only has 6 pokemon in the meta, making it very boring when it's the only league available. Besides those two points, the game is taken care of with events, new additions to the pokemon you can catch, and new ways to get items, like AR scanning. Pretty good game.

After three years of playing, the game still has it's clutches in me. The game is constantly updated providing additional content. The bare bones game was already fun in its own right, but since it's release, we've seen amazing additions that made game play so much better. Every time the game begins to get stale, Niantic releases an update to breathe new life into the game. This game beats all other AR games on the market and is the best Pokemon game available on Android.

The game is cool but it's poorly made, would have been better if they made it like a Nintendo game where we can walk around in game with some joy stick and be able to travel around the world in game, not everyone has the luxury to travel to places especially with gas prices high. Also y'all missed the concept of having to fight with our own pokemon to catch others in the wild so that's another let down. Fix the game and it'll live up to it's actually potential.

When the game actually works, it's awesome. However, right now, the game won't even load my save file. It's done this several times in the past as well. It's completely unacceptable that as much as stuff costs in this game that it's completely unplayable with as much as some people pay for add-ons. This review will remain 1 star until they fix this far too prevalent issue.

I would say it is great, but everything is force funded, and none of the shiny pokemon from Pokemon go look any different than their original forms. The events are virtually no different from regular gameplay, so the whole set up is rather disappointing and lack luster. The evolution manner is neat, and the original forms look pretty decent, but beyond that, the game has no real purpose, other than getting large groups of people all in one location, and bank info.

I have been a loyal customer, and truly enjoyed the game. That is, until my account was charged numerous times from an unknown source. Google was able to confirm that my account had been hijacked, however Niantic refuses to resolve the issue on their end. I was refunded for the charges to my bank account, but my Pokecoins now show a negative balance of 43,000+. When i contacted support, I was told they would not correct the issue. BEWARE!!!

Currently heavily bugged catch rates for insense. Over a week: <10% catch rate for great throw on green, and 0% for anything else (including excellent on green). This is for several hundred throws over more than a week, and not a problem for non-insense. What is supposed to be one of the most exciting parts of the game where you can see different Pokemon than usual is just flushing items down the toilet.

I started having sign in issues every single time I logged in after the major update this year, and now I'm getting an error message 15, and I was told that my account was suspended. I was never told why, nor did I ever get any notice of this suspension, I simply can't log in and keep getting that error message 15. I tried getting help, but after "the team" decides you're guilty of whatever reason (you won't be told), they simply ignore you. I have played the same way since the game started.

I've literally gone to 20 different pokestops and they've all said "Try again later", I didn't get any items from them. Everything else in the game was working except for when I spun pokestops. Please, fix this and give everyone a few items because its really difficult for me to get pokeballs when I can't get pokestops. I've literally ran out of pokeballs and I can't get more :(

The overall game is fun but there's alot of problems that can cause others to not have as much fun an example of this is people who live in more suburban type areas there's barely anything there, this is probably why some people resort to spoofing. Some missions require you to catch certain pokemon which some of those pokemon are not available at that time so you'd have to wait until they start spawning again which can take months. There is a lot of other bugs but these are only main problems.

I've been trying for three days to fix my game. It's not counting steps towards egg hatching or buddy journies. I've done every solution online nothing worked I synced it with google fit, still nothing. Now I've been waiting for 2.5 hours to get someone to help with tech support. That's ridiculous I have a lot of eggs that should be hatched now but I'm stuck. I'm uninstalling because it should not be this hard to enjoy a damn game. (Never got tech support 8 hrs later.)

I've been playing off and on since 2016 and I used to love it . But now the prices are way to high , for events there are always glitches where the game freeze and you have to restart the game, They put a limit on the amount of remite raids you can do per day.. They don't listen to what the players want. They do what they can do make more money.

Love the concept but it left out some of main features of Pokemon, (such as battling, and trading. You can only battle in the gym. There is no way to battle or trade with friends, no way to interact with your Pokemon after being caught.) All these features are need to make the game really great. All of the features mentioned in my original review have been added to the game and the wait has been worth it.(updated 2/21/19)

This game is worthless without the ability to spoof my location. I'm a gamer. I sit at home and spend way too much time and money on games so I don't have to leave the house. I do not go on four hour walks across town to follow routes and find gyms. I Idly flick pokeballs at things while half reclined on my couch eating chocolate chip cookies. This game has so little substance as it is but then limiting even that to the players unless they go walk for hours is missing the mark entirely.

Haven't played this game in years, but I got back into it recently and it's great! There's an additional feature if you have a Niantic account that lets you look at gyms and routes, but not Pokestops, unfortunately. There's also a power saver mode, which definitely makes a difference, albeit slightly. They've also (obviously) added more Pokemon since I had last played, including the starters from Scarlet and Violet and some Hisuian Pokemon, but from what I can tell, no Hisuian evolutions.

It is a good app, rather my only complaint is that the pokeballs or anything else that you'd expect to be free or at a small cost is not, and the only way to get these items are to pay, and it doesn't help when you aren't looking to spend any money into it and only looking for pokemon to transfer, i would love for Niantic laps/game freak to make a in-game currency like every other pokemom game, but other then that love the app (probably will delete it after awhile 🤫)

Have been playing for years and never had any issues until the recent update. Now the game crashes more than it works. This is seriously frustrating and in the past, Nantic has been responsive to complaints, but surprisingly now they are nowhere to be seen. This on top of shortening the community days to just 3 hours is making me look elsewhere to spend my time and $$! I think Niantic just killed PokemonGo!! 🤬☠️☠️

Overall a fun way to pass the time, but I wish there was a way to suggest qol improvements to the dev team. I usually leave my game on while I'm doing things, but miss out on raid invites because there's no sound to alert you to them and by the time you get a push notification to join, the invite has expired. You should look to add a chime of some sort to the game for when puerile invite you to things

I would give this more stars but It's already froze three times while trying to catch pokemon in the area. I've wasted countless items only for the game to freeze, causing me to not only lose all those items for nothing, but also lose the chance to catch the Pokémon. Every now and then the PokeStops don't work or the game will just freeze all together.. its been a few years now and I just don't understand why it's still like this.

I love pokemon and all, I've been playing it since I was a little kid. But nowadays its starting to bother me because of many things. Everytime I try playing my music while having the game sound effects + bg music muted it lags a lot and my music turns off constantly. Plus, team rocket is the most annoying thing in the entire game. Anytime you beat team rocket sometimes they come back right after you beat them. Not to mention, pokemon updates so often, too often in my opinion. Nothing changes.

The berry thing in the gyms is broken. Too many squatters. Nothing to prevent teams from taking all gyms in the area and hoarding them. Glitchy. Network error. Questionable RNG. Money grab. Tasks and the like have become useless and don't keep up with the players. Inaccurate weather. 4-5 star raids are useless unless you can plan last minute to get a bunch of people together to even have a chance. I've tried several times to work with this game and have only gotten mad. It's not worth it. ✌️

Overall a good game. Catching, trading, transfer to main games, and raids usually work well. The AR environment is generally well populated in major cities. Lots of events. Go Battle League has some bugs - patience is required. Prices on some stuff has gone up a bit, which is lame. Getting stardust (free in game 'currency' for powering up Pokemon) is grindy and rewards can sometimes be decreased which doesnt make sense. Still a must have game for any Pokemon fan and very fun to play.

I started playing this game on day one. As someone who grew up playing Pokemon I absolutely loved the game. However, with the recent change in remote pass cost I can't continue to play. I prefer to raid in person but enjoy remote raiding as well. This game is actively working to make it less inclusive and increasingly difficult for rural and/or disabled players to do raids. I can't continue to support a game like this.
