If the update could be reversed, the game would be great. Please keep the pandemic changes. Having the remote raid pass, the increase size of stops, and gyms is what helped bring this game back to life.

An entire game based around a gimmick. Once the novelty wears off, the gameplay falls flat. Very grindy, very slow, with little thinking/skill/effort required. In addition, the game has severe technical problems on some phones. The app is unstable, and will frequently freeze or crash (or crash your phone completely). It runs slow, overheats your hardware, and drains battery. You will need a higher end phone to make it work well.

A Rediscovered Gem with Some Glitches Review: I recently rediscovered this game after taking a break for several years, and I must say, it's still a lot of fun. However, I've encountered some frustrating glitches that have hindered my experience. Firstly, I've noticed an issue with the game not registering my achievements accurately. For instance, today I threw three great curve balls, but only one of them was counted. It's disappointing when your efforts don't reflect in your progress.

I've played this game since it launched and it's come a long way in terms of features. However, the Go Battle League needs some serious work. The amount of lag that happens is quite infuriating and has cost me many lost battles. Your losing is also kept track of, which adds an extra stinging reminder to the situation. For a company that's made an ungodly amount of money off of this game, you'd think they would produce a more polished product.

So I absolutely love all the things that we get to do during this COVID 19 lockdown. But with all the app updates, it keeps freezing my game so I have to restart it. Unfortunately, I had to restart the app right after I beat the Team Rocket Boss and before I got the chance to rescue the Pokemon. And my super rocket radar is gone so I don't have the ability to fight the boss again. I'm irritated. Please fix this issue. I like playing this game but if it keeps freezing up I won't play it.

I was in the beta and it's very rare that the beta has less issues than the actual game. I have to force close to app several times just to get it to work properly. It freezes often, doesn't allow me to make selections, often does not allow me to get Pokestops, and freezes pretty much any time I try to catch anything. I'm heavily disappointed in the functionality. Update 6/6/19: Still have to force close often, raids have been made harder and often when you beat them out says you time out &lose

I have played from the beginning. The changes made for the increased pokestop distance was great for the pandemic, but also great in general. It made it easier for many people. I don't understand why it was changed back. I think in some cases, the distance is even smaller then the original distance. I was able to reach a gym from a parking lot pre-pandemic. Now, I can no longer reach it from the same parking lot. Bad decision Niantic!!!

I've been playing about 5 months now and while the game itself is very fun and I do enjoy playing, the glitches and crashing are constant and becoming very frustrating. Not only does the game take a long time to load, sometimes I'll wait several minutes on it to load and it will instantly crash when opening, which means I have to start the process over again. It also has a bad problem dealing with a temporary signal loss.

I've been playing the game every day for a good while now, but the past few months it's been frustrating because of all of the glitching and freezing. It especially freezes during my daily incense use which is beyond frustrating. On top of that, I have trouble opening the app every time. It either goes black or stops loading all together. I have the newest Samsung phone and still have continuous problems after updating, uninstalling, and reinstalling.

I've been playing this game since before it went public. Had a drop off for like a year and half then got back into it. Currently level 42. Upset as of late that the game has quite a few game breaking bugs for weird form factor phones. I got a Z Fold 2 and it has ruined this game for me. There are things that only work on the outside screen or the inside screen. I get it's a specialty phone that not many people own but this form factor is gaining in popularity. Please add UI rescaling.

I've had ongoing issues with logging in since I set up my account in July. Constant "failure to authenticate" notifications. It seems like I was lucky just to get on when I could. I'm very disappointed this time because I was looking foward to the new trainer battle. It's a feature I've looked forward to since the app was developed. I suppose I won't be participating in battles or anything in this app anymore. Hope you guys fix the log-in issues before you add anymore new features.

This app has improved a lot over the years. However, like many people im upset about the new updates. Most of the stops and gyms near me are on private property, for instance one gym is on hole 8 of a golf course which used to be accessible from the road but now I would have to trespass to access it. I've played a lot less since they rolled the distance back. Please fix it.

Updated: A fun game. They continue to have a few bugs with the sheer volume of content they are pushing out, but it does keep the game new. Based on what I am seeing from various statistics sites, some accounts are definitely more apt to get the "random" extras, or unique items in the game (not sure why or how). Fun to play without paying, but to complete certain events or advance quickly will require you to pay to play.

I do wanna start off by saying, I just Love Pokemon Go, but there has been soooooo many bugs/issues since the last update, I installed. My AR mapping scan tasks freezes up the app and you have to close out app and restart app. Then when incense is on, you go to click on the pokemon and if it's too late to catch the pokemon, but you already clicked on it, then Boom app freezes up and you have to start right over again. Just way too many errors anymore, but I still play as much as I can!

The network communication failures really hurt playing the game. Very frustrating when it freezes catching a pokemon, in a battle, or simply logging on. Fix your code so it handles dropped packets better! If I was to guess, you are using UDP, when you should be using TCP. It is terroble when I see full bars on 4G LTE and can't get a response! The only fix is to kill the program and restart it, often several times. Also, fix it so it remembers settings! The music, sound, and battery saver!

I mean it's a fun game and a great concept but poorly executed. I started playing this game again recently (the first time I played was when it first came out) and the presentation is very underwhelming. The music sounds awful like its been recorded on a device and muffled. The characters are stiff and really underpolished. Not looking for something crazy but anything is better than this. Also looking at reviews from seasoned players makes me sad I missed out on previous incense rates and such.

Played when it first came out, dropped because it wasn't great. Came back to give it another go, dropped it in less than 3 hours. Nothing's really changed for the better IMO, and is actively worse in others. For example: the game constantly harrasses you to give camera permissions, even though it can be played without it with no issues. There are more stops in my area than before, but the same boring loop with garbage progression is there, and the extra events do little to break that.

This game is really fun with lots of new updates regularly. I would give it more stars if the game didnt crash every 10 mins. It has become really hard to play because of how often it will crash and my phone will return to its home screen even in mid battle or mid catch. That is very frustrating. I can understand not loading to start, but once I am playing there is no reason for it to crash mid game, this is unforgivable. Please fix the constant crashing and I will give more stars.

This game is alright, but like any other phone app it has its drawbacks. It runs fine for me, no technical issues or glitches. I got it originally when it first released, but lost interest. I redownloaded it last year and it's improved, but some things are unnecessary in game. First off, you need to be able to delete those missions with 2-3 separate things to complete, not everyone can do them because many don't even have a pokestop near. Also, fix my pokemon spawn. They almost never spawn now.

I like the game . Been playing it for a while, but i really dislike the frequent crashes and loss of location. My avatar keeps freezing making the app crash and close entirely or making me restart it just to catch up with the fact that im walking. Now im not sure if it's my phone being so crappy, i have an LG harmony lite phone, but i do notice alot of other people have the same issues. Would LOVE it more if it didn't crash so frequently, but i still try to play.

It needs some bug fixes. Here are some if not all the issues I'm having with this game. 1. The loading screen gets stuck constantly and is super annoying. Also, if you wait, it won't load the rest of the way. 2. Unknown Battle Errors. When Battling Team Rocket, once completed, it hits this error. I end up wasting resources. 3. When playing, it just gets stuck loading and freezing. I also am playing on a brand new phone plus a new account and honestly a horrible experience for "New Players"...

Too expensive for a "free" game. I've loved this game for years, but am highly disappointed the creators are constantly looking for ways to make it difficult to advance in the game without spending more money. Please make your features more affordable and accessible to those who live in more remote areas. It's a shame to charge so much for remote raid passes. Worst update choice ever. Won't be buying remote raid passes anymore.

It was fun...but then all of the sudden I started getting this one sprint ad popping up during weird times. I went to figure out what it was by letting it sit on the ad. Then the ad gave the new pokemon go thing asking if I was taking a break. So I uninstalled. Other than that...the app helped me lose 14lbs in 2 weeks for the military so I'll change my 1 star to a 2 or even 3 stars. Update: I did 2 stars. The ads were too annoying. They were popping up while I was using Chrome and Tor.

Look, I've been playing this game off and on since it first released years ago. We all remember when it was wildly popular. I left after a bit but when COVID hit and they added remote mechanics for raiding and gifts I was thrilled. However, a few years later to now and they've decided to make it just too difficult and expensive to play remote now. The changes they've made negatively impact the community in various areas. I hope they reverse the changes and if they do I'll come back.

It is a very fun game and I enjoy it plenty! However, the calibration is way off. In addition, you need internet to play, which makes no sense since it's a game where you walk all around. I don't have seevice, therefore no data, and can only play at home because of this. I would suggest a recalibration option that allows the app to locate the player more accurately. I live right next to a pokestop, and despite being just a few feet away, my character is JUST too far away.

This game is near entirely pay to play. Costs $2 to even attempt a raid, and then you play a minigame where you easily can run out of balls. $2 per try. Pay for your chance. Odds not disclosed. Prices for items in game are variable, as in, each player has a different real world price for the same item. The goal is so pay to win that almost every QoL improvement, like having any space, is a purchase in the shop at a obscene rate.

It's a wonderful game and I've been playing for quite some time now, but I must say it does need to be fixed here and there: For example the way remote raid passes work tend to mess up, raids tend to kick people out, the loading screen sometimes freezes, the game tends to crash every now and then, but other then those issues this game is perfect for a explorer and a collector! I diffently think you should download this game if you can get up and move around. Thanks for reading this!!

It is great, but I am having a problem with the app itself. I've now had for two days in a row, with a short break in between, problems with catching Pokemon and spinning stops. They will flee first try and the spins won't spin. I also won't get my candies from the select transfer method. I've g It,one to the extent of uninstalling almost every app on my phone, including this app, and it only worked for a few hours. Otherwise, the app is great, and is fun to play. Such a great time killer!

Game is no longer meant for casual players. Leveling up takes forever, and they added even more levels. Features will be locked behind those levels I'm sure, and it can take you actual months to get a level. Sad to see. Completely ruined the tracking system. Can no longer track one Pokemon. Have to shift through ALL the ones around you to try to get to the rare one. No way to tell when a raid will happen unless you you keep every gym in sight, which sucks... It is getting better though.

Game is a good concept and ive even worked out a problem with my account on my end and i still cannot get back in to play. Oh well. Another App gone. Game bites very much so if you dont travel or unable to. Its fun as a tinker yes but not much more then that. If you live in an area thats high population, game can be good, but if you are stuck in a low population area, dont bother. It is not worth more then a few rounds before you find your limitations to your location. Good luck.

I still can't take pictures! It's very disappointing since so many tasks require pictures to finish them. It would be nice to have a fix for the last update!!!! The newest update kicks me out of the game when I try to take pictures! Please fix the ability to take pictures. Now when I try it shuts the app down. No, my camera works perfectly outside of the game and yes my app has permission to use the camera!!!!! No it isn't my device.

I enjoy this game but I have been having massive issues with adventure snyc for the last 3 weeks. I walked over 4 miles today and it did not register a single step I took. So NONE of my eggs hatched. Very frustrating and all the hthings to fix it make no since as I don't even have those options. It's to the point I'm really thinking about just stopping. I never had this issue in the past. But it's constant now and upsetting.

Pay to win. If you're playing casually to collect, just play the games. It costs so much money to upgrade your item bag, and your Pokemon storage, and they dropped how much coins you can make without paying to an obscenely low amount. It's not possible to have a living dex without paying a lot, and you can hardly catch everything from even a single gen without spending. Not worth the trouble of starting, but if you've played in the past it's worth opening up again to see what's changed.

**EDIT: I've updated my review from one to three stars because they've made some positive changes over the years. Even though I still REALLY miss the footsteps fun times are definitely to be had.** This game, as bare bones as it is, still has potential to be fun at times. Removing the footstep tracking was an idiot move, though. Will continue to play when I'm out and about, but will not be paying anymore money for items. I'm sad I wasted $30+ on this screw-up.

This game... It needs more. More species of pokemon, trading, 1v1, and more pokemon in certain areas would be amazing. edit: They've really rewritten the formula with raid battles, trading, 1v1s, the redesigned gyms, and field research missions. Still not a perfect game, and took too long to update it enough to get it to this point, but definitely worth a shot if you haven't touched it since it first came out.

I had to reinstall this app because my phone crashed. Now app keeps saying it's not compatible with my phone. Worked fine just hrs before the crash. Not at all pleased. The first part of this was written in 2017. It is 2020 and I'm still playing because I like the game, but have bought 3 phones too keep up with all the extras that keep getting added on. It still crashes at will all the time and won't let players raid like its supposed to, even when you are at the gym in person. It's just bad.

I come back to this game time to time cuz I enjoy playing it. I come back to it today for the first time in who knows how long, I updated the app cuz that's what I needed to do to play and all that keeps happening is crashes. Gets kind of annoying when you're trying to catch something or battling. The whole game just crashes and goes right to my home screen.

Edit to original review (below): Updates have ruined more than helped the game. I rarely and I really mean rarely get nanab berries, great balls, or any eggs besides 2k. Has been this way for about a year now. Also, 75% of my wild catches run. It's fun, addictive, and a great way to want to get out and about and socialize. Servers have issues, but doesn't keep me from playing every chance I can!

Its been 5 long years since I first left a review. And the game has managed to stay alive in all that time. While the hype and player base from summer 2016 is way down, the game has improved and become something fun and interesting to return to even when i leave for extended periods. The game is a bit hefty so if your phone is older/dying it might not be easy to play with the constant lag and freezing. Aside from that, I dont have any complaints

I highly enjoy the game. Its fun and addictive. Yet, lots of problems. One, sometimes it freezes midway of capturing a pokémon. Sometimes it just freezes randomly. Second, servers are always down, it'd be good to add more soon. Some things you could add to make it better are more pokéstops in areas that barely have any or only have a few; same goes for gyms. You should also add a feature where you can add/friend other trainers, and maybe something where trainers can trade pokémon with others!

Continually freezes. Almost unplayable. Fun game when it does work but that's a big 'when'. Still needs vast improvement. Have lost a lot of good pokemon due to game freezing in the middle of a capture. Addendum for 2021 i would like to revise the stars to 4, the game is actually playable now, started playing it again to share the experience with my god son who is very into this game. Well done Niantic.

Concept? Great. Especially from someone who liked Ingress. This game? Complete garbage. I've had about 11 server errors. Despite relogging and restarting my GPS. When I'm on Wi-fi, the map loads. When I'm on data like everyone else, it takes forever to load. Pokéstops never load and thus I miss the items. If you guys make this game better and actually playable, I'll try.

Revisiting this after a few years. Still annoyingly reliant on the user having a high-end phone. Now I have one, and the problems arise with consistency and the intention of making the game fun. Unskippable encounters where the pokemon is supposed to be "given" to you are a mess. Adventure sync is good. Weird geographic limitations on pokemon feel ridiculous, but it's whatever. Wish spawn rates were higher in less populated areas, but I get it. Battles are fun.

I love the game concept itself. It could be a wonderful game... just my opinion on some of the mechanics of the game. Which i hope they are working on. Niantic has gotten better about fixing bugs and giving us some content we want. But still has a long way to go i believe. Like similar games has alot more stops to get items from than go does.. but game is much improved since launch

Decided to give it another chance, and was sorely disappointed. The GPS issues are crazy, at best, it freezes and tells me I shouldn't be driving when it catches up (this is when I'm on foot), at worse, I have to restart the game for the GPS to update my location. I don't have these issues with my other GPS apps, including Ingress. The game had issues before, that's why I stopped playing, but now it's almost unplayable

Currently, literally unplayable. Can't get into a single catch without white screen of death. Years later, and still feels not ready for release. Bugs, crashes, freezes, and random framerate death make it often unplayable. Balance issues galore and no action taken against cheaters. A huge battery/data drain, so play with caution. And now, a new feature that completely locks up. ..bravo.

This game has came a long way from its launch phase. The game play is fun, engaging, and gets you out exploring. I will say, however, that if you like in a city you are going to have a far easier time than a rural player. The game is definitely geared towards high population areas, but can be fun if you can find other local players. And if Niantic would ever do something about the cheaters, it would make the game much more fun. Nothing like competing against unbeatable opponents.

The app was ok, glitches and bugs here and there but overall it was stable. The concept got old a little quick as it was nothing more than a mini game compared to any actual pokemon game. I know new improvements are being made, but a long time has passed and the interest is simply not there anymore for such a repetitive concept. It was gun, but now it's time to say goodbye. Thanks for the fun times :)

The game is fun and addicting but needs some work to fix bugs. Update: game has made a lot of improvements. The next step in this game should be the option to see other trainers on the map and interact. Battle, trade, gift, etc. Another would be the ability to battle wild pokemon to make them easier to catch. I think we all wanted a live version of the original pokemon games/platform

The game has come a long way from where it started I played when it first came out and stopped because of frustration, picked it up after 3 years and I am happy with the changes and enjoying it, just fix the switch connectivity once I connect to the switch the 1st time the second time it doesn't connect unless i forget the switch and re connect.

I originally played this game back in 2016 during it's "Hype" phase. I stopped playing due to some issues that the game had back then. When I decided to download it again at the beginning of this year (2021), I was almost immediately hooked based on all the updates and quality of life changes that I've missed. There's no doubt that the game is 10 times better than it once was! Be careful though, I ended up spending over $100 trying to get shiny Heracross in raids and was unsuccessful. Bad odds!

Reminds me of my childhood and brings back a lot of memories. I wish the servers were more stable. The last problem I had with GO is that I have no pokestops near me and the closest one is 3km away and I don't have access to a car. Even with these problems I still think is deserves 5 stars! Way too many game breaking glitches should not have been released!

Edit: great fun and great way to exercise. it was really buggy in the beginning but it has improved greatly. only thing i would include is the ability to contact friends in-game. I really, really, really, really want to like this game. It's just too buggy. The servers are always down, I waste 5 pokeballs to catch a Pokémon and when I finally get him, the game freezes and I have to kill the app and lose my pokéballs and the Pokémon.

Great concept, but very buggy. Game crashes frequently and the servers are down at the least once a day. I lose pokéballs everyday because the game crashes mid-catch. It needs a turorial where it explains how to play more in-depth because the instrutions it gives you are not very helpful. Also I think there should be a log in bonus everyday of a few pokéballs or something. Overall it is a very fun game that gets you up and moving but it needs alot of work.

Updated for the new versions. When it works it's great but the new battle arena is full of issues. Constantly freezing or lagging is very frustrating and being an important part of the game it sorta ruins all the joy. When it works though: Fun diversion when you are out. Kinda dull if your just in one spot. The fun is about hunting for the Pokemon in the real world.

I've played since day one of release. Lots of bugs & lag to speak of but still continued to play. However after almost 4 years of playing, they decided to do an update which errors and changes my nickname to include a random number in it. Tried to change back to original it says the nickname is unavailable.. Contacted support: "We're sorry but we are unable to change your nickname, however feel free to change your nickname to what you would like." I would like my old nickname back. Uninstalled.

I love this game, really got me motivated to be out and walking around, until it won't let me sign in anymore.. literally the passed almost 2 months I've tried to connect the app tells me "unable to authenticate" day after day in row! I might as well uninstall the app sense I can't play it anyway... Very disappointed at the length of this issue :( 👎 **Can't this be fixed? **It was never like this until the end of the summer**

I played at launch and soon after dropped the game because it was a mess. It was unresponsive and buggy. I had been so excited for this game and was so thoroughly disappointed I dropped it until a month ago. I started playing because I'm trying to make a living dex and need Meltan... This game is honestly amazing now. A lot of changes and additions, theres a lot to do, a lot of freebies, and its fun. I came back just to get Meltan and I was going to stop after. I'm still playing and loving it.

I've been playing this game since the second day it came out, and I mean PokemonGO has come leaps and bounds above what it used to be. However in 2025 the game has 1000% lost it's fun motivation. You always get the same pokemon, over and over and over again until you're sick of the game. It doesn't matter where you travel now, all the Pokemon are still the same. It's very boring and makes the "search" for them 0/10. They took away the main point of the game and it has suffered greatly.

Again, after update, in the middle of an event, this app has issues. December Community Day and I'm doing the special research when I click on my reward encounter and the screen goes white. No matter how many times I exit and reload the game it stays white. Even after restarting the whole phone it stays white. So, I guess I can't do any more for this event because the game is acting up again.

Great game, fun to battle w/ against other people. Nice to get outside and exercise more. But I wish that they would add a purchased/your outfits category in the outfit picker. It's annoying having to go scrolling through all the other stuff to get what I want. Also wish that when you bought the extra storage space, it added a little more space.

Love the game play, the concept, I don't even mind that my phone doesn't allow the AR function. What I DO mind and hate is that the game keeps signing me out for no reason. Even after I was able to play with the recent next generation update, it signed me out after exiting twice with no problem. I don't know what's going on, but this is frustrating. We need solutions, not more updates. In short: fun game, very frustrating bugs.

I have played this game since day one. I have encountered problems here and there which can be frustrating. However tonight has me completely livid. I went to log in and it asked me to update. It wouldn't allow it. I did all the troubleshooting and decided to delete and redownload well now I can't get the app at all! I went to the support down below and sent a message to the support and I get a reply stating I need to log in to troubleshoot! Are you serious! How is anyone supposed to get help!

Niantic got one thing right by adding more customizations. Then they got 10 things wrong with such an unpolished end product. The player looks like a missing link. How does it look like it's slouching and not at the same time. The hands are so wide for both models but it's not like a masculine wide. It looks like it belongs to a malnourished gorilla. I'm thinking of transferring all my pokemon and calling it quits for this game soon.

The new battle pass system is blatantly money hungry. At least make upgrades the same price as research tickets ($5), not $20. I have played this game since day 1 and always appreciated how optional in-app purchases have felt. Now, advantageous content (like the newest item) is locked behind a battle pass upgrade. Makes me want to uninstall.

Game has been on a downward trajectory. Niantic only seems to care about the money from whales and user-location data. Raids suck, research gives boring/ bad rewards, everything is way too expensive. Not to mention a lot of the changes they've made (i.e. remote raids, etc.) Been playing since 2017-ish and been burnt out for way too long and just had to install. It sucks because I like many really loved this game.

Since 2016 I have played off and on, have gotten to level 40, have 1,300+ Pokemon, have completed many raids, 99% of them being remotely due to various reasons, and I have had a lot of fun doing so. Now however, remote raids have doubled in price, been capped at 5 per day, & forced people to attempt to meet up in person to do all these raids. I understand this isn't "how the game used to be", but we also used to have to ride horses to a general store to pick up our flour. Backwards isn't good.

Game keeps crashing lately. Was trying to catch gigamax but game crashed. I lost my chance without using up my white pokeballs. I spent money on getting extra particle too. Wasted money and recources. No it wasn't my internet, my other apps were working well. The game's server is probably unstable. I had the same problem in the LA tour. My friends had the same problem during last year's LA. It feels like with every new event comes new bugs. When the game finaly stablizes, new problems pop up...

More crashes than a Destruction Derby. Fun game when they can keep the servers going for more than 10 minutes at a time. Without the crash issues I would definitely give it 4 or 4.5 stars. Update: Game doesn't crash anymore. The kids love playing. I just bought them the pokeball plus though and am having issues with it recognizing it.

Update: app was working fine but then an update on 10/30/18 is not working out. It downloads but cannot install it. Going to try again might uninstall then reinstall. This is a really fun game, but the app freezes ALL the time. Slow loading on androids is what i found but better on iPhones. I lose Pokemon's and balls when the app freezes. Takes a while before it loads too. App had frozen on me on average 20 times a day. Almost ready to give up playing it.

Everyone that I talk to hates the grunts and wishes they were never added. They waste time and agravate when they pop up. They add No enjoyment and we wish we could eliminate them from our game. How about making them optional! 8/6/20 I have gotten to 40. I think that you should be able to keep on going higher. There doesn't seem to be much need to accumulate points anymore. On special raid days Niantic has a lot of problems with screw ups on the game. But, I enjoy Pokemon so much.

I've only had the servers fail on me once and the new nearby search feature near pokestops helps me from wandering aimlessly into the distance. The game has really become more stable ,but if you could please increase the spawn rate a bit more I've gone walking for a mile without pokestops and found no Pokemon to catch ;C. Overall a great game that is sure to stay in the spotlight for a while.

Love it. Great reminder & new take on collecting 'em all,from when I was a kid, but I'd really like to see more player interactive-options; trading, team building, training, etc. .. Now they've added player battles, among the friendship leveling, that is not restrictive to proximity! Not to mention trading & Adventure Sync! Getting better every update.

This is such a bad game. You can't battle or trade with your friends. The only battle system that exists is at the gyms, and it's basically fruit ninja, no strategy. Worst of all the only way to lvl up pokemon is to find more of the same type. Also, the game is not balanced at all! Last I checked, Vaporion was the strongest pokemon.

Changing my review to reflect the ever-constant need to continuously update what feels like once every two weeks or so. I don't understand why they need to issue updates so often. And after the last update, whenever I battle anyone, it keeps saying "weak connection" even though no other aspects of the game lag whatsoever. So I guess I'm taking a break from this game until someone can tell me that the constant updates are less frequent. I shouldn't have to update an app this often!

The game has slowly been on decline, but changes made during the pandemic made the experience better. Now they're making those pandemic benefits less accessible and more expensive, telling us its "for player experience." The game isn't in a great state right now, and Niantic doesn't care for its players, only its wallet.

I've played this game for years and it's always been a fun way to pass the time for a Pokemon lover. I've ignored minor bugs and issues as I was still enjoying the game. The recent price increases from Niantic alongside limiting certain gameplay is just a poor choice in my opinion. Especially trying to cover up the want for more profits by saying this will "balance the game for all players" is just gross. Really disappointed Niantic

Pokemon go use to be fun and as they introduced features during the pandemic, it seemed to adjust the game to allow it to become more accessible. However, they are now trying to remove or discourage use of those features. Example being remote raiding. Not everyone can pack up to go out to raids. Instead of discouraging remote raiding, encourage in person raiding more. Increased shiny chances, candy, catch rate, damage, etc. This is not a pokemon world, stop trying to treat it as such!

All of the reviews citing leveling update woes are 100% accurate and correct. Rollouts are done terribly! I've never seen an app take up so much space and have so many updates but nothing actually improves. The goals want you to catch 20, 30, 40 pokémon in a day or a week or a month, but you don't get half the items to do that with, so it's geared heavily toward pay to play now. I have to go through periods of inactivity because of a limited storage space for Pokemon. Shame. It could be good.

The number of bugs in this game is absurd. It's almost every other day (sometimes several times a day) where the game suddenly "fails to sign in" over and over for several hours. The game used to be a lot more stable, but it's honestly been the last year or so that the quality has plummeted. Sometimes, after healing my pokemon following a battle, then going into a gym battle again, it will forcefully switch the pokemon to the last one used in the previous battle with the health it had before.

Really takes forever to level up, I try to play with my friends but it takes forever to level up when you're in the country side and there's no stops or gyms within 20 miles... and we're too young to drive so it's not an option, kinda wish temporary stops were a thing or something similar. Even pokemon hardly spawn nearby at my friends house, like there might be an eevee for two minutes and then when we try to find it, poof it ran off before we got to it.

The game used to be great when they put more care into bug fixes, stability, and just overall game improvement. Now, they release exclusive pokemon that you cannot even catch because of bugs where they disappear the second you click on them. Events have also been extremely buggy preventing myself and others from participating. Don't even get me start on battling other trainers in the leagues (pvp). There are hackers and bugs everywhere. If you are an android user? Iphone has an advantage.

Edit: Now that the developers are focusing solely on new implementations into the game, the function is awful. The balls will often not throw, will throw to the side when you make it a curve, and the game lags out at crutial times. Not to mention the camera to take a picture of the Pokémon STILL has yet to work on my phone. The Pokémon merely stays stationary in the middle of the screen. Function really needs to be the focus right now. Not adding in new gens.

Its a good game but catching the legends are so hard, i've participated in a few raids and the legends were super far. It makes it so much harder to catch them if they're miles away, and thats excluding the fact that they always jump and they're attacking (?) it would be nice to have them closer or if we were able to have a more balanced count of pokeballs to use

The game was incredibly fun and I had played this for years. However, my frustrations with this game have only been increasing during and nerfing the remote raids has been the final straw. Niantic does NOT consider the player's experience at all and is constantly increasing prices and giving little in return. I'm really tired of hoping that the game play will improve for the best, but honestly it never does and I'm no longer holding my breath. 2/5 for nostalgia and the good memories.

I enjoyed this game for a long time, but back in May there was a bug where evolving your buddy crashed the game and made your account unplayable. That was a month ago, and I finally gave up hoping they'd fix it. Was a great game, but leaving show stoppers in production for a month puts an upper bound of the lowest rating on the game and the company.

overall I like it, but GPS can be a huge pain during critical moments of the game. Character spawns take some of the excitement away at time with how difficult and sometimes how illogically they appear. Very frustrating when you are trying to complete game tasks. Would like to see an extended search feature that let's me lookup in game common areas for pokemon locations. Would make my phone feel like a real pokedex.

I really love this game! Being that my husband plays it with me it is really fun!! That being said, we live in a major city, and most of the gyms have just... VANISHED. they're totally gone from the map. He has more gyms on his map than mine, and this has only been since the most recent update. We will look on his map and there's a gym right above us, then look on mine and that gym has just.... disappeared??? Would be 5 stars if they could fix that and give us more face/hair options.

Going in the wrong direction. I love this game but there is will a coming update that will greatly affect all players in a negative way and right out kill the game for rural players. I genuinely think if they make exploring and going out and interacting an overall more giving experience. Players will be more likely to go out vs limiting and increasing activities that you can do from home. Wouldn't recommend this game until things change.

With the new remote raid restrictions after just introducing scatterbugs from across the world, this app is making some highly questionable choices regarding their player base. I am very sad about them and am leaving this review to make my voice heard. A lot of issues occur due to improper preparation on Niantic's part and a lot of people lose out on time and money due to them. Overall the game is fun but the heartache and frustration needs to be addressed.

I used to play it often, up until they started adding in Alolan Pokemon. I think it started messing up once they added the Ultra Beasts, but it is really bad either way. The game struggles to load, and will most likely crash before it's done loading. If it finishes to load, chances are your character and Pokemon will be pitch black for some reason before crashing, and it can't be my phone since I have Dragon Ball Legends on here and that doesn't struggle at all. Niantic, please fix it.

A fun way to explore the city! I've found a lot of neat places in Spokane while playing. The spawn ratio of Pokémon needs adjustment. Some Raid Pokémon are overpowered and the style options for avatars are limited. ( One hair style? I'm sorry, but changing hair color isn't enough variety. Grant us different hair cuts!) Would be nice if the game alerted you when a friend was close enough for trades or battles, and a broader diversity of ways to gain evolution items would be great!

This game is a lot of fun! I normally play for a half hour or so each day, but since the latest update I have been so disappointed. I really enjoy listening to music or audio books, but because the new update seems to have blocked those apps from playing games simultaneously with the game, I find myself playing less and less. It's a shame. UPDATE: They fixed it and I love it! The ability to playing with my friends has really helped me during Covid times.

Pokemon Go is still Pokemon 'No' to me two years later. That isn't to say the game hasn't improved tremendously. It has with Community Days, trading, battling trainers, step counting, and a plethora of creatures to capture as each generation comes, though it feels as if some killer apps and features could have come earlier on. Easily a title for towns and cities with a lot of historical value and the walkers, but not for the sedentary. Give it a Go, but it still, for people like me... 'No'.

This is the biggest waste of time. The game has no depth, unless you call swiping in the right way to throw a pokeball "depth". I'd also rather go on a walk and NOT look at my phone. Where are the battles? I see a thing-but oh, I guess it's not working... The fact that catching pokemon in this game is a nestalgia insta-capture with no combat or difficulty at all makes this incredibly drab and boring. I personally would recommend just getting a switch and the most recent pokemon game.

I really like the game. It's a good way to pass the time, and get out the house and do something. The only problem I have with it is how much it freezes up. I've lost 5 different pokemon and a 2 5K eggs do to it freezing and me having to restart. Plus in a later update I would love to see the option to trade pokemon between trainers I think that would be an awesome feature to have.oo. p

Its better now than below review! Not so many freeze crashes. Still enjoyable though. My game freezes a lot in gyms. To the point where I have to force close the app. Uninstalled and reinstalled at least 2 times. It's playable most of the time and I enjoy it but sometimes it's buggy and not fun at all. edit- it's much better now....

Been playing this since it came out for androids. Despite any glitches or shortcomings it has had along the way, it's still a solid game. Not p2w in the least, but worth doing if you feel like paying back after you've gotten a lot of use put of this game. Great to play and share with othets, started playing this game with my partner, and we still play together to this day. Astoundingly, we are only levels 35 and 37 (max 40) as we play casually, but that just gives us more incentive to play.

I really enjoy this game I've been playing it almost since the beginning. The new release today though has been rough. when a new Pokemon has spawned and I try and catch it but I throw my ball it gives an error messages than I lose the ball and the character. Unable to fight in the gym that won't load, the map is not loading and the pokestops are not showing up. I think it needs a little debugging, please text I really looking forward to the new spawns.

Already lost about 3 high level pokemon from the game keeps freezing. Now in 2020, when you open the game, the news pops up and you click on to view it. While viewing, the "an egg is about hatch" notification pops up and it freezes. You click on it and nothing happens. So then you close the whole app and reopen it. You have no clue what hatched. Fix this please, its annoying.

I just find there could so easily be more done to streamline the accessibility & make this a worthwhile experience. It feels empty to a degree; pay to win; & the sheer grind can wear on you heavily. Small, user-friendly additional content would go a long way. This game yearns for a Tamagotchi-like component, as well as a way to show off your Pokémon to others. Unfortunately, as it stands, this is as barebones as it gets, & with so many paying so much, it likely will not change. Give a little.

There's so much potential in this game but Niantic ruins it at every Turning Point. Recent changes have shown that this game does not care for its rural players or those who may have accessibility issues. Their communication is god-awful & there are more glitches that I have ever seen. This community is so strong and yet the game is hell-bent on running it into the ground

I had an account, I was at level 10, I was all good. Then out of nowhere, I got logged out and it wouldn't let me log back in. I use my google account, but it just kept saying "Unable to Authenticate. Please try again." I uninstalled it for a while out of frustration but I recently reinstalled it when I saw the cool updates, and it still won't let me in! I don't want to start all the way over. It's a really cool game, if I could only log into the game I would go back to a high rating.

It's a good way to spend time outside but to many glitches, errors out and crashes at least once a day. Stability is needed. Trainer fights are good,Raids good, Gyms could use a little help. All around, a great way to get families and friends to spend time together outside. Good way to meet new people and bring community together.

I can only give this app 3 stars at the moment. There is an annoying bug I get sometimes where the game crashes after I throw a pokeball. This causes the catch to not register and I dont have the pokemon but the pokeball is wasted. It's very frustrating. Also the music really repetitive and dull in my opinion, (this is more of a personal thing) but fortunately I can mute it. Other than that its a pretty cool game. Im glad it motivates people to get up, move around, and possibly meet new people.

On Galaxy S8+ and for some reason the game no longer save pictures I take in game. Both in AR and non AR. I don't get any errors but it doesn't have anything to my gallery. They just seem to disappear. I've uninstalled and reinstalled the app and it still won't work. I'm not sure when this happened since the last time I took a pic was during Squirtle day.

This is my updated review of Pokemon GO. I originally rated it one star but have revised it now to three stars. Although tracking only works if you are tracking a Pokemon to a pokestop. Stability of the app has improved over time and the addition of multiple generations of Pokemon has added a lot of flavor. Things still aren't perfect but it is much better than it was during the first gen. There are still a huge lack of pokestops in my area and the only way to suggest a new stop is if you lvl40

Difficult to run on weaker phones, it's sad that some of my friends can't play. Some connectivity issues, forcing me to restart the app. Despite the technical problems, this game is rightfully one of the best on Google Play. Have grown as a person because of this game, and happily set time aside just to play. Will remain one of the staple games on my phone.

I just got back into this game and there's been some negative changes that kinda ruin the game. For starters, you can only win 50 coins a day, which means it would take at least 6 days to get enough coins to buy the smallest box, speaking of, the qualities of the boxes have dropped so now it's more for less. It's difficult to collect PokeBalls (especially when you live in a more isolated place) because you get three PokeBalls per stop and sometimes that's not even enough to catch a pokemon

If your starting out, please listen to the tutorial because there's much more than just running around catching pokemon. Trust me. Once you get to know it, the game is extremely fun and great to play with friends, even if your not walking around there's still loads of things to do, I definitely recommend. Update: I also feel there are some significant negatives. The number one negative is catching the pokemon after raids. It is nearly impossible to catch it even if you use a golden raspberry.

Really enjoy this game even though it seems it doesn't run as well on android in comparison to IOS. Been playing for years and there's still features I wish that were in the game. This game can he very repetitive and when you can't skip and evolution scene or a purifying scene ect. It's draining because it can take hours to transfer all the shadow after purifying them.

Let me start off by saying yes, I used to play this game a lot. i mean a lot a lot. But now barely at all. The game has become pretty much unplayable. Not do to errors or glitches. But I've caught every pokemon available in my area. I've done all the raids trying to get legendaries. I've signed in for 7 days to get the same pokemon over and over again. I've walked and hatched more eggs than I can remember. Just be disappointed every time with the same pokemon. Im done at this point.

For a free app with no ads (except some spon-con) Go offers a decent Pokemon collecting experience, albeit with some glaring design issues (my opinion as a long time Pokefan). The ability to progress is tied to traveling to as many stops and gyms as possible to get items and coins. This is grueling for players in sparsely populated areas. These players are forced to fall behind or make in-app purchases for more resources. I would love to see some scaling in resource costs to help these players.

The recent decrease in radius to hit pokestops has made me decide to stop playing. I work full time and can't go running around town all the time to hit these pokestops. It was easier and funner to play when I had two that were right at my job so I could collect items easily to catch my pokemon when they came up as I walked around work and other places for errands.

Overall love the game and concep. My app experienced issues like.... not seeing Pokemon after putting lure, being kicked out of guns during a raid, phone freezing siding catching, spinning or fighting, I have a number of suggestions or possible updates like sharing items, exchanging items for an upgraded version and more. PS some of these issues may be my cell.

I was excited for the launch, but the servers have put a real downer on everything. The actual game layout is amazing and if Nintendo and Niantic follow through it will be 5 star worthy.
