An increase in healing items would be greatly appreciated .

Game was fun for a while but....the game runs super slow (always has despite the technology available nowadays), takes up a lot of space on the phone, and maps still haven't updated to show my entire neighborhood and was told it wasnt going to be updated (lived here over a year now) or other major parts of my large town/small city so cant play unless I want to drive somewhere farther away. It is also harder to catch pokemon during raids as well as shinies and perfects are nonexistent now.

Gameplay continues to improve and get players to come back, but I fear it will never be as popular as it was on week 1 even though at the time it was virtually unplayable. However, location services no longer settle for the standard mode and requires you to use "high accuracy mode", which consumes more battery and doesn't guarantee it will be accurate enough to play

I have started playing this game a few days ago. It's fun to actually go outside and explore, especially with friends. I have a friend and his dad used to work for pokemon, that makes him a pokemon nerd. The thing is, even with my friend teaching me How to play, it's still astonishing how the developers were able to make it that hard to learn. Overall, it's a good game to get you active, but there are a lot of glitches and bad game design. It's hard to learn and playing it feels weird.

After the last update, I started having problems with gyms and raids. When I'm battling a gym, the battles freeze randomly preventing me from finishing a battle even if the opponent has no health left. In raids, I get kicked out of lobbies/raid battles resulting in me losing my remote passes. Also, I can't join other players in the same lobby, even if we joined at the same time.

Entertaining but frustrating. They finally bring trading into the game after countless requests from players, that is what finally got me back into the game. I've ruined 6 Pokémon total trading between my wife's and my game. They make trading so useless that is not worth it to even bother. Stupid game design choices like this is why I stopped, and probably will again. I hope they fix the terrible trading system eventually, I'll consider playing it again.

Good game. I'm not really into Pokémon but find it fun to play with friends. However, I can't buy coins, and parental controls aren't on. A glitch, but annoying, hence the lower rating. Overall, if you have a friend who loves pokémon and wants you to get involved and play together, this is a good game to do so. Edit: While I still have the glitch, mods were very helpful in trying to help, so I changed my rating to 5 stars for being nice and helpful.

My kids and I play together. They've been having trouble with items and Pokemon disappearing. We've talked to customer support multiple times and all they tell us is to change the password. We do, then new Pokemon and items are immediately gone, never even showing in the inventory but it will show in the journal that they should have it. So we can't play anymore.

The game itself is very fun, but some quests require a little too much work and the buddy system requires way too many candies for the rewards you get. The most important thing keeping me from rating 5 stars is that the app is so incredibly slow. All of my friends encounter the same issues of the game taking forever to load just about everything. The app has crashed on me about half the times I've dared to open it and it's ridiculous. Overall great, but a lot of errors. I love it though.

Pokémon Go! is an adequate time waster that rewards you for going outside. The deimplementation of the original tracking system was the worst thing to happen to the game. Integration with Google Fitness is great. The gym system is less oppressive than it was in its first year, though actual battle gameplay leaves something to be desired. Trading with friends was a welcome addition, but friend battles would be cool if they improve battle gameplay. Large cities are favored over rural areas.

Okay, so I have played this for quite a long while now, but ever since i got my new phone and made a new account there's this glitch. The professor tells me to catch the Pokemon but they are all spawning under my character , making them uncatchable. Please fix this, it would really love it if you guys could fix this and make it playable again. For those who don't have this problem, you all are very lucky.

I usually don't rate things but I figured I should after this last update I haven't been able to login in due to being sent right back to the login in screen after being able to login. Contacted support and have been getting gaslighted for the past week about not having the correct username or password when I have played this game almost on a daily basis since it started. Their support team is the worst and has yet to actually listen to me about the problem.

My grandson wants to play this game. We tried to set up a kids account but Niantic's servers would never send the email to validate the address or to logon to the game. Support could only copy and paste an invalid answer. Despite requests to be escalated to a level that could examine the issue and resolve it, they continued to exact same answer over and over for over a week. Needless to say it doesn't work. Niantic is refusing to fix it.

Pokemon go is a pretty killer game. Unfortunately they keep having server problems causing the game to freeze, crash, and sometimes not even work. Gotta expect this though with this game just coming out, considering how the game works. When the servers are doing good the game runs smooth though. Will change to five stars when this is fixed. Edit: I marked at 3 stars just for server issues back in 2016. Just started playing again and I 100% give 5 out of 5 stars 🌟 🌟 🌟 🌟 🌟

The game is broken now. Very glitchy, laggy and keeps crashing. Pokemon at weak levels are difficult to catch, they are pretty much at legendary catch rate; they always break out and/or run away. Raids are broken, when defeating a raid it just gets stuck. I lost a Virizion today, never even got the chance to try and catch it. Had to close my app because it froze. Also everything is in app purchase based now, feeling like a fool now.

Nice to have Pokémon on Android/iOS. Great that it gets myself and others out and about. This concept would be much better on mixed reality devices and would be better suited for random encounters that feel more like Pokémon and not a ball throwing simulator with a difficulty curve that appears to be Higher Level = Harder to Catch ANY CP Encounter. Also, sensitivity on curveballs is oddly off for my device. No way to tell where Pokémon are. Pokémon are limited to spawning in hotspots (Ingress).

I love the game but progress early on is not free. I wish there were more ways to get poke balls other than buying them or having to go to gyms to get more. I also wish that pokeballs that don't even hit the pokemon were reusable. This would make the experience much better and more enjoyable for new players. I also would like to see gifting that was specific, so that friends could send special gifts that contain items their friend might need (like pokeballs, potions, revives).

Rip off.. you pay to get coins to get raid passes. You win the raid, but most of the time, the pokemon will run off. Then you end up wasting your pass for literally nothing. Also, note you catch them with excellent catch with berries too. The game shop has also increased in their prices as well, making it more difficult to get items. This game is a headache to play.

Over the years it has kind of gotten better, but it still suffers the following problems - Pokemon that can break out of the first throw and run away. Feels really cheap and like they're just out there to waste your balls - Performance is awful in the friends list. Even on high end devices it runs horribly - Tap detection is awful in many areas. Often I'm trying to select a pokemon but end up tapping a gym or stop instead I hope these can be fixed in the future at some point

Love the game but I am constantly having to redownload it because it gets stuck in at "unable to log in" at least twice a week. If I hit "log in as different user", then I get "unable to authenticate". Only way to get around this is to uninstall and reinstall but it is getting to where it is not worth it and I am finding myself not as active as I used to be out of annoyance.

Im just trying to activate my account. Ive asked for the email verification four times now and have waited well over the two days but it still hasn't shown up. Ive had no response from any of customer support. I had my original account i need help with the password i waited months to hear anything and have tried over 7 times to contact anyone. Finally in order to just try to play at all i had to transfer my email to a new account to even get this far. Im starting to get very upset.

Things that would make this game better 1. Ability to see friend codes so we can share that code with nearby friends. 2. Give xp and candy rewards for reaching best friend status 3. Hold more research tasks than just 3 or 4 5. Allow unlimited research tasks from pokestops and not just one per spin 6. Ability to see how many more days it will take to get to the next friend level. 7. Ability to see what friends have not given a gift in x days so we can delete them and make room for new friends.

The game is great and all, my problem is that it stopped letting me play as it required me to sign in, and even after entering my password, it just starts the sign in process over and over again, overall it's a great game, it's just bugs like these that bother me, I had to uninstall the game and reinstall it, good game, bug that needs to be fixed.

Was 5* dropped to 1 with the latest update. I was excited and happy to see we can change hair and our facial features a bit. But the loss of the original face for a not so good looking rip off one, isn't something I wanted or would want. And for the other 6 variants of facial features, literally every single one is deformed ugly. Being forced to see myself in bottom left corner with forcing me into this ugly look. No thanks, no more money from me and probably quit playing before too long.

Would rate 1* if they weren't taking action to scrub reviews. #hearusniantic. This game was fantastic for so long but now that they are raising prices exponentially and providing no authentic new content for over a year now. I can no longer say this game is worth the commitment. The game has also been rife with bugs and UI issues for years now and is getting worse. Niantic, it's not too late to fix the damage done, but it needs to be fixed.

What's most disappointing is the lead up and excitement to the game and being let down once I open it. Servers are regularly down and the game freezes very frequently. I spend a lot of time quitting and reloading this app. Reliability has not changed since recent update. Years down the road reliability is still so-so. These days what's disappointing is finding out we were all just used to create maps and mine millions of dollars of data out of.. and then Niantic sells out, with all our data.

I used to love this game, been playing since the first month it came out. Niantic does not care about its players and making the game enjoyable for them, has turned into a big money grab for Niantic. Anymore their changes just take things away from the players and increase cost for them. Events always have glitches. Guess I'll be saving money now and have more free time for enjoyable things, it was fun until it wasn't.

I have fun playing the game, but I have one big complaint: The game doesn't properly track my km's with adventure sync at all. It doesn't need to be perfect by any means, but this is far from. My Pokémon Go account says I did like 17 km's this week, and my friend who I was walking with THE WHOLE TIME got 43.6 or something. How does that even happen? All of my apps are updated, I just don't get it. This has been an ongoing issue for some time now and I'm not sure why it does this. Niantic fix.

I sunk 2 years into this game. Good times, met a ton of new people, had my fun. Now, they're holding gen 4 over my head too much. I just wish they'd release most of them, straight up. But I love the PVP. Took 3 years lol, not much into it now, but I had to update my previous 3 stars from when it first came out. It seems like they ironed out most the bugs and lags. Thanks for the memories, PoGO!

The game is great, but the support is terrible. I love the game; it's like stepping into one of the old Pokemon games I grew up playing. They have done a good job adding new features and improving the game. Occasionally when I try to log in, I get an error and an option to retry or log out. Either way I can't log in, usually for several days. It's very frustrating. With no individual customer support, all I can do is wait for the problem to fix itself.

Before this past couple days this was an easy 5 star. As of lately the game will not play. Even if it does load the 1 out of 20 times it either gets stuck on a black screen or quickly freezes up. Or runs so slow it is unplayable. I have lost raid passes, missed opportunities to catch pokemon, not to mention the wasted gas driving to town to hit the populated areas. All this during your Mega Kangaskhan event. Super pissed I missed out on that because your app was broken.

An entertaining game early on for those who love Pokemon and you can now bring them in to your world. However, you'll realize the limitations if you have a handicap and can't do some tasks such as make 5 great curveball throws in a row. Additionally, if you live in a rural area, there are less pokemon to catch as well as poke stops you can just "walk" to. You have to be level 38 to submit a stop suggestion as I've wanted to place some good rual areas. That level is 2-3 years of play.

Definitely a money grab. But functional. Make it more like the Pokemon games though, Pokemon centers, item stores for in game (non-gold) currency, give us TRADITIONAL Pokemon gyms, maybe NPC trainers. It's come a long way, I have played since release and I am level 32 so there is appeal, but it's feeling quite transparent as a microtransaction farm aimed at children and juveniles. You can play for free, but boy is it a slog.

This game has so many glitches and problems that make it unappealing and unplayable. From Pokeballs glitching out of the game, to the impossible stardust limitations, charging the price of 15 apps for a single event day, it's a mess. This is a huge disappointment to a fan who has played Pokemon since the game started. This game is a huge waste of money and time.

I used to gather my family and friends to play this game together, but Niantic became very greedy. We would buy passes, take time off work and still no enjoyment, just stress on these timed events. Then they got more greedy taking more and more fun out of the actual game, the free to play or minimum pay model is no longer viable for the company obviously. I have been playing since beta, my partner has been playing since day one. We both deleted the app after the news of yet more money gauging.

Overall, a fun game to play. Rated 4 stars due to a variety of bugs that do occasionally take away from the experience. Definitely worth checking into for a Pokemon fan, or someone that needs some motivation to exercise. It does become a bit lackluster if you live in a small town without a lot of stops or gyms, though.

Pokemon Go certainly had it's issues during in launch period in 2016. Tracking was non-functional, servers constantly crashed, and bugs galore. In 2018, 4 generations in, the game is great. Trading, raids, friends, hundreds of Pokemon, quests, and much more. Fantastic game for any Pokemon fan that helps get people active.

People are complaining in other reviews that it's not as cool as other Pokémon games, but it's a free app. It's unreasonable to expect it to be as good as games that were made to be sold for consoles. Also, people say your Pokémon can't get stronger without spending money, which is also not true. I will admit that the servers get overwhelmed a LOT, and this makes battling gyms VERY difficult, as well as catching pokemon. I will come back to rate this 5 stars if they end up fixing that.

Great game with great story, cool characters. Sadly Niantic has turned this fun game into a frustrating mess. You'll have fun when your not bombarded by pop up messages right before you spin a pokestop or try to catch one while riding in a car. Or GPS stops working. Edit: still had it's problems but the community is what makes this game great. Niantic has tried and it shows. They still have a bit to go but it's improving. Still needs work tho

Update*---improvements have been made. Glitches are taken care of quickly and seem to be less frequent. With the recent update on the pokestops and the already present glitches...all we see is the "you're going to fast" warning. Walking, bicycle doesn't matter...you can't hit the pokestop. I've been lucky to restart the app a few times to get it but for my kid, he just gets angry and shuts it down. Needs better updates guys...

Niantic has proven time and again to have no idea what their players want. Most paying customers are people who don't have the time or ability to drive to where others are playing. Instead of developing ways for more players to be able to participate, Niantic is constantly pushing an agenda of excluding players and trying to charge them more for less.

level 40 is standard for most casual players since the level cap hasn't been raised since the game came out in 2016. level 40 is extremely boring and slow rollout of each new generation is extremely disengaging. i want to love this game, and i used to. now it's just boring. I've got better things to spend my time and money on that are engaging and challenging.

A game that falls short on every aspect and tries to use Pokémon as a crutch. Ask yourself, would you play this game if it were some other knock off of Pokémon? Only the familiarity of the brand keeps people's interest, and barely at that. The game needs to change allow you to explore without GPS. The idea that the game is entirely based around location severely limits how much a player can do, especially for rural players or higher-crime areas, or even for daily weather or natural climate.

I really love the nostalgia of this game. Combined with the real world map and AR functionality, this is a great game to enjoy with family and friends. I really enjoy working together on the raid battles or taking down a particularly tough opposing gym. I'm always excited when there's a Pokemon I haven't added to my Pokedex nearby! Overall, it's a great way to spend an afternoon exploring your city with some friends.

Played since day 1. One of the only mobile games I'll casually drop money on. Their recent decisions to limit play experience is unfortunate. However no other game matched the experience you get from this game. The new app from Niantic, Campfire, adds potential for creating another dimension to the gameplay. If done right, I feel like it adds the engagement factor we all got from day 1.

Very fun game and for most of it easy to play. I do have some problems though. like lvling and evolving pokemon is dumb also the trading is not the best as well. i mean who decided that if u have never seen a certain pokemon and wanted to trade for it. it will cost 100 times more in resources? and on that note y does trading even take resources to begin with? other than those complaints it is still very fun and i will continue to play. I wanna be a pokemon master!!😄

Decent enough game, thought with ingress they would have smoothed some stuff out. There is no getting out and exploring! If you are not in a city you need to buy incense, which cost way to much for only getting 6 Pokémon over the half hour. If you can't just sit a pokestop for hours on end its terrible. Not to mention I need to stop doing everything else in my phone. Needs a lot of work to be enjoyable. EDIT: Very much enjoying the game, great updates since launch. Playing with friends.

I love this game. There are a few things I wish they would change though. They have been adding all these new things (items to evolve, gifts, TMs, rare candy etc.) but they still have not increased the bag to hold items! I earn those pokeballs, berries and potions and have to turn around and delete them. Same with the cap for holding pokemon. I also think EVERY gift should have an egg if you have a spot open. I invest a lot of time and money into it and I get very disappointed wasting either.

Still can't abandon completed field research. If you're low on pokeballs and have skipped the last 6 hoppips to save resources the game doesn't care. You're still getting one in your field research and even though the game calls it a "reward" it's worthless, can't be abandoned, costs resources to collect, and takes up a slot in your log. Also I'm locked out of battle league until I "accept" my reward. A pokemon that won't run and had busted out of 8 great and 3 excellent throws.

Niantic has stripped the heart from the app. Increasing the cost of remote passes and limiting the number of remote passes allowed to be used on any given day has driven me to greatly reduce playing for the most part. The new 'Routes' aspect of game play is typical Niantic BS. Doesn't work for me, non functional, incomplete, can't create nor find routes in my area. Stay away new players.

Level 45, played since the beginning. The grind was real. Especially living in a rural area. We made the game better and the community grew. Remote raiding made the game more approachable and ultimately made Niantic a lot of money. The last several months remote raiding had been constantly attacked by Niantic and the latest jab is too much. Done. Uninstalled. Bye.

The adventure sync is spotty. Especially since the last update. I've turned it off then back on, got the notification that it was enabled but has not worked for over a week now. I've restarted the app and my phone several times. It has made me use the app less and is very frustrating. Especially when there are incubator events.. I know several people that have been having the same issue. Please fix!

The 'catching pokemon' part of this seems to be broken. CP seems to have no bearing, the color of the target circle seems to not matter, the curvature of the throw doesn't matter, and the berries no longer seem to have an effect after two or three. Even using more powerful pokeballs seems to be pointless. Also, transfering Pokémon should offer a few more candies, especially if the Pokémon your transferring has a higher CP.

It's gotten so much better over the years and it actually gets me to go out and walk. I enjoy it for the small goals and tasks, and battling is fun every now and then. Really just needs a way to IV train and trade from far away and it'd be fantastic. Seriously needs to remove the restrictions on trading in general.

Niantic has run the game into the ground 3 weeks after release. No communication at all. Removal of core gameplay features. The game isn't even version 1.0. It's still in beta. Disaster. Edit: well, it's been a year since the game launched, and we STILL don't have features that were promised in September 2015 like PvP battling or trading.

I have played Pokemon go since the first hour of its release. Their ability to keep me playing all this time later is impressive, with constant updates, consistent changes to the game,beautiful graphics,and being able to bring people together and make new friends like no other game out there, Pokemon go, for me,can be summed up with four simple words. I JUST WANT MORE

Pros: it gets me up and walking around. The animations are lovely and bright. Cons: I live in a rural area, so no 'stops or 'mon for miles = I can only play when I'm in a town. No hairstyle options. The landscape is all the same. I wish that you could encounter nearby players in-game. Not a chat, but a marker that means "Hey, this is another player! You're not alone in this endless green!"

I downloaded this game for my son but it's poorly developed and maintained. After a while it became clear to me that the point of this game is to convert micro transactions, not produce enjoyable gameplay. The latest updates brought in horrendous, genderless avatars (he literally cried when he saw his character) and a ton of UI/UX bugs. It is super laggy and keeps freezing. It even takes 2-3 attempts just to log in. It's a shame because he loves walking around our neighborhood catching Pokemon.

A great game to get around and exercise. The battle system has been somewhat improved and the pokemon encounters don't seem as buggy. I stopped playing the game after a couple of months but find myself playing it again with greater delight. The game is good when playing alone but great when you have more people with you. Also a plus if you are exercising.

Its a fun game to play, but it just takes so much of my space. When i go to update it, it says i dont have enough space even tho i just deleted a whole bunch of things. It needs major improvements. I dont spend money on it but sometimes it keeps pushing me to spend. The item bag and poke bag upgrades should add 100 more spaces, not 50. Item bag upgrade could be more than 100, you just get so much items that once you dont have room there isint much to get rid of.

When I made my account for the first time, my expierence was amazing. But the second time I made an account, it was laggy and glitching out. When I went to customize my character and went to hats, I pressed a hat and it just stopped. I tried it a couple times, didnt work. So I went with the preset character. When it told me there were Pokemon nearby, there were just white orbs.....

All the adjustments made only show they want more money. Limited remote raids. Increase in prices constantly. I miss the perks of covid with this game. I still explored outside but loved being able to play when it was freezing outside or I was unable to get anywhere to meet up with people. Can't catch them all if they keep breaking the bank and limiting everything. If it ain't about the money...

You should be able to add people by not only the trainer code and QR code, but also nickname, AND you should be able to add friends from any screen where you can view a trainers name and level and stuff like that like when you go into a gym or when you're in a raid lobby waiting for it to start, there should be an button right there to add that trainer... Because even if you remember their nickname and/or write it down, there's no point because you'd still need their trainer code.

I've been playing the game for years and enjoyed most of it, but Niantic keeps raising the prices of in game store items and taking out game mechanics that the pokemon community really enjoyed. And even though we get events, they haven't added enough new mechanics to the game to keep it fresh and interesting. They have gotten greedy and they don't listen to their customers. I don't need anymore reason to stop playing.

Its fun somedays. There's many issues including the adventure sync. I have miles on my google fit app (not added actually counted like the game requires) and it won't sync. This is a issue for multiple people. Also during community day the shiny pokemon isn't distributed fairly. I went with a group of 5. 1 person caught 8 shinys within the first 30 minutes while 3 of us got lucky at the very end barely caught 1.

Go battle league needs fixed. Even when I'm connected to wifi (fast wifi) I will almost always get the "weak connection" message and die to lag, because my opponents apparently have no lag whatsoever. And half the time when I try to use a protect shield it doesn't register and I die to a charged attack. This game is fun, but it would be a lot more fun if I could beat people instead of just being a free win. I have plenty of storage space on my phone, so the problem must be the game itself.

The game was best its 1st week when you really had to walk around & find pokemon instead of them being concentrated at pokestops. The game lacks depth, challenges, & competition. The new gym system ,while okay for new players, took a ton of fun out of the game. The 50 coin limit per day is greedy it should be closer to 200. The items in the shop are over priced. The game is just a fancy PAY to play/ grind game with no real payoff 4 your time. Swap pokemon for made up monsters & no 1 would play.

Okay one thing I wish that there was is a lower amount of space needed to have this on my phone. Some of us have a lower storage capacity and then have to uninstall other apps to have this game on their phone. If there was like a companion game, like one that had a lost of what pokemon were nearby and didnt show the map and you could have the choice to catch them from the list. And there could be a check mark if it's been caught and put in the pokedex. Honestly this game takes up so much space

Had been playing daily but after the latest update I'll be deleting this app for now. With decreased POI distances and other changes I'm no longer able to play as I'm still self isolating/social distancing, especially with the delta variant, and cannot stay safe while playing. Hopefully some changes will be made in future, as I did quite enjoy having this game be part of my day.

No longer worth playing. Yes they added a lot of extras, however it's clear that are now after money. I remember when events were a $1 or $1.99, shop items were cheap, you could actually earn coins and get shop items now it's turned into a pay for play players. Every event now cost $10-$20+ and the items are just not worth it. I'm a level 37 and spent years on this game. Sadly it's coming to an end.

As a longtime player now I have enjoyed my experiences but I've noticed that the reporting system is either flawed or simply not taken seriously. I have issued a few reports to Niantic alongside a few fellow players in regards to one particular offender and no action has been taken. I'm not one to report another player for a silly offense but it can be easily proven that he is spoofing and still nothing is being done. It doesn't seem like you can rely on the in-game support at all.

I have been playing since day 1, still love this game! Its come so far in such a short amount of time! They really are trying to keep this game so that you stay active and have to get out to reach your goals. so while some people are in their own minds about "covid" (its been done for over a year. lets move on people) pokemon go is still trying to be what it originaly was for people to get out and be able to play a game while being healthy and exercising!

I love this game, just wish things that need fixed and features promised since the beginning would be implemented. I know it takes time and resources, but I figure somethings would have been done by now, and none of my bugs I've submitted have been address or helped in any way, I still play and love it. Just hoping for a polished product in the near future. Other then that, pokemon go is awesome.

Game is a lot of fun... it is good that a game finally figured out how to get people up and moving. This is also a great way for my son and I to bond. He looks forward to our Pokemon hunting adventures. Not really a big fan of the new buddy system... I don't like that I can't earn Candy unless he is fed and out. My berry supply is already limited due to not being able to spin stops all the time (my location and daily life keep me from it not an in game issue)

As much as a like this game it has a few large flaws that are hard to ignore. 1: Server issues. This game has been out for a while and I'm still running into server issues. I haven't even been able to log in for the past 2 days. 2:Raid battles. Yes, I know, they are suppose to be for large groups of people, but as I don't have many local friends raid battles are impossible. They don't need to be easier, but having a diffrent mechanic to catch the legends would be nice to a single player.

Fun for ALL ages! It might seem like a kids' game, but as an adult, I l've found that the augmented reality adds a challenge and realism that I really appreciate. It doesn't require money to advance or enjoy any part of the game (although its very tempting) and it's great motivation to get out and get a little fresh air. The game has increasing difficulty with some very long term goals. I didn't think it would keep me entertained, but its been over 6 months and I keep coming back to play.

I love the idea but it needs more!! It would be great if it told you when other players are near by and playing. It also would be cool if you could battle others outside of gyms maybe the prizes for winning can be smaller or of lesser value when not at a gym. And finally t would be great if we could trade our Pokemon with friends and those around us. If these things were changed then I would rate it five stars all day long.

A great game when it actually works. The game always had trouble loading in and sometimes just flat out doesnt let you in, not to mention the glitches. I just missed out on an EX raid because the game told me that the gym was in a different place then it was. I reload the game, and sure enough, the gym is exactly where it always was. This is not the first time this has happened, and it won't be the last I presume as they only care about getting money, not the functionality of the game.

The recent avatar changes are broken. No one has any issues with more options for personalization and more body types. However, the crothes look baggy, the hands are too big, the torsos too long, eyes look hollow, etc. They even took away features, like your characters just don't/can't have hips now. Worst of all, the pokemon-esque art style they had is gone. They just look like generic sims now. I'm not a complainer, I like the game and think Niantic is a good dev generally, but this is bad.

Niantic actively makes decisions that hurt the game. It's like they have no idea how the game works anymore and only care about gathering and selling data on players. They make it so hard to actually want to play this game. Edit: almost a year later and now they're double prices on remote passes and limiting to 5 per day 😂 Edit another year later: now all the avatars are hideous and deformed. A+ Niantic

I started playing this game when it was released in 2016. Like most people, after about a year of playing I took a small break for close to 2 years. I jumped back fully into the game in late 2018 and have had a blast playing it up until this last year or so. Niantic is showing that they don't care about the players. Times have changed drastically in 7 years since release, and with it so have how players interact with a community, explore the world and play the game. Do better Niantic.

Great game, Routes and route creation could use major work. Tried to make a route that was 3.6 km long, and of course, I can't choose the end point that far away, so I elected to choose end point later. Got to the end of my envisioned route, and it then wanted me to select the start point again before being able to select the end point, which was the same issue as before, I couldn't because I'm too far away! A game that encourages exploration and walking, but only if it's short walks.

I must say it does keep you active which I like. Though there needs to be an option to hide my gift location. I feel like it is a privacy issue displaying where I am or at. It's fine when sending the gift to actual friends and family, but the random people we meet and befriend, is a bit to much information sharing. It Leaves open to potential stalkers. Imo

I've been playing Niantic games since early ingress. Pokemon so far is the most stable updated version. I'm loving the updates. The progression, although slow, keeps the game fun. They release events all the time now. It will have bugs. However, I looked into it. They generally aren't something Niantic can fix overnight due to all the service providers and the sheer number of players.

I have spent a lot of time and money playing the game on my own and with friends. Ever since they nearly doubled the prices of many of the items in the game, and still have not made it easier to naturally get coins in game, I have quit playing. Too often do I feel as though they have blatantly disregarded the community, the fans, and the playerbase. Plus the game's quality has seemingly reduced as it has login issues and crashes too often.

Pokemon Go was way better when they had the expended distance for stops and gyms. It made it safer and easier for people to enjoy. Players were able to spin more, get more items and in turn probably spend more money in game. These shorter disances make it harder for those with disabilities, if Niantic wants to be more inclusive they should go back to the longer distances. I like to take my kid out in the stroller for walks and some places aren't stroller friendly so the longer distance helped.

On launch, this game was a worldwide sensation with real staying power. A lot of Pokémon have been added, and the events are semi regular. The problem comes in their treatment of the consumer. Raising the price of item boxes, reducing the quality and quantity of item you'll get from said boxes, and now limiting remote raid heavily. If you're a rural player, or urban player with s small group size, you're better off skipping. You have to treat me with respect to ask for my money Niantic

Edit 2: I picked the game up again and kept my word on my previous edit. If I could vote another 1 star I would. The avatar model update needs A LOT of work. We have the illusion of more options for our characters, but instead have an awful middle ground for femme and masc chars. Edit: the significant price increase for remote raid passes marks the end of an era. It made playing much more accessible, so now they're more expensive and limited, I won't be spending anymore and will play less.

I love playing this game and experiencing the Pokémon World in real life. You definitely have to grind your way up to a decent level to get the full experience but I think this game is meant for casuals, regulars and those die hard fans. My only concern doe the game at the moment would be that when I use a remote raid pass to join a friend's invite, halfway through the battle I will sometimes get disconnected and ultimately will be unable to join again.

Some games I've played made certain in-game statistics available to the gamer showing the gamer how many: headshots, body shots, explosive kills and so on they've achieved throughout the game. I would like to see the statistics for how many of each type of Pokémon I have caught. Would also like to see how many overall pokeballs I've thrown as well as which type of throw it was (nice, great, excellent). It would be very interesting to see these statistics available to the Pokémon community.

This game is highly addictive and really fun to play. The main issue I am currently having is the adventure sync, it doesn't work well. I know I walk more than what the game is saying, but it just doesn't catch it I guess. One more thing, I cannot connect my Switch with my account so I can connect it to Let's Go: Eevee.

Great game, absolutely love it. However there are some bugs. For example, my bag consistently is full despite the actual contents of the bag being about 150 less than the max (yes I counted because I couldnt believe how quick it was filling up) and connection issues keep happening despite having great connection to wifi or LTE. Not a bug but would also like the 50 coin limit per day to be removed. There's no purpose in beating a gym if you alreafy got uour daily limit.

Worse than the last update, which was worse the the one before. Now NOTHING works. Buddy shows up on top of you, telling you to give it space, then when you move it disappears. Constantly drifting, cannot spin discs, cannot catch pokemon. If one does allow the chance, most throws become spun and fly off screen immediately. Every 4th update breaks this game, then it takes the next 3 just to fix what they couldn't leave alone. Very time consuming and frustrating game. Greedy company.

The game is better with expanded radius for gyms and stops, although users who aren't near either are at a distinct disadvantage. Niantic s slow to react to pandemic developments and needs to retain the radius changes as if everyone is o in the most restricted situation. Disappointing recent paid event didn't deliver nearly the value for the amount paid. Better spawns without incense would be nice. I still enjoy playing and remote raids have increased the ability to play with friends.

I've loved playing the Pokemon games longer than I can remember and having the ability to carry those games into my adult life is such an awesome feeling! The app is user friendly and updates quickly to deal with any bugs. I'd recommend this app to anyone looking for a reason to get outside and strike up a conversation with someone doing the same thing as you! Playing Pokemon Go and enjoying the outdoors.

180 seconds for the raids but they start the counting before they say "go", before you can move or attack. and often there will be a few seconds remaining, still visibly counting down after the gym says time up and kicks you out. also you should expect to irrevocably waste precious stardust and other resources when you open or look at your app and click what you think is one of far too many intrusive pop ups, but is actually a utterly useless powerup. And add a calculator, Duh.

Long time player and love this game in general but there always seems to be issues and it's impossible to get support (literally the get support button is not where they say it is in the help files). I also dislike how the game makes you do research with functions that may not be working on someone's phone, such as with the snapshot feature. My previous phone had a broken camera and my new phone seems to have an issue with the software where it freezes when I try to take a photo or use AR.

The adventure sync is STILL not working! I work almost every day and do a ton of walking and running, yet the app never registers it unless it is open. I can't keep the game open while I work and so I am stuck making zero progress. No candies. No eggs hatching. I have to adult to live. Please! PLEASE! Can't you fix this?! It's SUPER not fair!!

Reduced the rating due to Niantic being really inconsiderate of players. Do not recommend. The number of bugs is too dang high! You can get kicked out of a raid with so many different kinds of errors and lose passes. If you even manage to stay in and catch a legendary, especially during an event in which they are supposed to have a specific move, there's a bug for that, too! It won't have it! You can contact support for this, and they don't compensate you with anything.

Alright, I don't know if anyone else has this issue, but my experience has been terrible. Installed, deleted, even REINSTALLED, and I still walk terribly slower than I should. I sprinted across my yard, and barely even took two steps in the game. Laggy as hell, and won't even load properly 90% of the time. Uninstalling after writing this.

As a new player who's been playing for less than a year, I initially enjoyed this game. But recently with the increase of spoofers with multiple level 50 accounts and no real way to report them, the game has degraded. There are only two ways to gain PokéCoins 1 by spending real money and 2 by taking gyms for 8 hours. So if you don't want to spend money, you must take gyms and you have a snowballs chance against multiple level 50 accounts. As usual, other players are the worst part of this game.

The game is great! It's fun to play, the controls are easy, the graphics and sound are amazing, and there are no ads! That said, if it is your only exposure to the Pokémon franchise, please know that it is nothing like the canon games (that's right, I don't consider it canon- that's how different it is)! My only complaint is that it can be pretty laggy sometimes!

I've been playing since launch, and while I've had many problems with how niantic runs things, overall, I have enjoyed the game enough to still be playing all these years later. With that said, since about the 6th of March, I can not launch the game on any account on any device. Support has offered the same solutions 4 times now, and I have confirmed everything compatibility wise. Kind of crazy to leave a bug this big for so long.

Love hate relationships with Niantic. I've played PoGo since day 1. Even with all the bugs this game was still worth playing. Catching, getting out and exploring were just the foundation. The real reason we all play is the community. Niantic had the chance to make this the greatest game of all time. Sadly lack of communication, bugs, and money grab events may be the downfall of this game. I have gone f2p at the moment and if things don't change soon many will begin to stop playing all together.

The game is alright. It's mostly the people behind the game that brought the score down. They don't listen to player feedback or fix major issues. For example, I've been having trouble defeating shadow legendary raids. My partner and I use the required number of gems, but the game doesn't register all of them, so the raid becomes impossible to defeat, AND the game doesn't refund the gems used. Player support may or may not compensate you with a raid pass (if it's Remy the bot then yes).

I've played this off and on since the beginning. It punishes you if you have any kind of mobility disability. It is so buggy, even after being out for years and years. They can't get this right :( I was excited at the prospect of remote raiding. But the passes cost a ton. And it doesn't even work. Or maybe it's needlessly complicated. Either way. Avoid pokemon go.

Played when it first came out. Started playing again. The raids system are impossible for solo players and the game base isn't as big as it used to be so this system doesn't work well especially in rural places. Niantic also routinely ignores player base requests. The point of the game is that it's fun. If the playerbase gives insight, they should listen. Increase the radius.

I loved this game for the longest time and even paid for it. I refuse to give in to that temptation again. I will not spend a single PokeCoin until they being back double PokeStop distance. It was a quality of life upgrade that we needed to continue as some PokeStops are in trespassing zones, across streets or otherwise inaccessible without the boost. Niantic needs to learn to listen to their players when they are crying out for something to be done. The radio silence tells the tale.

This game is extremely addicting and gets you outside walking around and seeing things you've walked by a hundred times without noticing. It's a really fun, solid game, but the app itself is poorly coded. When it's not having server issues, it is locking up, crashing, or unable to detect your real location. Let's hope Niantic puts some of the money they've made back into QA for the app and the servers. If they fix those issues I will rate it 5/5. Update: they (mostly) fixed the issues! 5/5

Company never listens to its customers, doesn't care what we want, refuses to refund purchases that it makes invalid, and rolls out "updates" that ruin the game for us. Also, most of the in game purchases are insanely overpriced. Stopped playing for years, and really regretting coming back to it. Will be uninstalling again unless serious changes are made.

I played it for about 2 years when the game first came out. Gave it for a while and picked it up again last year because some friends were playing it. Now, the game is a mess. If you live in a rural area, you're screwed because it's incredibly unfriendly to rural players as well as free to play players. It almost seems like Niantic is purposely trying to kill the game.

This game has serious potential, but if you live rurally, you will rarely see even common Pokemon, and never see a single Pokestop, which have been made central to the game's function. It's definitely a game meant for high population areas, which is really disappointing to discover and prevents me and others like me from really enjoying the game.

Absolutely love the game, but I wish there was a way to message your friends on the game. I have lots of friends from all over the world and it world and I would love to battle them but its almost impossible when there's no way to message or at least notify other players(friends) you want to battle. It would also be great if you could see when friends are active or online so you could message them and meet up for raids.

Used to play this game every single day. There are so many bugs with almost every single event. And now they limit my fun to five times per day while increasing the price to hopefully not lose hundreds of millions for the year. Every other game that Niantic has made has failed. The only reason this one hasn't is because The Pokémon brand is attached to it.

It gives mostly what you imagine if we can catch Pokemon in the real world mostly. The "Road to Hell Avatar" update, the avatars got a downgrade were they look like basement dwellers that never left home. It's also a bit sexist and transphobic, one can't go to their ideal beauty/real gender (Unlike before). I wouldn't have this problem with this update, if the previous models were included and if the clothes weren't clipping and poses as a risk for a game breaking bug.

Been freezing up alot lately no matter how strong my connection is. I just bought more poke balls and never received them but it charged my account for them. This is the 3rd time over the past month this happened. And now when I go in to purchase more for whatever reason I can't buy them with real money. I lost out on 3 wins in trainer battles that would've gave me streaks of 4/5 wins twice and once for 5/5 due to freezing and having to force close. What can u do to make this right?! Not happy!

Very interesting spin on the franchise... if done just a little bit more... pokemon-ish (i.e. battling wild monsters with your party of 6 monsters until it was weak enough to catch, only being able to switch out monsters at pokestops/pokecenters, having pokecenters to heal monsters, battles with trainers that are within one kilometer without having to scan there code just use wifi to link the battles (really akward walking up to little kids and asking them if they want to battle), wifi trading.

I'm disappointed with the decision to raise the price for remote raid passes. Sometimes that's the only option I have to participate in raids and it already takes two days to collect enough for the original price, now it will take four days to earn enough coins to purchase just one remote pass. I guess that's the end of the road for us non pay-to-play people. Good bye, Pokemon Go

update: can no longer recommend. I received a ban after playing at the airport and in another city. the only reason I can believe it is happening is because I am on the beta versions of Android rather than the most recent standard release. It's lots of fun to go out with friends and go along pokestops and catching Pokemon on the way. If you want to catch them all though you'll have to be extremely lucky and patient.

Back after a 3 year break, not much has changed. Routes is a awesome way to enjoy parties. My frustration is that the Journal feature has not changed since the beginning of the game. Would love to see #s like "Total # of Pokemon caught on a given day" that INCLUDES Pokemon transferred. Tags are new, but can't access tags when setting up raid battles. Can't organize tags in order you want them to show up unless you plan for it when creating them. And gameplay can change at times.

I can't seem to log in ever so had to take it off recently. I'll try again in a few days or so but if I can't ever log in especially after a few hours on wifi something is definitely going on. Other's in my friend group are starting to have troubles like this too. Hopefully it'll be fixed as Pokemon Go really helps get me active. Otherwise besides from the log in issues the game is very fun and would recommend it big time!

Okay game, but has several glitches which impact the playing experience and the creators have become disconnected with the player base as they've grown in size. Editing to one star. Game glitches make it unplayable at times. Can take 5+ attempts to get the game to actually load. Recent updates have also removed the social aspect to the game my friends and I were able to enjoy. Feels too isolating. Recommend exploring other apps which allow you to interact with friends while playing.

It has so much potential, but it's terribly executed. Endless server issues, grind/wait or pay mechanics, repetitive boring events, and ultimately ends up being only aimed at players who pour in lots of both time and money. Also, endless hat Pikachus, expensive trainer outfits, primitive battle modes, and if you've got power players around your nearby gyms? Good luck ever getting game coins. Since it's several years since game launch, this game is pretty much only for whales with cash to spend.

I'm a casual player, but am disappointed w/ rollbacks on PokeStop interaction distances. Pandemic or no, the game is safer/more accessible with more distance from stops and gyms. Weird lags, loading trouble and occasional GPS issues aside, this is a fun game-- but I question some of the developers' decisions lately, especially in the context of a renewed pandemic.

Diminished even more. The QoL made during quarantine made the game more accessible and enjoyable for everyone. Not exactly out of the woods yet plus the distance reduction really causes a lot of players to what to stop. We all walked during go fest. I don't understand the reasoning behind reducing distance again. Just don't bother playing right now. What made the game even better and more fun has all but been taken away during a time when the pandemic isn't even fully over. Bad look Niantic.

Really was a fun game until Niantic got greedy. What they do is give you a lot of neat stuff and once your addicted they slowly begin to take it away. When COVID started, Pokemon spawned all the time, now I'm lucky if they spawn even once with a lure. Their prices keep rising and their limits make the game unlikable. They don't listen to criticism, but they are more than happy to take your money. Overall very disappointing...

I've been enjoying the game. It allowed me to bond with my son. Unfortunately a money grab has begun. We will be cutting back on paying after the recent announcement for the update coming up. The cost increase and new limitations hurt the fun factor down to 1 star. It's been great Niantic but after our gold coins are gone so am I. Well ill keep playing but no more spending money. Fun factor is gone so the time we spend on it will be way less. No need to spend anymore money.

I've never seen a game developer less interested in player feedback. They've continuously rolled back features like Pokestop distance and remote raiding that made it possible to play this game at all for the majority of players. New releases are frequently buggy, but since this is a game meant to be played outside, it can cost an hour or two of your time instead of a moment's frustration. With the changes made to the game over the last year or two, I wouldn't recommend this game to anyone new.

This started out with much promise. Within 24 hours they have undone most of the potential. Removed tracking, blocked 3rd party tracking. The game is unplayable outside select areas with all the activity, unless you are willing to fork out the cash, of course. In its current state, it is not worth your time.

Really not much else to say. I wanted pokémon in real life, and this is as close as we can get. I'm one satisfied customer. (Edit) Pokémon GO has had its ups and downs, but the most recent versions of the game have astronomically improved everything from bugs and glitches to easier interfacing. I've never held on to a mobile game this long. 5/5

Edit: current update is broken. Freezes when trying to catch. Can't contact support. menu freezes. Old: Great Fun, A Bit Buggy, Support Problems Lag spikes have destroyed battles on occasion and some controls are a bit lacking. The graphics are great and overall I love this game. My biggest issue so far is that if the game won't log in, support is nonexistent since the only support offered is only accessible in-game.

Long time player. It got repetitive, but also, some people in the game are gym hogs. Takes away from the game experience when there's someone doing that. There's literally no incentive to camp a gym past the 50 daily limit on coins or after you've received the gold gym badge for X hours defending a gym. Lol. I played game for much too long. Also, did anyone else hear about the company and/or govt using players for data collection? 😂

A year since my updated review, and the game continues to expand, tho certain things like loot box...sorry, eggs...are polluted with an insanely deep pool of Pokémon that make it difficult to get what you want during a certain rotation. The changes made to accommodate COVID - remote raid, extended Stop interaction ranges, etc - are excellent and should stay permanent.

Every update has a problem. Galaxy s10. Can't use the new feature to play with pets. It just force closes every time. At least the actual game is working. Still a fair amount of GPS issues though. Watching my character ping pong blocks away is loads of fun when you're trying to battle a gym and get kicked out of it for GPS problems.

Update 03/23/2023 issues: 1. Using Mystery Box lure (Meltan), the game kept glitching and saying the pokemon could not be found, and it kept fleeing. 2. Trying to buy coins and my granddaughter's Google account shows up but not mine. It is a fun game and enjoy finding new interesting locations around town that I didn't know existed. Hate that when I have limited resources to capture new Pokemon they keep escaping the ball repeatedly and I end up giving up in frustration.

I've played the game since its 2016 launch and have enjoyed it over the last 5yrs. Being able to trade and battle have all been great improvements on the game. Legendary Pokémon AR still very difficult get if you have a small play group of 4 or less. Leveling up seems extremely difficult past lvl37. All the event themed Pokémon are quaint but lack the ability to evolve which is annoying. Bugs are at a minimum and graphics have improved over the years.

Randomly deleted from my phone, and when I reinstall it, I can't sign in. This is the second time I have had trouble signing in. The first was months ago so you can't use the excuse "the servers are down". Just a pile of finicky trash that was popular popular for a week in 2016. Better off with one of those free games with an add every 30 seconds.

Love the game but theyre slowly making all events (which used to be free) ticketed and now the ticket prices keep rising higher and higher. During COVID you could buy one remote pass a week so that the game was still playable without interacting with people, but now they're full price again. When they do go on sale, you are only allowed to own three at the same time so you can't stock up. Very predatory pricing and greedy actions

Everytime I get to the loading screen the game closes itself. I would really like to play. Edit: A year later (2017) and I still can't log in.... edit 2: (2019) thought I'd give it another try and was shocked to see I could log in! It lasted for 7 days, then a mandatory update rolled out and now the app won't even open... *sigh* Edit 3: (2024) Surely it would work now...nope. Cant login and cant create an accout. Just keep getting "oops something went wrong".

This game can be fun with the right friends, but the combat is limited and repetitive, and not at all like a proper Pokémon game. The fundamental gameplay does encourage walking to some extent, but in-app purchases are continuously put in your face as your experience is extremely limited (and laborious) if you try to play for free. All in all, this was interesting for some time, but proved to be a terrible waste of time and a distraction when out and about.

Niantic has seriously grown out of touch with the playerbase. The artificial scarcity of things is way too apparent, and the game is really a chore to play unless you have money to spend. (Gas isn't cheap and pokestops disappear everyday) Also unlike other apps, you can get arrested for trespassing or be killed. Yet millions of people go out and play every day. Pretty depressing that Niantic is more concerned with wringing pennies from you, than your well-being or enjoyment of the game.

I think it would be 5 if it was still pokemon go from when it was first released. But now due to all the new Pokemon and new things the game feels kinda cluttered and overwhelming. Not to mention that the default bag is to small and can no longer fit the entire dex. I know you can put Pokemon in gyms and stuff but things like that takes time and I just don't have that much time to grind down a gym.

I think that this game is good for a little while, but then it gets a little boring. Especially for those who don't really go out a ton, you're only able to get the three or so Pokémon that spawn a day. I do like how you can battle with other players, though I do wish it were like an actually Pokémon battle, where you can pick from a set of moves. The graphics are pretty nice as well. This app will probably take up about 1.60 GB on a Samsung. Other than that, the game is fun! 🦊

I've been playing since 2017, but now the game crashes frequently, or freezes up every time I look at a Pokémon's stats. Even the app store says that this app "likely won't work on this device" anymore. I don't know what happened, but I wish it could ve reversed. I used to really love this game, and I hadn't had any issues up until recently...

There was an update on December 31st—the same update that I've been forced to reinstall three times now. As much as I love Pokemon Go and will continue to play, this definitely dampens the experience. Make sure your updates are as bug free as possible before you ship them out so people aren't forced to download 50mb of data they've already installed several times before.

Task rewards are lame...game is laggy and 30+ balls only to fail to catch a Pokemon is beyond ridiculous. Especially when the CP is low. Other than that it's a good game for passing time. Also used Google points to buy stuff in the game and not only did it take the points but it also charged my bank account. Basically double charging me. Not happy AT ALL!

How are players supposed to do the one and only end game content this game has ever had since launch, if you over monetize it and force us with limitations to only do 5 a day. They increased the price of remote raid ticket to $2 ($1 before) and a three pack to $6 ($3 before), and its such a coincidence that their manipulative cash shop doesn't sell the exact amount of poke coins you need for that purchase so you have to buy the more expensive bundle to be able to buy just one pass.

The worst gaming experience I've ever had. When you lose a 11 win streak to lag like the game let him freely beat me when I definitely was about to fire off my charge move, then next thing its frozen and somehow I lose without even getting a fair chance to keep my win streak. So frustrating seeing you guys make all this money, add things into the game without fixing the core issues and aspects of the game, still money hungry after being out for some years now? Lol

Constant login crashes for weeks. They took away remote raid guaranteed 7 day reward for a chance and I have literally never seen one since. They keep breaking the game and making it worse to play for some reason. Pretty dumb company to take something good and make it like literally unplayable. After one more week not being able to log into your game I'll probably be in the habit of just not playing or thinking about it anymore which would be an overall positive in my life.

PERSONALLY I love this game been with it pretty much since launch. Although I'm not the best at the game me being lvl 36. it's so fun I've quit and came back multiple times but there are a few bugs and glitches and Niantic is horrible at marketing, but don't let that deter you from this game if you can put some hours into the game you will have fun. Cheers trainers and have fun out there. And be looking for shinies.

This is truly one of the best games out there. They have no ads and are always trying to fix problems. For example, during covid they added stuff that would allow you to actually be able to play the game at home. I just love the community and all of the features it has. I love the buddy system (❤Looking at you Espion!❤). It really gets me active and has me spending time outdoors. Not a complaint but I would want to see Jesse and James more often and another research task to find Jeovani.

I've been playing this game since the first summer it was released. My favorite app by far. But I have not been able to log in after the last update, I just remain at the Niantic logo no matter what. I've done everything possible, from clearing the cache to uninstalling and reinstalling the app, but nothing works. Please fix this so I can start playing my favorite app again.

Used to be really into this game even with the bugs occasionally stopping the game from starting and kicking me out of raids. The recent changes I'm just not a fan of though. I got attached to the regional tours which got needed along with remote raiding which has also been nerfed. It's just hard to invest any time/money in a game that takes away my favorite features like that. They don't care about player feedback and have made that clear. I can't recommend this game to anyone.

Was a 4 star rating until Niantic decided to take away the much welcomed doubled distance in which you can activate pokestops. not only was this a great feature for disabled people who may not be able to access pokestops, it meant you could find a safe spot out of people's way to get pokestop items. Now you can't even be across the street and activate a pokestop sometimes which just makes getting items so much more annoying. Please fix this as soon as possible Niantic.

Mostly play because I have already for so long. It's always one step forward, two steps back with Niantic. They don't listen to our concerns cause they'll make their money regardless. I really can't shake the thought that they're trying everything they can to make sure we pay for every addition to the game. "New costumed pokemon!" really just means "here's a new complication for hoarders, hopefully they'll buy more bag space!"

I LOVE this game! I love it that we can gift with people from other countries and see a little bit of their world. I love that you don't HAVE to spend $ AND that ANY age can play. I love that when we used to travel more ( pre-COVID) there were new pokemon to find on the road trip as well as at the destination! Yes- there are frustrating times when it doesn't connect, or there's a lag during the game. But there's always something to do like battling or sorting pokemon. It keeps me entertained.

I've really enjoyed playing this from when it came out. I like all the little tasks and research the role out. I didn't do any pokemon as a kid but this got me into some switch games and such. I even traveled to the vehas event for my birthday. But they're making it harder and harder. Doubling the price for remote raid passes when you kind need them to get enough people for 5 star raids is just awful. They're getting worse about paid research for little to no reward too.

This game officially destroyed my interest in pokemon. I had been playing since the beginning, and all that happened was the app kept getting harder, and more expensive, and the return for what I input in to the game was way less than expected.
