It's better now! As of it's kinda available in Bangladesh, right now 🤞🏻 but still, no better Pokemons, very few of them are powerful like 3 stars, and the game is just not playable in F2P mode. I like the game. Although the game kind of defeats the original purpose of the older and slightly better games. The core concept of the game is amazing. The developers are out of touch. Bugs are common, especially in Australia. Can't even get in the game without a few restarts. Interesting game with serious flaws due to extremely uneven distribution of stops and gyms. It's discouraging to play this game in Africa. There are hardly any pokestops, even in capital cities. Update: quit the game about a year ago. No regrets. Nothing fun happens and if something fun does you need to pay to play. Literally. Still brings me back but they are only doing 40% of what could potentially be done. Im only staying because i want to see this game reach its potential

I have loved and played this game for some years now. Never had any problems or bad encounters until two days now. After all the support and money we invest as players they do not care for us!!!!

l absolutely loved this game as I've always loved pokemon, however, i wished there were more variations of skills. I hate leaving this game a bad review, but I'm hear again:(. First of all since the new update I drift a lot. First couple of days are really fun, but it quickly becomes pay-to-play, which is my most hated free-to-play style! What point is a game if you can't play it? Hugely disappointed. great game overall, the developers are lovely and keep the playerbase active through events. they're generous with pokeballs and items needed to enjoy, a part from egg hatching you do realistically have to throw some money at if you want to hatch a lot, but this is not a necessity. there are some great bundles that come up from time to time which can be nice to pick up. you can also earn game currency through play so you don't necessarily need to spend money if you're a patient person. 5/5

I want to hop on here with others who are trying to be heard and mention the lack of care and respect from those who run the app. This distasteful attitude unfortunately leaches into the actual game, over years and months making it harder and less fun to play. Loving playing this so far. Would be good if you could use a pokemon assigned to a gym to view the gym when youre out of range. As a concept I think this is brilliant, having Pokemon overlaid on the real world is a neat idea. My kids love playing it and big bonus is they are getting outdoors, along with hundreds of others, I have even registered my own account. Bug fixes / updates are reasonably frequent. Still playing 4 years on, my kids have given up but it makes a daily walk a bit more interesting and some catches have become souvenirs of my travels.

Great.... When it works. Most recent update has completely ruined the gameplay though. I track my runs on two other apps at the same time, and both show I've run ~12 km this past week, with another 5 k walking. All while Pokemon Go was open, yet Pokemon Go registered a total of 1.7k. literally 1/10th the reality. It also freezes frequently, and drains battery more than any other app I've ever used. But this distance tracking is enough to finally force me to uninstall.

The game itself is really good. I've been playing it for around 4 years. But in my opinion, the bag limit should get removed. My bag reached around 1000/350 items, so I'm pretty frustrated that I can't pariticipate in league battles no more because I can't claim the item rewards.

just a casual player which opens this game whenever they go out. As a casual game I think this game is great for pokemon lovers. I so far have had no problems with the game crashing and no glitches. But in reality I think the addition to scan pokestops is just something you dont want to be seen doing in real life. Played on and off since 2016, but based on the decisions made by Niantic in the last six months alone, that switch is permanently off. I've loved this game for years. It is honestly my escape from reality. The problem is sometimes the app locks you out, or says it cannot authenticate you. Bland and grindy - it really is nothing but a chore. The things you do everyday is more or less the same, and the grinding part is ugly. Achievements take too much efforts to obtain! Its fun here and there, but it's meh. The game sets out to be what it is. But it could be alot better if more was brought to it, or even if features that they have now removed still remained. A really fun game to play. The game used to be good, now after years, it is slow, still has quite a lot of bugs and a lot of features require spending money to be actually useful.
